#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define SPI_DEVICE "/dev/spi0.0"
#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_BITS 8
#define SPI_MODE 0

#define GPIO_CE0 8
#define GPIO_MOSI 10
#define GPIO_MISO 9
#define GPIO_SCLK 11

#define LOG_FILE "moisture.log"

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (gpiod_is_initialized()) {
        gpiod_unexport_all();
    }
    if (spi_close()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "SPI device closed successfully\n");
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to close SPI device\n");
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
    struct gpiod_handle spi_handle;
    struct gpiod_line *gpio_ce0;
    int fd_spi, fd_gpio;
    char buffer[1024];
    struct timespec ts;

    // Set up signal handler for SIGINT
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    // Initialize SPI device
    if ((fd_spi = open(SPI_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set up SPI transfer parameters
    spi_transfer.msb = 0;
    spi_transfer.msbs = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsbs = 0;
    spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    spi_transfer.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    spi_transfer.bits_per_line = SPI_BITS;
    spi_transfer.mode = SPI_MODE;

    // Initialize SPI transfer
    spi_transfer.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&spi_transfer;
    spi_transfer.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&spi_transfer;
    spi_transfer.len = sizeof(spi_transfer);

    // Initialize GPIO line
    if ((fd_gpio = gpiod_open()) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO driver");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if ((gpio_ce0 = gpiod_get_line(fd_gpio, GPIO_CE0)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set GPIO line to output mode
    if (gpiod_set_mode(gpio_ce0, GPIOD_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set GPIO line to high (CE0 high)
    if (gpiod_set_value(gpio_ce0, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line value");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Loop indefinitely
    while (1) {
        // Set up timestamp
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        fprintf(stderr, "Timestamp: %ld.%09ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);

        // Perform SPI transfer
        if (ioctl(fd_spi, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &spi_transfer) < 0) {
            perror("SPI transfer failed");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        // Read SPI data
        if (read(fd_spi, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read SPI data");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        // Print raw ADC value
        fprintf(stderr, "Raw ADC value: %d\n", (int)buffer[0]);

        // Write to log file
        if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
            perror("Failed to open log file");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
        if (fprintf(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a"), "%ld.%09ld %d\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0, (int)buffer[0]) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to log file");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
        if (fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a")) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to close log file");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        // Wait for 1 second
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>
#include <linux/gpiod.h>
#include <time.h>

#define SPI0 0
#define CE0 8
#define A0 4
#define D0 4
#define MCP3008_ADDR 0x68
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_BITS 8
#define SPI_MODE 0

typedef struct {
    int fd_spi;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
    int fd_gpio;
    struct gpiod_handle handle;
    struct gpiod_line *gpio_ce0;
    struct gpiod_line *gpio_d0;
    struct gpiod_line *gpio_a0;
    int flame_present;
    int temperature;
    char filename[256];
} FlameSensorData;

void init_spi(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    fsd->fd_spi = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (fsd->fd_spi < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fsd->spi_transfer.msb = SPI_BITS;
    fsd->spi_transfer.msbs = 0;
    fsd->spi_transfer.lsb = SPI_BITS;
    fsd->spi_transfer.lbs = 0;
    fsd->spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    fsd->spi_transfer.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    fsd->spi_transfer.mode = SPI_MODE;

    ioctl(fsd->fd_spi, SPI_SET_SPEED, &fsd->spi_transfer);
}

void init_gpio(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    fsd->fd_gpio = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY);
    if (fsd->fd_gpio < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fsd->handle = gpiod_open(fsd->fd_gpio);
    if (fsd->handle < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device handle");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fsd->gpio_ce0 = gpiod_get_line(fsd->handle, CE0);
    if (!fsd->gpio_ce0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO CE0 line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fsd->gpio_d0 = gpiod_get_line(fsd->handle, D0);
    if (!fsd->gpio_d0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO D0 line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fsd->gpio_a0 = gpiod_get_line(fsd->handle, A0);
    if (!fsd->gpio_a0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO A0 line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_request(fsd->handle, fsd->gpio_ce0, FIONB) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO CE0");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_request(fsd->handle, fsd->gpio_d0, FIONB) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO D0");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_request(fsd->handle, fsd->gpio_a0, FIONB) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO A0");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_spi(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    int buffer[1];
    ssize_t bytes_read;

    ioctl(fsd->fd_spi, SPI_IOC_MESSAGE1, &fsd->spi_transfer, buffer, &bytes_read);

    if (bytes_read < 0) {
        perror("SPI transfer failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fsd->temperature = (int)(buffer[0] * 3.3);
}

void read_gpio(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    int value;

    if (gpio_get_value(fsd->gpio_ce0) == 1) {
        fsd->flame_present = 1;
    } else {
        fsd->flame_present = 0;
    }

    if (gpio_get_value(fsd->gpio_d0) == 1) {
        fsd->temperature = 100;
    } else {
        fsd->temperature = 0;
    }
}

void write_gpio(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    if (gpio_direction_set(fsd->handle, fsd->gpio_ce0, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO CE0 direction");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio_direction_set(fsd->handle, fsd->gpio_d0, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO D0 direction");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio_direction_set(fsd->handle, fsd->gpio_a0, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO A0 direction");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void log_data(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *timeinfo = localtime(&now);
    char filename[256];
    snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "flame_data_%d-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S.csv", timeinfo->tm_mon + 1, timeinfo->tm_mday, timeinfo->tm_hour, timeinfo->tm_min, timeinfo->tm_sec);

    FILE *fp = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(fp, "%d,%d\n", fsd->flame_present, fsd->temperature);
    fclose(fp);
}

void cleanup(FlameSensorData *fsd) {
    gpiod_close(fsd->handle);
    gpiod_free_line(fsd->gpio_ce0);
    gpiod_free_line(fsd->gpio_d0);
    gpiod_free_line(fsd->gpio_a0);
    close(fsd->fd_spi);
    close(fsd->fd_gpio);
}

int main() {
    FlameSensorData fsd;
    memset(&fsd, 0, sizeof(fsd));

    init_spi(&fsd);
    init_gpio(&fsd);

    write_gpio(&fsd);

    while (1) {
        read_spi(&fsd);
        read_gpio(&fsd);
        log_data(&fsd);

        sleep(1);
    }

    cleanup(&fsd);

    return 0;

void handle_file_error(int err) {

void handle_alert_error(int err) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

    if (sensor->fd > 0) {
        close(sensor->fd);

    if (sensor->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(sensor->i2c_fd);
    }
    free(sensor);
}

    char *log_buffer = NULL;

    int log_fd = open(CO_LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);

        handle_file_error(log_fd);

    log_buffer_size = strlen(CO_LOG_HEADER) + strlen("CO ppm: ") + 6 + 1;

    if (write(log_fd, log_buffer, log_buffer_size) < 0) {
        handle_file_error(log_fd);
    }

    free(log_buffer);
    close(log_fd);
}

void write_alert_log(SensorData *sensor, int ppm) {

        return -1;

}

int spi_read(int fd, int cs, int num_bytes) {
    uint8_t buffer[num_bytes];
    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_READ, cs, buffer, num_bytes) < 0) {

        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int spi_deinit_spi(int fd) {

int adc_read(int fd, int cs, int channel) {

    if (result < 0) return -1;
    result = spi_read(fd, cs, 3);
    if (result < 0) return -1;
    buffer[0] = buffer[1] = buffer[2] = 0;
    buffer[0] = buffer[1] = buffer[2] = 0;
    buffer[0] = (buffer[0] << 2) | (buffer[1] >> 6);
    buffer[1] = (buffer[1] << 6) | (buffer[2] >> 10);
    return buffer[0] * 256 + buffer[1];
}

double adc_rms(int samples[], int count) {
    double sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        sum += (samples[i] / 32768.0) * 2.8284271247461903; // sqrt(2)

    return sqrt(sum / count);

    wiringPiSPIClose(SPI_CHANNEL);
    wiringPiClose();
    return 0;

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        return -1;
    }
    return buf[0];

    if (instance->clear == 0 || instance->red == 0 || instance->green == 0 || instance->blue == 0) {

    char timestamp[20];
    strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", &ts);
    char line[100];
    snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%s,%d,%d,%d,%d", timestamp, instance->clear, instance->red, instance->green, instance->blue);

    }
    if (instance->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(instance->i2c_fd);
    }
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

    if (instance->clear == 0 || instance->red == 0 || instance->green == 0 || instance->blue == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor error: invalid configuration\n");
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor error: invalid configuration\n");
    }
    if (instance->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(instance->i2c_fd);
    }
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

static void run() {
    init_sensor();
    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, sigint_handler);
    while (1) {
        if (instance->clear == 0 || instance->red == 0 || instance->green == 0 || instance->blue == 0) {
            handle_sensor_error();
        }
        read_color_values();
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second
    }

    run();

int read_adc(ADS1115 *adc) {
    int buffer[1];
    int len = 1;
    int result = 0;

    if (ioctl(adc->fd, I2C_RD, 0, buffer, len) < 0) {
        perror("I2C_RD");
        return -1;
    }

    int16_t value = (int16_t)buffer[0];
    int32_t pressure = (float)value * (float)adc->gain / 32768.0 * (float)adc->resolution * (float)PRESSURE_RANGE;

    if (pressure < adc->pressure_min || pressure > adc->pressure_max) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int init_logger(Logger *logger) {
    logger->fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (logger->fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return -1;
    }

    struct tm *now = gmtime(&time(NULL));
    char buffer[128];
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%06Z", now);
    logger->timestamp_fd = open(buffer, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (logger->timestamp_fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        close(logger->fd);
        return -1;
    }

    logger->pressure_fd = open(buffer, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (logger->pressure_fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        close(logger->fd);
        close(logger->timestamp_fd);
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int write_log(Logger *logger, int pressure) {
    char buffer[128];
    struct tm *now = gmtime(&time(NULL));
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%06Z", now);
    char log_line[128];
    snprintf(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%s,%d", buffer, pressure);

    if (write(logger->timestamp_fd, log_line, strlen(log_line)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return -1;
    }

    if (write(logger->pressure_fd, log_line, strlen(log_line)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);

    int gpio_result = init_gpio(SDA_PIN);
    if (gpio_result < 0) {
        perror("gpio initialization");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    int adc_result = init_adc(&adc);
    if (adc_result < 0) {
        perror("adc initialization");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    Logger logger;
    int logger_result = init_logger(&logger);
    if (logger_result < 0) {
        perror("logger initialization");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    while (1) {
        int adc_result = read_adc(&adc);
        if (adc_result < 0) {
            perror("adc read");
            continue;
        }

        int pressure = adc_result;
        if (write_log(&logger, pressure) < 0) {
            perror("log write");
        }

        sleep(1);
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <errno.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <math.h>

#define SPI0 0
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define ADC_CHANNEL 0
#define CE_PIN 8
#define ADC_MAX 0x3FF
#define ADC_MIN 0
#define FLOW_RATE_MAX 5.0
#define FLOW_RATE_MIN 0.0

typedef struct {
    int spi_fd;
    int spi_mode;
    int spi_freq;
    int spi_channel;
    int spi_cs;
    int spi_result;
    int spi_transfer_result;
    int spi_adc_result;
    int spi_adc_result_valid;
    int spi_adc_result_absent;
    int spi_adc_result_out_of_range;
    int spi_adc_result_flow_rate;
} SpiInterface;

typedef struct {
    char timestamp[26];
    double flow_rate;
} LogEntry;

void spi_init(SpiInterface *spi) {
    spi->spi_fd = -1;
    spi->spi_mode = SPI_MODE;
    spi->spi_freq = SPI_FREQ;
    spi->spi_channel = SPI0;
    spi->spi_cs = CE_PIN;
    spi->spi_result = 0;
    spi->spi_transfer_result = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_valid = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_absent = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_out_of_range = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_flow_rate = 0;
}

int spi_open(SpiInterface *spi) {
    spi->spi_fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (spi->spi_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error opening SPI device: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    spi->spi_result = ioctl(spi->spi_fd, SPI_SET_MODE, &spi->spi_mode);
    if (spi->spi_result < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error setting SPI mode: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    spi->spi_result = ioctl(spi->spi_fd, SPI_SET_SPEED, &spi->spi_freq);
    if (spi->spi_result < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error setting SPI speed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    spi->spi_result = ioctl(spi->spi_fd, SPI_SET_CS, &spi->spi_cs);
    if (spi->spi_result < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error setting SPI CS: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int spi_transfer(SpiInterface *spi, uint8_t *buf, uint8_t *data) {
    spi->spi_transfer_result = ioctl(spi->spi_fd, SPI_TRANSFER, buf, data);
    if (spi->spi_transfer_result < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error transferring data: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int spi_adc_read(SpiInterface *spi, uint8_t *buf, uint8_t *data) {
    spi->spi_result = ioctl(spi->spi_fd, SPI_READ, buf, data);
    if (spi->spi_result < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error reading ADC: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

double spi_adc_to_flow_rate(uint16_t adc_value) {
    if (adc_value == 0 || adc_value == ADC_MAX) {
        return NAN;
    }
    double flow_rate = (adc_value / ADC_MAX) * FLOW_RATE_MAX;
    if (flow_rate < FLOW_RATE_MIN || flow_rate > FLOW_RATE_MAX) {
        return NAN;
    }
    return flow_rate;
}

void log_entry(LogEntry *entry) {
    char timestamp[26];
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    strftime(timestamp, 26, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f", localtime_r(&ts.tv_sec, &ts.tv_nsec));
    snprintf(entry->timestamp, 26, "%s", timestamp);
    entry->flow_rate = spi_adc_to_flow_rate(spi->spi_adc_result);
    if (isnan(entry->flow_rate)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ADC value out of range or sensor absent\n");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "Flow rate: %f L/min\n", entry->flow_rate);
    fprintf(stderr, "Timestamp: %s\n", entry->timestamp);
    fprintf(stderr, "\n");
}

void spi_close(SpiInterface *spi) {
    if (spi->spi_fd > 0) {
        close(spi->spi_fd);
    }
    spi->spi_fd = -1;
}

void spi_deinit(SpiInterface *spi) {
    spi_close(spi);
    spi->spi_result = 0;
    spi->spi_transfer_result = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_valid = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_absent = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_out_of_range = 0;
    spi->spi_adc_result_flow_rate = 0;
}

int main() {
    SpiInterface spi;
    LogEntry log_entry;

    spi_init(&spi);
    if (spi_open(&spi) < 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    int fd = open("flow_log.csv", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error opening log file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        spi_transfer(&spi, (uint8_t *)0, (uint8_t *)&spi->spi_adc_result);
        if (spi->spi_transfer_result < 0) {
            continue;
        }
        spi_adc_read(&spi, (uint8_t *)0, (uint8_t *)&spi->spi_adc_result);
        if (spi->spi_adc_result_valid) {
            log_entry.flow_rate = spi_adc_to_flow_rate(spi->spi_adc_result);
            if (isnan(log_entry.flow_rate)) {
                fprintf(stderr, "ADC value out of range or sensor absent\n");
            } else {
                snprintf(log_entry.timestamp, 26, "%s", spi->timestamp);
                fprintf(fd, "%s,%f\n", log_entry.timestamp, log_entry.flow_rate);
                fflush(fd);
            }
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "ADC read failed\n");
        }
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

    spi_deinit(&spi);
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>

#define ICP10125_ADDR 0x48
#define ICP10125_MEASUREMENT_COMMAND 0x00
#define ICP10125_RESULT_SIZE 6
#define ICP10125_RESULT_OFFSET 0
#define ICP10125_RESULT_LENGTH 6
#define ICP10125_RESULT_CRC_OFFSET 4
#define ICP10125_RESULT_CRC_LENGTH 2

#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_TEMP_OFFSET 0
#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_TEMP_SCALE 0.0001
#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_TEMP_OFFSET_TEMP 0.0
#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_TEMP_SCALE_TEMP 0.0
#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_PRESSURE_OFFSET 0
#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_PRESSURE_SCALE 0.0001
#define ICP10125_CALIBRATION_PRESSURE_OFFSET_PASCAL 101325.0

typedef struct {
    uint8_t pressure_MSB;
    uint8_t pressure_LSB;
    uint8_t temperature_MSB;
    uint8_t temperature_LSB;
    uint8_t crc[2];
} ICP10125Result;

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    ICP10125Result result;
    char filename[128];
    FILE *log_file;
    time_t timestamp;
    struct tm *tm;
} EnvironmentalData;

void handle_error(int err, const char *msg) {
    fprintf(stderr, "%s: %d\n", msg, err);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void log_error(const char *msg) {
    EnvironmentalData *data = (EnvironmentalData *)malloc(sizeof(EnvironmentalData));
    data->fd = -1;
    data->result.pressure_MSB = 0;
    data->result.pressure_LSB = 0;
    data->result.temperature_MSB = 0;
    data->result.temperature_LSB = 0;
    data->result.crc[0] = 0;
    data->result.crc[1] = 0;
    data->timestamp = time(NULL);
    data->tm = localtime(&data->timestamp);
    snprintf(data->filename, sizeof(data->filename), "environmental_data_%s.csv", asctime(data->tm));
    data->log_file = fopen(data->filename, "a");
    if (!data->log_file) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to open log file");
    }
    fprintf(data->log_file, "%ld,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d\n", data->timestamp, data->result.pressure_MSB, data->result.pressure_LSB, data->result.temperature_MSB, data->result.temperature_LSB, data->result.crc[0], data->result.crc[1]);
    fclose(data->log_file);
    free(data);
}

void calibrate_pressure(ICP10125Result *result) {
    result->pressure = (result->pressure_MSB << 8) | result->pressure_LSB;
    result->pressure = result->pressure * ICP10125_CALIBRATION_PRESSURE_SCALE + ICP10125_CALIBRATION_PRESSURE_OFFSET_PASCAL;
}

void calibrate_temperature(ICP10125Result *result) {
    result->temperature = (result->temperature_MSB << 8) | result->temperature_LSB;
    result->temperature = result->temperature * ICP10125_CALIBRATION_TEMP_SCALE + ICP10125_CALIBRATION_TEMP_OFFSET_TEMP;
}

void read_result(ICP10125Result *result, int fd) {
    result->pressure_MSB = 0;
    result->pressure_LSB = 0;
    result->temperature_MSB = 0;
    result->temperature_LSB = 0;
    result->crc[0] = 0;
    result->crc[1] = 0;
    if (ioctl(fd, ICP10125_RESULT, ICP10125_RESULT_OFFSET, result)) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to read result");
    }
}

void read_sensor_data(int fd) {
    ICP10125Result result;
    result.pressure_MSB = 0;
    result.pressure_LSB = 0;
    result.temperature_MSB = 0;
    result.temperature_LSB = 0;
    result.crc[0] = 0;
    result.crc[1] = 0;
    if (ioctl(fd, ICP10125_MEASUREMENT_COMMAND, 0, &result)) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to issue measurement command");
    }
    read_result(&result, fd);
    if (result.crc[0] != 0 || result.crc[1] != 0) {
        handle_error(errno, "CRC error");
    }
    calibrate_pressure(&result);
    calibrate_temperature(&result);
    printf("Temperature: %.2f°C, Pressure: %.2f Pa\n", result.temperature, result.pressure);
}

void open_sensor(int *fd) {
    *fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (*fd == -1) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to open I2C bus");
    }
    if (ioctl(*fd, I2C_SLAVE, ICP10125_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to set I2C slave address");
    }
}

void close_sensor(int fd) {
    if (fd != -1) {
        close(fd);
    }
}

void log_data(const char *filename, ICP10125Result *result) {
    EnvironmentalData *data = (EnvironmentalData *)malloc(sizeof(EnvironmentalData));
    data->fd = -1;
    data->result.pressure_MSB = 0;
    data->result.pressure_LSB = 0;
    data->result.temperature_MSB = 0;
    data->result.temperature_LSB = 0;
    data->result.crc[0] = 0;
    data->result.crc[1] = 0;
    data->timestamp = time(NULL);
    data->tm = localtime(&data->timestamp);
    snprintf(data->filename, sizeof(data->filename), "environmental_data_%s.csv", asctime(data->tm));
    data->log_file = fopen(data->filename, "a");
    if (!data->log_file) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to open log file");
    }
    fprintf(data->log_file, "%ld,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d\n", data->timestamp, data->result.pressure_MSB, data->result.pressure_LSB, data->result.temperature_MSB, data->result.temperature_LSB, data->result.crc[0], data->result.crc[1]);
    fclose(data->log_file);
    free(data);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        close_sensor(data->fd);
        if (data->log_file) {
            fclose(data->log_file);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    EnvironmentalData data;
    int fd = -1;
    data.log_file = NULL;
    data.timestamp = time(NULL);
    data.tm = localtime(&data.timestamp);
    snprintf(data.filename, sizeof(data.filename), "environmental_data_%s.csv", asctime(data.tm));
    data.log_file = fopen(data.filename, "w");
    if (!data.log_file) {
        handle_error(errno, "Failed to open log file");
    }
    fprintf(data.log_file, "timestamp,pressure_MSB,pressure_LSB,temperature_MSB,temperature_LSB,crc[0],crc[1]\n");
    fclose(data.log_file);
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);
    open_sensor(&fd);
    while (1) {
        read_sensor_data(fd);
        log_data(data.filename, &data.result);
        sleep(5);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <string.h>

#include <fcntl.h>

#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define SPI_DEVICE "/dev/spi0.0"
#define SPI_CS_PIN 0
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_BITS 8
#define SPI_MODE 0

#define MAX_LINE_LENGTH 256

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
} spi_moisture_reader;

void handle_spi_error(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer error: %d\n", err);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_file_error(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "File error: %d\n", err);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (spi_reader->line) {
            gpiod_line_put(spi_reader->line);
        }
        gpiod_chip_put(spi_reader->chip);
        spi_close(spi_reader->fd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    char timestamp[MAX_LINE_LENGTH];
    spi_moisture_reader spi_reader;
    int fd, line_fd, result;

    // Initialize SPI device
    fd = open(SPI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        handle_file_error(errno);
    }

    // Set SPI mode and CS pin
    spi_reader.spi.msb = 0;
    spi_reader.spi.msbs = 1;
    spi_reader.spi.mode = SPI_MODE;
    spi_reader.spi.bits = SPI_BITS;
    spi_reader.spi.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    spi_reader.spi.delay_us = 0;
    spi_reader.spi.cs_change = 1;
    spi_reader.spi.cs_high_level = 0;
    spi_reader.spi.cs_low_level = 0;
    spi_reader.spi.first_bit = 0;
    spi_reader.spi.last_bit = 7;

    result = ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, &spi_reader.spi.mode);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    result = ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, &spi_reader.spi.cs_change);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    result = ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, &spi_reader.spi.cs_high_level);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    result = ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, &spi_reader.spi.cs_low_level);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    // Initialize GPIO driver
    spi_reader.chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (!spi_reader.chip) {
        handle_file_error(errno);
    }

    spi_reader.line = gpiod_chip_request_line(spi_reader.chip, SPI_CS_PIN, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT);
    if (!spi_reader.line) {
        handle_file_error(errno);
    }

    // Set GPIO pin to output
    result = gpiod_line_request_output(spi_reader.line);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_file_error(errno);
    }

    // Set GPIO pin to low
    result = gpiod_line_set_value(spi_reader.line, 0);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_file_error(errno);
    }

    // Set up signal handler
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    while (1) {
        // Get current time
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        strftime(timestamp, MAX_LINE_LENGTH, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%06fZ", localtime_r(&ts.tv_sec, &ts.tv_nsec));

        // Read SPI data
        spi_reader.spi.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&spi_reader.spi;
        spi_reader.spi.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&spi_reader.spi;
        spi_reader.spi.len = 1;
        spi_reader.spi.delay_us = 0;
        spi_reader.spi.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
        spi_reader.spi.bits = SPI_BITS;
        spi_reader.spi.mode = SPI_MODE;

        result = ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &spi_reader.spi);
        if (result < 0) {
            handle_spi_error(errno);
        }

        // Read raw ADC value
        unsigned int adc_value = spi_reader.spi.rx_buf[0];

        // Check if ADC value is within valid range
        if (adc_value < 0 || adc_value > 1023) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid ADC value: %d\n", adc_value);
            continue;
        }

        // Write to log file
        char line[MAX_LINE_LENGTH];
        snprintf(line, MAX_LINE_LENGTH, "%s,%d\n", timestamp, adc_value);
        result = write(fd, line, strlen(line));
        if (result < 0) {
            handle_file_error(errno);
        }

        // Sleep for 60 seconds
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi0.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi0-mcp3008.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define SPI0_CE0 8
#define SPI0_MISO 9
#define SPI0_MOSI 10
#define SPI0_SCLK 11
#define MCP3008_ADDR 0x78
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000

#define LED_PIN 17
#define LED_ON 1
#define LED_OFF 0

#define JSON_FILE "water_levels.json"
#define JSON_HEADER "{\"water_levels\": ["
#define JSON_FOOTER "]}"

#define MAX_READINGS 1000

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer transfer;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    int level;
    int last_level;
    int last_time;
    int last_error;
    int running;
} SensorData;

void handle_spi_error(int error) {
    printf("SPI error: %d\n", error);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (SensorData[0].running) {
            SensorData[0].running = 0;
            gpiod_line_put(SensorData[0].line, LED_ON, 0);
            close(SensorData[0].fd);
            free(SensorData[0].chip);
            free(SensorData[0].line);
            exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    SensorData sensor_data[1];
    sensor_data[0].running = 1;

    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_READINGS; i++) {
        sensor_data[i].fd = 0;
        sensor_data[i].chip = NULL;
        sensor_data[i].line = NULL;
        sensor_data[i].level = 0;
        sensor_data[i].last_level = 0;
        sensor_data[i].last_time = 0;
        sensor_data[i].last_error = 0;
    }

    int spi_fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int json_fd;

    if ((spi_fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_GET_MODE, &sensor_data[0].transfer.mode) < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_GET_MODE, &sensor_data[0].transfer.mode));
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_SPEED, &sensor_data[0].transfer.speed) < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_SPEED, &sensor_data[0].transfer.speed));
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CS_MODE, 0) < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CS_MODE, 0));
    }

    if ((i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-0", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, MCP3008_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((json_fd = open(JSON_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL, 0644)) < 0) {
        perror("open JSON file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (write(json_fd, JSON_HEADER, strlen(JSON_HEADER)) < 0) {
        perror("write JSON header");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    sensor_data[0].last_time = ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;

    while (sensor_data[0].running) {
        if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CS_MODE, 0) < 0) {
            handle_spi_error(ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CS_MODE, 0));
        }

        if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_I2C_MCP3008, &sensor_data[0].transfer, 0) < 0) {
            handle_spi_error(ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_I2C_MCP3008, &sensor_data[0].transfer, 0));
        }

        if (sensor_data[0].transfer.error) {
            sensor_data[0].level = sensor_data[0].transfer.value;
            sensor_data[0].last_error = sensor_data[0].transfer.error;
        } else {
            sensor_data[0].level = sensor_data[0].transfer.value;
            sensor_data[0].last_error = 0;
        }

        if (sensor_data[0].level > 75) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(sensor_data[0].line, LED_ON);
        } else if (sensor_data[0].level < 70) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(sensor_data[0].line, LED_OFF);
        }

        struct timespec now;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
        sensor_data[0].last_time = now.tv_sec * 1000 + now.tv_nsec / 1000000;

        char buffer[128];
        snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "{\"timestamp\":\"%ldms\",\"level\":%.2f}\n", sensor_data[0].last_time, (float)sensor_data[0].level / 255.0 * 100.0);

        if (write(json_fd, buffer, strlen(buffer)) < 0) {
            perror("write JSON entry");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (fstat(json_fd, &statbuf) < 0) {
            perror("fstat JSON file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (statbuf.st_size % 2 == 0) {
            if (write(json_fd, JSON_FOOTER, strlen(JSON_FOOTER)) < 0) {
                perror("write JSON footer");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }

        usleep(500000); // 5 seconds
    }

    close(spi_fd);
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(json_fd);

    return 0;
}

typedef struct {

void spi_init(SpiDevConfig *config) {

        perror("SPI SCLK write");

        perror("SPI CS write");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI, SPI_CS_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI MOSI read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MISO, SPI_CS_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI MISO read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SCLK, SPI_CS_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI SCLK read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_CS, SPI_CS_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        perror("SPI mode write");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

void spi_read(SpiDevConfig *config, int *raw_data) {
    int buffer[SPI_TRANSFER_SIZE];
    int result;

    config->cs_gpio = SPI_CS_RELEASE;
    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_CS, SPI_CS_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS release");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    result = ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA, buffer);
    if (result < 0) {
        perror("SPI read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    *raw_data = buffer[0] << 8 | buffer[1] | (buffer[2] & 0x07);
}

void spi_write(SpiDevConfig *config, int value) {
    int buffer[SPI_TRANSFER_SIZE];
    int result;

    config->cs_gpio = SPI_CS_RELEASE;
    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_CS, SPI_CS_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS release");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    buffer[0] = value >> 8;
    buffer[1] = value >> 0;
    buffer[2] = 0;

    result = ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_DATA, buffer);
    if (result < 0) {
        perror("SPI write");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void spi_release(SpiDevConfig *config) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    config->mosi_gpio = SPI_MOSI_RELEASE;
    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI, SPI_MOSI_RELEASE) < 0) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    config->sclk_gpio = SPI_SCLK_RELEASE;
    if (ioctl(config->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SCLK, SPI_SCLK_RELEASE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI SCLK release");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void sig_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        SpiDevConfig config;
        config.fd = 0;
        config.cs_gpio = 0;
        config.mosi_gpio = 0;
        config.miso_gpio = 0;
        config.sclk_gpio = 0;

        spi_release(&config);
        close(config.fd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = sig_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);

    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("sigaction");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    SpiDevConfig config;
    config.fd = 0;
    config.cs_gpio = 0;
    config.mosi_gpio = 0;
    config.miso_gpio = 0;
    config.sclk_gpio = 0;

    spi_init(&config);

    while (1) {
        int raw_data;
        spi_read(&config, &raw_data);

        double moisture = (raw_data * 100.0) / 1023.0;
        printf("Raw ADC: %d, Moisture: %.2f%%\n", raw_data, moisture);

        sleep(5);
    }

    return 0;
}

}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (spidev_fd != -1) {
            close(spidev_fd);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }

#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL 200
#define RELAY_PIN 17
#define REED_PIN 27
#define RELAY_ON_TIME 3000
#define LOG_FILE "/var/log/door_events.log"

void calibrate_ads1115() {
    int fd = open("/dev/i2c‑1", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(fd);
        exit(1);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define PCF8591_ADDR 0x48
#define PCF8591_AIN0 0x00

int i2c_fd;

void sigint_handler(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdma_request request;
    int status;

    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);

    i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    request.request = I2C_SLAVE;
    request.flags = 0;
    request.addr = PCF8591_ADDR;

    status = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, request.addr);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(i2c_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    msg[0].addr = request.addr;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = PCF8591_AIN0;

    msg[1].addr = request.addr;
    msg[1].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[1].data[0] = 0;

    while (1) {
        status = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, msg);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            close(i2c_fd);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (msg[0].data[0] == 0) {
            // Dummy read
            msg[0].data[0] = PCF8591_AIN0;
            status = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, msg);
            if (status < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read I2C data");
                close(i2c_fd);
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }

        printf("%d\n", msg[0].data[0]);
        usleep(100000); // 100ms delay
    }

    return 0;
}

static void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

static void handle_adc_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

static void handle_gpio_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "GPIO error: %d", err);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void init_i2c() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, SS49E_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(errno);
    }
}

static void init_adc() {
    if ((adc_fd = open("/dev/adc1", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, I2C_GET_ID, 0) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, I2C_SET_CONFIG, 0) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, I2C_SET_CONFIG, ADC_CONFIG_SINGLE) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, I2C_SET_CONFIG, ADC_CONFIG_GAIN_2) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, I2C_SET_CONFIG, ADC_CONFIG_RESOLUTION_12BIT) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, I2C_SET_CONFIG, ADC_CONFIG_SAMPLE_RATE_1) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(errno);
    }
}

static void init_gpio() {
    if ((gpio_fd = wiringPiGpioInit()) < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }
    if (wiringPiGpioSetMode(gpio_fd, INPUT_OUTPUT, GPIO27) < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }
    if (wiringPiGpioSetPullUpDnControl(gpio_fd, GPIO27, 0) < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }
}

static void shutdown_gpio() {
    if (wiringPiGpioSetMode(gpio_fd, INPUT, GPIO27) < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }
    if (wiringPiGpioUnexport(gpio_fd) < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <math.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x49E
#define ADC_GAIN 4.096
#define ADC_RESOLUTION 16
#define ADC_CHANNELS 1
#define ADC_SINGLEENDED 1
#define ADC_PGA_GAIN 4.096
#define ADC_RESOLUTIONS 16
#define ADC_RESOLUTIONS_PER_VOLT 32768
#define ADC_RESOLUTIONS_PER_GAUSS 10000

#define LED_GPIO 17
#define LED_ON 1
#define LED_OFF 0

#define DEFAULT_THRESHOLD 100.0

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int adc_fd;
    int threshold;
    int running;
    int led_state;
} Config;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (Config.running) {
        Config.led_state = LED_OFF;
        Config.running = 0;
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    handle_sigint(signum);
}

void init_config(Config *config) {
    config->running = 1;
    config->led_state = LED_OFF;
    config->threshold = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
    config->adc_fd = -1;
    config->i2c_fd = -1;
}

void init_i2c(Config *config) {
    if (config->i2c_fd == -1) {
        config->i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
        if (config->i2c_fd < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (ioctl(config->i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void init_adc(Config *config) {
    if (config->adc_fd == -1) {
        config->adc_fd = open("/dev/adc1", O_RDWR);
        if (config->adc_fd < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open ADC device");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void read_adc(Config *config) {
    if (config->adc_fd < 0) {
        perror("ADC device not initialized");
        return;
    }
    int buffer[ADC_CHANNELS];
    if (ioctl(config->adc_fd, ADC_GET_VALUE, buffer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read ADC value");
        return;
    }
    int16_t value = buffer[0];
    double volts = (double)value * ADC_RESOLUTIONS_PER_VOLT / ADC_RESOLUTIONS;
    double gauss = volts / ADC_RESOLUTIONS_PER_GAUSS;
    printf("Magnetic field: %.2f Gauss\n", gauss);
    if (gauss > config->threshold) {
        config->led_state = LED_ON;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            usleep(50000);
            if (config->led_state == LED_ON) {
                config->led_state = LED_OFF;
            } else {
                config->led_state = LED_ON;
            }
        }
        config->led_state = LED_OFF;
    }
}

void cleanup(Config *config) {
    if (config->adc_fd != -1) {
        close(config->adc_fd);
    }
    if (config->i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(config->i2c_fd);
    }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    Config config;
    init_config(&config);
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);

    init_i2c(&config);
    init_adc(&config);

    double threshold = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
    if (argc > 1) {
        threshold = atof(argv[1]);
    }

    while (config.running) {
        read_adc(&config);
        usleep(100000);
    }

    cleanup(&config);

    return 0;
}

#define SPI_CS_PIN 8
#define SPI_MOSI_PIN 10
#define SPI_MISO_PIN 9

    spi_transfer.bits_per_word = 10;
    spi_transfer.delay_us = 0;

    if (wiringPiSPISpiSetMode(SPI_MOSI_PIN, SPI_MISO_PIN, SPI_SCLK_PIN, spi_fd, SPI_MODE) < 0) {

        close(spi_fd);

        close(spi_fd);

}

#include <string.h>

#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <math.h>

#define SPI_DEV "/dev/spi0.0"
#define MCP3008_CHIP_ENABLE 0
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int spi_fd;
    int csv_fd;
    struct timeval timestamp;
} SensorData;

void init_spi(int spi_fd) {
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI mode write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPEED_hz, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI speed write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SPEED_hz, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI speed read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BITS_PER_WORD, 10) < 0) {
        perror("SPI bits per word write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BITS_PER_WORD, 10) < 0) {
        perror("SPI bits per word read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void init_sensor_data(SensorData *sensor_data) {
    sensor_data->fd = open("/dev/input/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (sensor_data->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    sensor_data->spi_fd = ioctl(sensor_data->fd, SPI_IOC_GET_ID, 0);
    if (sensor_data->spi_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get SPI device ID");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(sensor_data->spi_fd, SPI_IOC_SET_CS_MODE, MCP3008_CHIP_ENABLE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI chip enable mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    sensor_data->csv_fd = open("sensor_data.csv", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT, 0644);
    if (sensor_data->csv_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open CSV file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_analog_values(SensorData *sensor_data, int channel) {
    unsigned char buffer[3];
    int n = 0;
    buffer[0] = 0x40 | (channel & 0x03);
    buffer[1] = 0;
    buffer[2] = 0;
    if (write(sensor_data->spi_fd, buffer, 3) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write SPI command");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (read(sensor_data->spi_fd, buffer, 3) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI response");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    sensor_data->timestamp.tv_sec = buffer[0] << 16 | buffer[1] << 8 | buffer[2];
    sensor_data->timestamp.tv_usec = (buffer[0] & 0xFF) << 16;
    int value = (buffer[1] << 8) | buffer[2];
    double voltage = (value * 3.3) / 1024.0;
    printf("%ld.%06ld,%f,%f,%f\n", sensor_data->timestamp.tv_sec, sensor_data->timestamp.tv_usec, voltage, voltage, voltage);
    if (fputs("%ld.%06ld,%f,%f,%f\n", &sensor_data->timestamp, &sensor_data->timestamp.tv_usec, voltage, voltage, voltage, sensor_data->csv_fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to CSV file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup(SensorData *sensor_data) {
    if (sensor_data->csv_fd > 0) {
        close(sensor_data->csv_fd);
    }
    if (sensor_data->spi_fd > 0) {
        close(sensor_data->spi_fd);
    }
    if (sensor_data->fd > 0) {
        close(sensor_data->fd);
    }
}

void signal_handler(int sig) {
    cleanup(&sensor_data);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    SensorData sensor_data;
    init_sensor_data(&sensor_data);
    init_spi(sensor_data.spi_fd);
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);
    while (1) {
        gettimeofday(&sensor_data.timestamp, NULL);
        read_analog_values(&sensor_data, 0);
        read_analog_values(&sensor_data, 1);
        read_analog_values(&sensor_data, 2);
        sleep(5);
    }
    return 0;
}

    struct i2c_msg i2c_msg;
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data i2c_rdwr_data;
    int spi_fd, i2c_fd;
    int sound_level, light_level;
    int error_code = 0;
    SensorData data;
    time_t timestamp;
    char buffer[128];

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    if ((spi_fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c‑1", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE1, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MOSI, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI MOSI mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MISO, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI MISO mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_LSB_FIRST, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI LSB first mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPEED_hz, 1000000) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI speed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SPEED_hz, &speed) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI speed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    spi_transfer.ioctl = SPI_IOC_TRANSFER;
    spi_transfer.buffer = (unsigned char *)malloc(3 * 8);
    spi_transfer.len = 3 * 8;
    spi_transfer.delay_usecs = 1000;

    i2c_msg.addr = BH1750_I2C_ADDR;
    i2c_msg.flags = I2C_MSG_READ | I2C_MSG_REPEATED_START;
    i2c_msg.data[0] = 0x00;
    i2c_msg.data[1] = 0x00;

    i2c_rdwr_data.msgs = &i2c_msg;
    i2c_rdwr_data.nummsgs = 1;

    while (1) {
        timestamp = time(NULL);
        data.timestamp = timestamp;

        if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA0, &sound_level) < 0) {
            error_code = 1;
        } else {
            data.sound_level_db = (float)sound_level * 0.5 / 1024.0;
            if (data.sound_level_db < SOUND_LEVEL_DB_MIN || data.sound_level_db > SOUND_LEVEL_DB_MAX) {
                error_code = 2;
            }
        }

        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &i2c_rdwr_data) < 0) {
            error_code = 3;
        } else {
            if (i2c_msg.flags & I2C_MSG_REPEATED_START) {
                i2c_msg.flags &= ~I2C_MSG_REPEATED_START;
            }
            if (read(i2c_fd, buffer, 2) < 0) {
                error_code = 4;
            } else {
                light_level = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
                data.light_level_lux = (float)light_level / 10.0;
                if (data.light_level_lux < LIGHT_LEVEL_LUX_MIN || data.light_level_lux > LIGHT_LEVEL_LUX_MAX) {
                    error_code = 5;
                }
            }
        }

        log_sensor_data(&data);

        sleep(5);
    }

    free(spi_transfer.buffer);
    close(spi_fd);
    close(i2c_fd);
    return 0;
}

typedef struct {
    int distance;
    int volume;
} ThereminConfig;

int i2c_open(const char *dev, int addr) {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data data;
    int fd, err;

    fd = open(dev, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return -1;
    }

    data.addr = addr;
    msg[0].addr = addr;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_RDWR;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x00;
    msg[0].len = 1;

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, (unsigned long)&data, (unsigned long)&msg) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    return fd;
}

int spi_open(const char *dev, int addr, int mode) {
    struct spi_ioc_transfer transfer;
    int fd, err;

    fd = open(dev, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        return -1;
    }

    transfer.multiple = 0;
    transfer.len = 1;
    transfer.addr = addr;
    transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    transfer.speed_hz = 1000000;
    transfer.transfer_type = SPI_WRITE;
    transfer.data_size = 1;
    transfer.data = (unsigned char *)(&mode);

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &transfer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    return fd;
}

int pwm_open(const char *dev) {
    int fd;

    fd = open(dev, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open PWM device");
        return -1;
    }

    return fd;
}

int gpio_open(int pin) {
    int fd;

    fd = open("/sys/class/gpio/gpio" STR(pin), O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device");
        return -1;
    }

    return fd;
}

int spi_read(int spi_fd, unsigned char *buf, int len) {
    struct spi_ioc_transfer transfer;
    int err;

    transfer.multiple = 0;
    transfer.len = len;
    transfer.addr = 0x48; // MCP3008 I2C address
    transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    transfer.speed_hz = 1000000;
    transfer.transfer_type = SPI_READ;
    transfer.data_size = len;
    transfer.data = buf;

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &transfer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI device");
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int gpio_read(int fd, int pin) {
    char buf[3];
    int err;

    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "/sys/class/gpio/gpio%d/value", pin);
    err = access(buf, R_OK);
    if (err == -1) {
        perror("Failed to read GPIO value");
        return -1;
    }

    return atoi(buf);
}

    int start_time, end_time, distance;

    gpio_write(trig, 1);

    end_time = time(NULL);
    distance = (end_time - start_time) * 17150 / 1000000.0;
    return (int)distance;

    ret = pwm_set_range(GPIO_M1_EN, 0, MAX_SPEED);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM range for M1_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_range(GPIO_M2_EN, 0, MAX_SPEED);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM range for M2_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_clock(GPIO_M1_EN, 1000000);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM clock for M1_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_clock(GPIO_M2_EN, 1000000);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM clock for M2_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void init_motor(int potentiometer) {
    int ret;

    ret = i2c_open(0, 0x48, &motors[potentiometer].fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = i2c_read_byte_data(motors[potentiometer].fd, 0x00);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    motors[potentiometer].speed = 0;
    motors[potentiometer].potentiometer = potentiometer;
}

void read_potentiometer(int potentiometer) {
    int ret;

    ret = i2c_read_byte_data(motors[potentiometer].fd, 0x00);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    motors[potentiometer].speed = (int)(motors[potentiometer].value * MAX_SPEED / 1024);
}

void set_motor_speed(int potentiometer, int speed) {
    int ret;

    ret = i2c_write_byte_data(motors[potentiometer].fd, 0x00, 0x00);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = i2c_write_byte_data(motors[potentiometer].fd, 0x00, 0x40 | (speed & 0xFF));
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void set_motor_direction(int potentiometer, int direction) {
    int ret;

    ret = i2c_write_byte_data(motors[potentiometer].fd, 0x00, 0x00);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = i2c_write_byte_data(motors[potentiometer].fd, 0x00, 0x80 | (direction & 0x01));
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup_motor(int potentiometer) {
    int ret;

    ret = i2c_close(motors[potentiometer].fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup_gpio(void) {
    int ret;

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_MOSI);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO MOSI");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_MISO);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO MISO");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_SCLK);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO SCLK");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_CE);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO CE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_M1_EN);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO M1_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_M2_EN);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO M2_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_M1_DIR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO M1_DIR");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpio_unexport(GPIO_M2_DIR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to unexport GPIO M2_DIR");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup_pwm(void) {
    int ret;

    ret = pwm_set_mode(GPIO_M1_EN, PWM_OFF);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM mode for M1_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_mode(GPIO_M2_EN, PWM_OFF);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM mode for M2_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_range(GPIO_M1_EN, 0, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM range for M1_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_range(GPIO_M2_EN, 0, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM range for M2_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_clock(GPIO_M1_EN, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM clock for M1_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = pwm_set_clock(GPIO_M2_EN, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM clock for M2_EN");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup_spi(void) {
    int ret;

    ret = close(open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR));
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup(void) {
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_POTENTIOMETERS; i++) {
        cleanup_motor(i);
    }

    cleanup_gpio();
    cleanup_pwm();
    cleanup_spi();
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

        printf("Error initializing SPI slave select delay.\n");

    ret = wiringPiSPISetUp(0, 5000000, 8);
    if (ret < 0) {
        printf("Error initializing SPI setup.\n");
        return -1;

        printf("Error creating SPI handle.\n");
        return -1;
    }

}

int calibrate() {

int main() {

    if (init_spi() < 0) {
        printf("SPI initialization failed.\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (init_i2c() < 0) {
        printf("I2C initialization failed.\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (init_gpio() < 0) {
        printf("GPIO initialization failed.\n");
        return 1;
    }
    calibrated_baseline = 0;
    threshold = 0;
    calibrate();
    printf("Calibrated baseline: %d\n", calibrated_baseline);
    printf("Threshold: %d\n", threshold);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_CS 0
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_BITS 8
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_TIMEOUT 1000

#define CALIBRATION_FILE "calibration.txt"
#define LOG_FILE "airflow_log.txt"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi;
    struct gpiod_handle handle;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
} spi_config;

static spi_config config;

static int spi_open() {
    int ret;
    config.fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (config.fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return -1;
    }

    ret = ioctl(config.fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return -1;
    }

    ret = ioctl(config.fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BITS_PER_LINE, SPI_BITS);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return -1;
    }

    ret = ioctl(config.fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPEED_hz, SPI_SPEED);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int spi_close() {
    if (config.fd > 0) {
        close(config.fd);
    }
    return 0;
}

static int spi_init() {
    int ret;

    ret = spi_open();
    if (ret < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    config.line = gpiod_new_line(gpiod_new_line_request());
    if (config.line == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_new_line");
        return -1;
    }

    ret = gpiod_request_edge(config.line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, GPIOD_EDGE_TRIGGER_RISING);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_request_edge");
        return -1;
    }

    ret = gpiod_request_line(config.line, config.fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_request_line");
        return -1;
    }

    config.handle = gpiod_open(config.line);
    if (config.handle < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_open");
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static void spi_cleanup() {
    if (config.handle > 0) {
        gpiod_close(config.handle);
    }

    if (config.line) {
        gpiod_free_line(config.line);
    }

    if (config.fd > 0) {
        spi_close();
    }
}

static int calibrate() {
    FILE *fp;
    char line[256];
    int calib[2];

    fp = fopen(CALIBRATION_FILE, "r");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return -1;
    }

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp)) {
        if (sscanf(line, "%d %d", &calib[0], &calib[1]) == 2) {
            break;
        }
    }

    fclose(fp);

    if (calib[0] < 0 || calib[1] < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int read_adc() {
    int ret;
    unsigned char buffer[3];
    struct spi_ioc_transfer transfer;

    memset(&transfer, 0, sizeof(transfer));
    transfer.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&buffer;
    transfer.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&buffer;
    transfer.cs = SPI_CS;
    transfer.len = 3;
    transfer.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    transfer.delay_us = SPI_TIMEOUT;
    transfer.use_spi_buf = 0;

    ret = ioctl(config.fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &transfer);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return -1;
    }

    if (buffer[0] & 0x80) {
        return -1;
    }

    return (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
}

static double convert_to_airflow(int adc_value) {
    double airflow;
    FILE *fp;
    char line[256];
    int calib[2];

    fp = fopen(CALIBRATION_FILE, "r");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return -1;
    }

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp)) {
        if (sscanf(line, "%d %d", &calib[0], &calib[1]) == 2) {
            break;
        }
    }

    fclose(fp);

    if (calib[0] < 0 || calib[1] < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    airflow = (double)adc_value * (calib[1] - calib[0]) / 1024.0 + calib[0];
    return airflow;
}

static void log_reading(double airflow) {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];

    rawtime = time(NULL);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);

    fprintf(stderr, "%s, %f\n", buffer, airflow);
    fprintf(stdout, "%s, %f\n", buffer, airflow);

    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return;
    }

    fprintf(stdout, "%s\n", buffer);
    fprintf(stdout, "%f\n", airflow);
    fprintf(stdout, "\n");

    if (fputs(buffer, fopen(LOG_FILE, "a")) < 0) {
        perror("fputs");
        return;
    }

    if (fputs("%f\n", fopen(LOG_FILE, "a")) < 0) {
        perror("fputs");
        return;
    }

    fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a"));
}

static void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (config.handle > 0) {
        gpiod_close(config.handle);
    }

    if (config.line) {
        gpiod_free_line(config.line);
    }

    if (config.fd > 0) {
        spi_close();
    }

    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

static void main_loop() {
    double airflow;
    int adc_value;

    while (1) {
        adc_value = read_adc();
        if (adc_value < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: ADC read failed\n");
            log_reading(-1.0);
            continue;
        }

        airflow = convert_to_airflow(adc_value);
        if (airflow < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: Calibration file not found\n");
            log_reading(-1.0);
            continue;
        }

        log_reading(airflow);

        sleep(100);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    if (calibrate() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: Calibration file not found\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (spi_init() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: SPI initialization failed\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    main_loop();

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

int spi_init() {
    int fd;
    if ((fd = open(SPI_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    return fd;
}

int spi_read_adc(int fd) {
    mcp3008_data_t data;
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, MCP3008_REG_DOUT, &data) < 0) {

        return -1;
    }

}

        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }

    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[80];

    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);

    fprintf(file, "%s %f %d\n", buffer, voltage, ppm);
    fclose(file);
}

        perror("Failed to set SIGINT handler");
        return 1;
    }

    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    int ppm;

        if (voltage < 0) {

        printf("%s\n", buffer);

        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

    close(spi_fd);
    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO4 4
#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO27 27
#define ADC_HIGH 3.3
#define ADC_LOW 0.0
#define MAX_MILLITESLA 100
#define MIN_MILLITESLA -100

typedef struct {
    int sensor1;
    int sensor2;
    int sensor3;
} SensorValues;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    gpiod_stop();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct gpiod_handle handle;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    int fd;
    char filename[] = "magnetic_log.txt";
    char line[128];
    SensorValues values;
    int i;

    // Initialize GPIO
    if (gpiod_init(&handle) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error initializing GPIO: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Create lines for GPIO4, GPIO17, GPIO27
    if (gpiod_request_line(&handle, GPIO4, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT, &line) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating GPIO4 line: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (gpiod_request_line(&handle, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT, &line) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating GPIO17 line: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (gpiod_request_line(&handle, GPIO27, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT, &line) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating GPIO27 line: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Create edges for each line
    if (gpiod_request_edge(&handle, line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &edge) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating edge for GPIO4: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (gpiod_request_edge(&handle, line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &edge) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating edge for GPIO17: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (gpiod_request_edge(&handle, line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &edge) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error creating edge for GPIO27: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Create events for each edge
    for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (gpiod_request_event(&handle, edge, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &event) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error creating event for GPIO%d: %s\n", GPIO4 + i, gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
            gpiod_destroy(&handle);
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }

    // Set callback function for events
    gpiod_set_callback(&handle, event, (void (*)(void))handle_event, NULL);

    // Open file for writing
    fd = open(filename, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error opening file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        gpiod_destroy(&handle);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set signal handler for SIGINT
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        // Read GPIO states
        if (gpiod_get_value(&handle, line) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading GPIO state: %s\n", gpiod_strerror(handle.err));
            continue;
        }

        // Simulate ADC
        values.sensor1 = (gpiod_get_value(&handle, line) ? ADC_HIGH : ADC_LOW);
        values.sensor2 = (gpiod_get_value(&handle, line) ? ADC_HIGH : ADC_LOW);
        values.sensor3 = (gpiod_get_value(&handle, line) ? ADC_HIGH : ADC_LOW);

        // Convert to magnetic field strength
        values.sensor1_mT = (values.sensor1 == ADC_HIGH) ? 3.3 : 0.0;
        values.sensor2_mT = (values.sensor2 == ADC_HIGH) ? 3.3 : 0.0;
        values.sensor3_mT = (values.sensor3 == ADC_HIGH) ? 3.3 : 0.0;

        // Check for out-of-range values
        if (values.sensor1_mT > MAX_MILLITESLA || values.sensor1_mT < MIN_MILLITESLA) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Warning: sensor1_mT = %f is out of range\n", values.sensor1_mT);
        }
        if (values.sensor2_mT > MAX_MILLITESLA || values.sensor2_mT < MIN_MILLITESLA) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Warning: sensor2_mT = %f is out of range\n", values.sensor2_mT);
        }
        if (values.sensor3_mT > MAX_MILLITESLA || values.sensor3_mT < MIN_MILLITESLA) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Warning: sensor3_mT = %f is out of range\n", values.sensor3_mT);
        }

        // Log values
        snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%f,%f,%f", values.sensor1_mT, values.sensor2_mT, values.sensor3_mT);
        if (write(fd, line, strlen(line)) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error writing to file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        } else {
            fflush(fd);
        }

        // Wait 100ms
        usleep(100000);
    }

    // Graceful shutdown
    gpiod_stop();
    close(fd);
    gpiod_destroy(&handle);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

        if (creat(csv_filename, 0644) < 0) {
            perror("Error creating CSV file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    // Install SIGINT handler
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read from SPI channels
        if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA, &spi_transfer) < 0) {
            perror("Error reading SPI data");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA, &spi_transfer2) < 0) {
            perror("Error reading SPI data");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        // Log readings to CSV file
        char line[MAX_LINE_LENGTH];
        snprintf(line, MAX_LINE_LENGTH, "%f,%f,%f\n", spi_buf[0], spi_buf[1], spi_buf[2]);
        if (write(spi_fd, line, strlen(line)) < 0) {
            perror("Error writing to CSV file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        // Sleep for 1 second
        usleep(1000000);
    }

    return 0;
}

    // Request the event line
    if (gpiod_request_event(line_fd, info.line, EVENT_LINE, &req) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request event line");
        gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
        gpiod_close_fd(fd);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Open the log file
    if ((ret = open(LOG_FILE, LOG_FILE_MODE)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
        gpiod_close_fd(fd);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    while (!shutdown_flag) {
        // Wait for an event
        if (gpiod_wait_event(line_fd, &event) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to wait for event");
            gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
            gpiod_close_fd(fd);
            close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        // Read the event
        if (gpiod_get_event(event, &req) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read event");
            gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
            gpiod_close_fd(fd);
            close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        // Read the event value
        if (gpiod_get_value(event, &info.value) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read event value");
            gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
            gpiod_close_fd(fd);
            close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check if the event is a falling edge
        if (info.value == 0) {
            // Get the current time
            clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

            // Format the timestamp
            char timestamp[20];
            snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%ld.%09ld", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);

            // Append the timestamped message to the log file
            if (write(ret, timestamp, strlen(timestamp)) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to write to log file");
                close(ret);
                gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
                gpiod_close_fd(fd);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }

            // Append the event message to the log file
            if (write(ret, "Falling edge detected\n", 18) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to write to log file");
                close(ret);
                gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
                gpiod_close_fd(fd);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }

            // Print the event message to stdout
            printf("Falling edge detected\n");

            // Shutdown the system
            system("sudo shutdown -h now");

            // Clear the event
            if (gpiod_clear_event(event) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to clear event");
                gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
                gpiod_close_fd(fd);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }
        }

        // Free the event
        gpiod_free_event(event);
    }

    // Close the GPIO line
    if (gpiod_close_line(line_fd, info.line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close GPIO line");
        gpiod_close_chip(line_fd);
        gpiod_close_fd(fd);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Close the GPIO chip
    if (gpiod_close_chip(line_fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close GPIO chip");
        gpiod_close_fd(fd);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Close the GPIO file descriptor
    if (close(fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close GPIO file descriptor");
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

    msg[0].addr = BH1750_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_MSG_READ;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x00;
    rdwr_msg.msgs = msg;
    rdwr_msg.nummsgs = 1;
    rdwr_msg.control = I2C_RWRANDWR | I2C_RDSMB;
    ioctl(handle->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &rdwr_msg);
    *lux = *((float *)&msg[0].data[0]);
}

    struct spi_ioc_transfer transfer;

    transfer.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    transfer.bits_per_line = SPI_BITS;
    transfer.mode = SPI_MODE_0;

#define CSV_FILE "flame_events.log"
#define LOG_FORMAT "%s,%d,%d"

    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    struct pollfd pollfd;
    char timestamp[128];
    char buffer[1024];

    // Initialize GPIO
    fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open /dev/gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        close(fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Find the GPIO line
    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO_PIN);
    if (!line) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set the line to input mode with pull-down resistor
    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_mode");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set the line to pull-down
    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line, GPIOD_PULL_DOWN) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_pull");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Create an edge for the line
    edge = gpiod_line_create_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (!edge) {
        perror("gpiod_line_create_edge");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Create an event for the edge
    event = gpiod_edge_create_event(edge, 0);
    if (!event) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_create_event");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set the event to trigger on the line's state change
    if (gpiod_event_set(line, event, GPIOD_EVENT_EDGE_CHANGE) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_event_set");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open the CSV file for writing
    fp = fopen(CSV_FILE, "w");
    if (!fp) {
        perror("fopen");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Initialize the pollfd structure
    pollfd.fd = fileno(fd);
    pollfd.events = POLLIN;
    pollfd.revents = 0;

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Poll the GPIO line
        if (poll(&pollfd, 1, -1) < 0) {
            perror("poll");
            close(fd);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(fp);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        if (gpiod_line_get_value(line) == 1) {
            // Record the timestamp
            struct timeval tv;
            gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
            sprintf(timestamp, "%ld.%06ld", tv.tv_sec, tv.tv_usec);
            fprintf(fp, LOG_FORMAT, tv.tv_sec, GPIO_PIN, 1);
            printf("Flame detected at %s\n", timestamp);
        } else {
            fprintf(fp, LOG_FORMAT, tv.tv_sec, GPIO_PIN, 0);
        }

        // Sleep for 1 second
        if (sleep(1) < 0) {
            perror("sleep");
            close(fd);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(fp);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    // Cleanup GPIO resources
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    close(fd);
    fclose(fp);

    return 0;
