#define SPI_BAUD 1000000
#define MCP3008_CHANNEL 0
#define READ_DELAY 60
#define MIN_ADC 300
#define MAX_ADC 800
#define LOG_FILE "soil_moisture_log.csv"
#define SIGINT 2

volatile sig_atomic_t sigint_received = 0;

void signal_handler(int signal) {
    if (signal == SIGINT) {
        spi_close();
        driver_close();
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);

    spi_config_t config = {
        .channel = SPI_CHANNEL,
        .baud = SPI_BAUD,
        .mcp3008_channel = MCP3008_CHANNEL
    };

    if (!spi_setup(config)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "SPI setup failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file\n");
        return 1;
    }

    while (!sigint_received) {
        int adc_value = read_mcp3008(MCP3008_CHANNEL);
        if (adc_value < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer failed\n");
            usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
            continue;
        }

        double moisture_level = calculate_moisture_level(adc_value);
        log_data(moisture_level, log_file);
        printf("%.2f%%\n", moisture_level);

        usleep(60000000); // 60 seconds delay
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;

int read_mcp3008(int channel) {
    int fd;
    if ((fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open SPI device\n");
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE0) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to set SPI mode\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BIT, SPI_BIT0) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to set SPI bit\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPEED_hz, SPI_BAUD) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to set SPI speed\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, &SPI_MODE0) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read SPI mode\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BIT, &SPI_BIT0) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read SPI bit\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SPEED_hz, &SPI_BAUD) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read SPI speed\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    uint16_t data;
    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_READ, MCP3008_CHANNEL, &data) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer failed\n");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    close(fd);
    return data;
}

double calculate_moisture_level(int adc_value) {

}

    strftime(buffer, 100, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time_info);
    fprintf(log_file, "%s,%.2f\n", buffer, moisture_level);

        close(fd);

        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to set SPI speed\n");
        close(fd);
        return 0;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, &SPI_MODE0) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read SPI mode\n");
        close(fd);

    }

    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BIT, &SPI_BIT0) < 0) {

        close(fd);
        return 0;
    }

    if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, &buf) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_DQBUF");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    cam->buffer = mmap(NULL, buf.maj.minor, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, cam->fd, buf.maj.minor);
    if (cam->buffer == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("mmap");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/videodev2.h>

#define CSI_DEVICE "/dev/video0"

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct v4l2_capability cap;
    struct v4l2_frmsizeTypeDef frmsize;
    struct v4l2_frameintTypeDef frameint;
    struct v4l2_control ctrl;
    int cap_ok = 0, frmsize_ok = 0, frameint_ok = 0, focus_ok = 0;

    fd = open(CSI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open device");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCAP, &cap) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to query capabilities");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    cap_ok = cap.capabilities & V4L2_CAP_VIDEO_CAPTURE;

    if (!cap_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Device does not support video capture\n");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&frmsize, 0, sizeof(frmsize));
    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_ENUM_FRMSIZES, &frmsize) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to enumerate frame sizes");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    frmsize_ok = frmsize.nfrbits > 0;

    if (!frmsize_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "No supported frame sizes\n");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < frmsize.nfrbits; i++) {
        struct v4l2_frmsize frmsize_i;
        memset(&frmsize_i, 0, sizeof(frmsize_i));
        frmsize_i.nfrbits = i;
        if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_ENUM_FRMSIZES, &frmsize_i) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to enumerate frame size");
            close(fd);
            return 1;
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "Frame size: %d bits\n", frmsize_i.nfrbits);
        for (int j = 0; j < frmsize_i.nfrbits; j++) {
            struct v4l2_frameint frmsize_i_j;
            memset(&frmsize_i_j, 0, sizeof(frmsize_i_j));
            frmsize_i_j.nfrbits = j;
            if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_ENUM_FRAMEINTERVALS, &frmsize_i_j) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to enumerate frame intervals");
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "Frame size %d bits, frame intervals:\n", frmsize_i_j.nfrbits);
            for (int k = 0; k < frmsize_i_j.nfrbits; k++) {
                struct v4l2_frameint frmsize_i_j_k;
                memset(&frmsize_i_j_k, 0, sizeof(frmsize_i_j_k));
                frmsize_i_j_k.nfrbits = k;
                if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_ENUM_FRAMEINTERVALS, &frmsize_i_j_k) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to enumerate frame intervals");
                    close(fd);
                    return 1;
                }
                fprintf(stderr, "  %d Hz\n", frmsize_i_j_k.framerate);
            }
        }
    }

    memset(&ctrl, 0, sizeof(ctrl));
    ctrl.index = VIDIOC_CID_FOCUS_AUTO;
    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCTRL, &ctrl) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to query focus control");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    focus_ok = ctrl.flags & V4L2_CTRL_FLAG_HAS_VALUE;

    if (!focus_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Focus control is not supported\n");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl VIDIOC_SELECTBUFS");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

        // Stop streaming
        ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_STREAMON, &buf);
        munmap(buf_ptr, buf.maj.minpels * sizeof(uint8_t));
        close(fd);
        fclose(fp);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    });

    FD_ZERO(&readfds);
    FD_SET(fd, &readfds);

    struct timeval tv;
    tv.tv_sec = CAPTURE_TIMEOUT;
    tv.tv_usec = 0;

    while (1) {
        ret = select(fd + 1, &readfds, NULL, NULL, &tv);
        if (ret == -1) {
            perror("select");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        } else if (ret == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Timeout\n");
            ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_STREAMON, &buf);
            munmap(buf_ptr, buf.maj.minpels * sizeof(uint8_t));
            close(fd);
            fclose(fp);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        ret = ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QBUF, &buf);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("ioctl VIDIOC_QBUF");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        ret = ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, &buf);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("ioctl VIDIOC_DQBUF");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (ret == 0) {
            continue;
        }

        // Check the returned width, height and pixel format
        ret = ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_G_FMT, &fmt);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("ioctl VIDIOC_G_FMT");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (fmt.fmt.pix.width != WIDTH || fmt.fmt.pix.height != HEIGHT || fmt.fmt.pix.pixelformat != V4L2_PIX_FMT_YUYV) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Mismatched format\n");
            ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_STREAMON, &buf);
            munmap(buf_ptr, buf.maj.minpels * sizeof(uint8_t));
            close(fd);
            fclose(fp);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        // Copy the complete YUYV macroblocks to avoid color corruption
        for (int i = 0; i < HEIGHT; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < WIDTH; j++) {
                buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2] = fmt.fmt.pix.y0[i * WIDTH + j];
                buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2 + 1] = fmt.fmt.pix.u[i * WIDTH + j];
                buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2 + 2] = fmt.fmt.pix.y1[i * WIDTH + j];
                buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2 + 3] = fmt.fmt.pix.v[i * WIDTH + j];
            }
        }

        // Crop a 200 × 150 region
        for (int i = 0; i < HEIGHT; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < WIDTH; j++) {
                if (i >= 50 && i < 150 && j >= 0 && j < 200) {
                    buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2] = fmt.fmt.pix.y0[i * WIDTH + j];
                    buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2 + 1] = fmt.fmt.pix.u[i * WIDTH + j];
                    buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2 + 2] = fmt.fmt.pix.y1[i * WIDTH + j];
                    buf_ptr[j * 2 + i * WIDTH * 2 + 3] = fmt.fmt.pix.v[i * WIDTH + j];
                }
            }
        }

        // Write the cropped YUYV macroblocks to the file
        ret = fwrite(buf_ptr, FRAMESIZE, 1, fp);
        if (ret != 1) {
            perror("fwrite");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        // Check the return value of fwrite
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("fwrite");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

typedef struct {

    int i2c_fd;
    Si1145Data data;
} Si1145Handler;

static void sigint_handler(int signum) {
    if (Si1145Handler::instance->fd > 0) {
        close(Si1145Handler::instance->fd);
    }
    if (Si1145Handler::instance->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(Si1145Handler::instance->i2c_fd);
    }
    Si1145Handler::instance->data.proximity = 0;
    Si1145Handler::instance->data.ambient_light = 0;
    Si1145Handler::instance->sensor_api_call();
    exit(0);
}

static Si1145Handler* Si1145Handler::instance = NULL;

Si1145Handler* Si1145Handler::getInstance() {
    if (!instance) {
        instance = (Si1145Handler*)malloc(sizeof(Si1145Handler));
        if (!instance) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Memory allocation failed\n");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        instance->fd = -1;
        instance->i2c_fd = -1;
        instance->sensor_api_call = Si1145Handler::sensor_api_call;
        signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);
    }
    return instance;

void Si1145Handler::sensor_api_call() {
    if (instance->fd > 0) {
        munmap(instance->buffer, 1024);
    }
    instance->fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (instance->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(instance->fd, I2C_SLAVE, SI1145_PART_ID) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    instance->i2c_fd = instance->fd;
    instance->buffer = mmap(0, 1024, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, instance->fd, 0);
    if (instance->buffer == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("Failed to mmap I2C buffer");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    instance->data.proximity = *(uint32_t*)(instance->buffer + 0x00);
    instance->data.ambient_light = *(uint16_t*)(instance->buffer + 0x18);

    if (instance->i2c_fd > 0) {

#include <time.h>

#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/i2c.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define I2C_BUS "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x10
#define PROXIMITY_REG 0x00
#define PROXIMITY_DATA_REG 0x01
#define PROXIMITY_REG_SIZE 2
#define PROXIMITY_DATA_REG_SIZE 2
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 100
#define CSV_FILE "heartrate.csv"

volatile bool running = true;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    running = false;
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    int i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_device_t *device = gpiod_open(NULL);
    if (!device) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod device");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_chip_t *chip = gpiod_chip_get(device);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to get gpiod chip");
        close(i2c_fd);
        gpiod_close(device);
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_line_t *line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, 0);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to get gpiod line");
        close(i2c_fd);
        gpiod_close(device);
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_line_request_t request;
    request.line = line;
    request.request = GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_I2C;
    if (gpiod_chip_request(chip, &request) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request I2C line");
        close(i2c_fd);
        gpiod_close(device);
        return 1;
    }

    struct i2c_smbus_ioctl_data data;
    data.i2c_smbus_cmd = I2C_SMBUS_READ;
    data.i2c_smbus_data_size = PROXIMITY_REG_SIZE + PROXIMITY_DATA_REG_SIZE;
    data.i2c_smbus_read_address = I2C_ADDR;
    data.i2c_smbus_read_offset = PROXIMITY_REG;
    data.i2c_smbus_read_count = PROXIMITY_REG_SIZE + PROXIMITY_DATA_REG_SIZE;

    while (running) {
        struct timespec ts;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        char timestamp[64];
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%03d", &ts);
        fprintf(stderr, "Writing to CSV: %s\n", timestamp);

        if (gpiod_chip_request(chip, &data) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to request I2C read");
            continue;
        }

        uint8_t buffer[PROXIMITY_REG_SIZE + PROXIMITY_DATA_REG_SIZE];
        ssize_t bytes_read = gpiod_chip_read(chip, &data, buffer, PROXIMITY_REG_SIZE + PROXIMITY_DATA_REG_SIZE);
        if (bytes_read < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading I2C data: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            continue;
        }

        uint16_t proximity = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
        uint16_t data = (buffer[2] << 8) | buffer[3];

        uint32_t bpm = 60000.0 / ((double)SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS * (double)bytes_read / 2.0) * (double)proximity / 100.0;
        if (bpm < 1) {
            bpm = 1;
        }

        FILE *csv = fopen(CSV_FILE, "a");
        if (!csv) {
            perror("Failed to open CSV file");
            continue;
        }

        fprintf(csv, "%s,%d\n", timestamp, (int)bpm);
        fflush(csv);
        fclose(csv);

        usleep(SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);
    }

    gpiod_chip_release(chip);
    gpiod_close(device);
    close(i2c_fd);

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x60
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_DELAY 50
#define I2C_SAMPLE_DELAY 200
#define I2C_LOG_FILE "distance_log.txt"

#define BUFFER_SIZE 256

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int i2c_err;
    int log_fd;
    char timestamp[BUFFER_SIZE];
} TDKCH101;

void init_driver(TDKCH101 *ctx) {
    ctx->fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (ctx->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ctx->i2c_fd = ioctl(ctx->fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (ctx->i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ctx->log_fd = open(I2C_LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (ctx->log_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        close(ctx->fd);
        close(ctx->i2c_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void close_driver(TDKCH101 *ctx) {
    close(ctx->fd);
    close(ctx->i2c_fd);
    close(ctx->log_fd);
}

void read_distance(TDKCH101 *ctx) {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdma_msg msg_rdma[1];
    struct i2c_err err;

    memset(msg, 0, sizeof(msg));
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x00;

    memset(msg_rdma, 0, sizeof(msg_rdma));
    msg_rdma[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg_rdma[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg_rdma[0].data[0] = 0x00;

    if (ioctl(ctx->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, msg) < 0) {
        ctx->i2c_err = errno;
        return;
    }

    if (ioctl(ctx->i2c_fd, I2C_RDMA_RDWR, msg_rdma) < 0) {
        ctx->i2c_err = errno;
        return;
    }

    if (msg[0].data[0] == 0x00) {
        ctx->i2c_err = 0;
    } else {
        ctx->i2c_err = 1;
    }

    if (ctx->i2c_err) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", ctx->i2c_err);
        return;
    }

    // Calculate distance
    int distance_mm = 1000 * (msg[0].data[0] & 0xFF) / 0x80;
    snprintf(ctx->timestamp, BUFFER_SIZE, "%s %s", "2023-", ctime(&time(NULL)));
    fprintf(ctx->log_fd, "%s, %d\n", ctx->timestamp, distance_mm);
    fprintf(stdout, "%s, %d\n", ctx->timestamp, distance_mm);
}

int main() {
    TDKCH101 ctx;
    init_driver(&ctx);

    while (1) {
        read_distance(&ctx);
        if (ctx.i2c_err) {
            continue;
        }

        usleep(I2C_SAMPLE_DELAY);
    }

    close_driver(&ctx);
    return 0;
}

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO18 18
#define FILENAME "obstacle_log.txt"
#define LOG_INTERVAL 100000  // 100 milliseconds

int fd;
struct gpiod_chip *chip;
struct gpiod_line *line1, *line2;
struct gpiod_edge *edge1, *edge2;
struct gpiod_event *event1, *event2;
struct timespec ts;

void handle_error(const char *msg) {
    perror(msg);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT) {
        printf("Graceful shutdown initiated.\n");
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line1);
        gpiod_line_free(line2);
        gpiod_event_free(event1);
        gpiod_event_free(event2);
        close(fd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    fd = open(FILENAME, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (fd == -1) {
        handle_error("Failed to open log file");
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (chip == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to open gpiod device");
    }

    line1 = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO17);
    if (line1 == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to get GPIO line 17");
    }

    line2 = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO18);
    if (line2 == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to get GPIO line 18");
    }

    edge1 = gpiod_line_request_edge(line1, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge1 == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to request edge on GPIO line 17");
    }

    edge2 = gpiod_line_request_edge(line2, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge2 == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to request edge on GPIO line 18");
    }

    event1 = gpiod_edge_request_event(edge1, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 0);
    if (event1 == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to request event on GPIO line 17");
    }

    event2 = gpiod_edge_request_event(edge2, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 0);
    if (event2 == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to request event on GPIO line 18");
    }

    gpiod_chip_enable(chip, GPIOD_ENABLE_LINE | GPIOD_ENABLE_EDGE);
    gpiod_line_enable(line1);
    gpiod_line_enable(line2);

    while (1) {
        if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) == -1) {
            handle_error("Failed to get current time");
        }

        if (gpiod_edge_get_value(edge1) == 1) {
            fprintf(fd, "%ld,1\n", ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000);
        } else {
            fprintf(fd, "%ld,0\n", ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000);
        }

        if (gpiod_edge_get_value(edge2) == 1) {
            fprintf(fd, "%ld,1\n", ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000);
        } else {
            fprintf(fd, "%ld,0\n", ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000);
        }

        if (sleep(LOG_INTERVAL / 1000) == -1) {
            handle_error("Failed to sleep for 100 milliseconds");
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

            continue;
        }

        char buffer[128];
        strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&now));
        printf("%s Distance: %d mm\n", buffer, distance);
        fflush(stdout);
        last_print_time = now;
        usleep(I2C_POLL_INTERVAL * 1000);
    }

    cleanup();
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

    uint32_t time_of_flight;
    uint16_t ambient_light;
    uint8_t error_flags;
} OPT3101_DATA;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("Graceful shutdown initiated.\n");
    close(i2c_fd);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct iocb iocb;
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg rdwr_msg;
    OPT3101_DATA data;
    int i, ret;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    memset(&iocb, 0, sizeof(iocb));
    iocb.most recent message = I2C_MMR_NONE;
    iocb.ifachannel = i2c_fd;
    iocb.tx_buf = (unsigned char *)&data;
    iocb.rx_buf = (unsigned char *)&data;
    iocb.len = sizeof(data);
    iocb.flags = I2C_MMR_START | I2C_MMR_STOP;

    while (1) {
        msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[0].len = 1;
        msg[0].buf = (unsigned char *)&data;

        msg[0].len = 1;
        msg[0].buf = (unsigned char *)&data;

        ret = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, msg, &rdwr_msg);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read from I2C device");
            continue;
        }

        if (rdwr_msg.msgs[0].flags & I2C_M_RD) {
            data.time_of_flight = msg[0].buf[0];
            data.ambient_light = msg[0].buf[1];
            data.error_flags = msg[0].buf[2];
        }

        printf("Time of Flight: %u, Ambient Light: %u, Error Flags: %u\n", data.time_of_flight, data.ambient_light, data.error_flags);
        fflush(stdout);

        usleep(500000); // 500ms delay
    }

    close(i2c_fd);
    return 0;
}

static void handle_sigint(int signum) {

    if (handler.fd != -1) {
        close(handler.fd);
    }
    printf("Graceful shutdown initiated.\n");
    exit(0);
}

static void handle_sigterm(int signum) {

    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data data;
    data.msgs = msg;
    data.nmsgs = 1;
    data.flags = I2C_RDWR;

    fd = open(bus, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c bus");
        return -1;
    }

    msg[0].addr = addr;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    data.msgs[0] = msg[0];

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, &data) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c bus");
        return -1;
    }

    return fd;
}

static int i2c_read(int fd, int addr, char *buf, size_t len) {
    int status;
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data data;
    data.msgs = msg;
    data.nmsgs = 1;
    data.flags = I2C_M_RD;

    msg[0].addr = addr;
    msg[0].len = len;
    msg[0].buf = buf;

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, &data) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read from i2c bus");
        return -1;
    }

    status = I2C_SUCCESS;
    if (msg[0].status < 0) {
        status = msg[0].status;
    }

    return status;
}

    struct gpiod_chip *chip;

    status = gpiod_chip_open(fd, &chip);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open gpio chip");
        return -1;
    }

    status = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, line, &line_fd);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request gpio line");
        return -1;
    }

    return line_fd;
}

static int gpio_read(int line_fd) {
    int status;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    status = gpiod_line_get_fd(line_fd, &line);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get gpio line fd");
        return -1;

    status = read(line_fd, &status, sizeof(status));
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read gpio line");
        return -1;
    }

    return status;
}

static int gpio_write(int line_fd, int value) {
    int status;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    status = gpiod_line_get_fd(line_fd, &line);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get gpio line fd");
        return -1;
    }

    status = write(line_fd, &value, sizeof(value));
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to gpio line");
        return -1;
    }

    return status;
}

static int gpio_close(int line_fd) {
    int status;
    status = gpiod_line_release_fd(line_fd);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to release gpio line");
        return -1;
    }

    return status;
}

static int gpio_chip_close(struct gpiod_chip *chip) {
    int status;
    status = gpiod_chip_release(chip);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to release gpio chip");
        return -1;
    }

    return status;
}

static int gpio_bus_close(int fd) {
    int status;
    status = close(fd);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close gpio bus");
        return -1;
    }

    return status;
}

static int i2c_gpio_handler(I2CGPIOHandler *handler) {

    status = i2c_open(handler->fd, handler->i2c_addr);
    if (status < 0) {

            continue;

            continue;

        if (sensor_data.distance < 10.0) {
            gpioWrite(GPIO_PIN, 1);
        } else {
            gpioWrite(GPIO_PIN, 0);
        }

void handle_i2c_error(int fd, int err) {
    if (err == -EBUSY) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C bus is busy, retrying...\n");
        usleep(1000);
    } else if (err == -ENXIO) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C bus is not accessible, retrying...\n");
        usleep(1000);
    } else if (err == -EIO) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C bus error, retrying...\n");
        usleep(1000);
    } else {
        i2c_open_error(fd, err);
    }
}

    fprintf(stderr, "I2C timeout error: %s\n", strerror(err));
    close(fd);
}

    int err = -1;

} I2CHandle;

static void i2c_read(I2CHandle *handle, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < handle->i2c_retry; i++) {
        if (ioctl(handle->fd, I2C_SLAVE, handle->i2c_addr) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
            return;
        }
        if (write(handle->fd, buf, size) != size) {
            perror("write");
            return;
        }
        if (read(handle->fd, buf, size) < 0) {
            perror("read");
            return;
        }
        if (handle->i2c_timeout > 0) {
            handle->i2c_timeout--;
        }
        if (handle->i2c_timeout == 0) {
            return;
        }
    }
}

static void i2c_write(I2CHandle *handle, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < handle->i2c_retry; i++) {

    VL53L4X *sensor = (VL53L4X *)context;
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        close(sensor->i2c_fd);
        sensor->addr = NULL;
        sensor->fd = -1;
        sensor->i2c_fd = -1;
        ioctl(sensor->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, sensor->addr);
        sensor->libcleanup();
        exit(0);
    }
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ipc.h>
#include <sys/msg.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <linux/sched.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <wiringPi.h>
#include <wiringPiGpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS
#define GPIO_PIN 23
#define MSG_QUEUE_NAME "/msg_queue"
#define MSG_QUEUE_SIZE 1024
#define MSG_SIZE 128
#define MSG_TYPE 1
#define MSG_QUEUE_PERMISSIONS 0666

#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_RETRIES 3

#define BUZZER_ON 1
#define BUZZER_OFF 0

#define DISTANCE_THRESHOLD 100

typedef struct {
    long msg_type;
    double distance_mm;
} message_t;

static int i2c_fd;
static int msg_q_id;
static int buzzer_pin;

static void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("I2C error");
        close(i2c_fd);
        wiringPiGpioUnexport(buzzer_pin);
        if (msg_q_id > 0) {
            msgctl(msg_q_id, IPC_RMID, NULL);
        }
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    handle_i2c_error(ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0));
    wiringPiGpioUnexport(buzzer_pin);
    if (msg_q_id > 0) {
        msgctl(msg_q_id, IPC_RMID, NULL);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

static void init_i2c() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }
}

static void init_buzzer() {
    wiringPiSetupGpio();
    buzzer_pin = GPIO_PIN;
    wiringPiGpioExport(buzzer_pin);
    wiringPiGpioUnexport(buzzer_pin);
    wiringPiGpioSetMode(buzzer_pin, PI_OUTPUT);
}

static void init_message_queue() {
    if ((msg_q_id = msgget((key_t) ftok(MSG_QUEUE_NAME, 0), IPC_CREAT | IPC_EXCL | MSG_QUEUE_PERMISSIONS)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to create message queue");
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }
}

static void read_distance() {
    message_t msg;
    int err;

    if ((err = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &msg)) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(err);
    }

    if (msg.msg_type != MSG_TYPE) {
        perror("Invalid message type");
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }

    if (msg.distance_mm < DISTANCE_THRESHOLD) {
        printf("Distance: %.2f mm\n", msg.distance_mm);
        if (wiringPiGpioWrite(buzzer_pin, BUZZER_ON)) {
            printf("Buzzer activated\n");
        } else {
            printf("Failed to activate buzzer\n");
        }
    } else {
        printf("Distance: %.2f mm\n", msg.distance_mm);
    }
}

static void main_loop() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdma_msg rdma_msg[1];
    struct i2c_msg msg2[1];
    struct i2c_rdma_msg rdma_msg2[1];
    int err;

    init_i2c();
    init_buzzer();
    init_message_queue();

    while (1) {
        msg[0].addr = 0x29; // VL53L1X address
        msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[0].len = 0;
        rdma_msg[0].addr = 0x29;
        rdma_msg[0].flags = I2C_RDMA_RD;
        rdma_msg[0].len = 0;
        msg2[0].addr = 0x29;
        msg2[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg2[0].len = 0;
        rdma_msg2[0].addr = 0x29;
        rdma_msg2[0].flags = I2C_RDMA_RD;
        rdma_msg2[0].len = 0;

        err = i2c_rdma_write_read(i2c_fd, msg, rdma_msg, 1);
        if (err < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(err);
        }

        err = i2c_rdma_read(i2c_fd, msg2, rdma_msg2, 1);
        if (err < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(err);
        }

        read_distance();
        usleep(50000); // 50 ms delay
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    main_loop();

    return 0;
}

void *interrupt_handler(void *state) {
    ProximitySensorState *sensor = (ProximitySensorState *)state;
    while (sensor->running) {
        if (sensor->interrupt_flag) {
            sensor->interrupt_flag = 0;
            sensor->interrupt_data_flag = 1;
            int data = sensor->interrupt_data;
            struct timeval tv;
            gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
            char timestamp[256];
            strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), PROXIMITY_LOG_FORMAT, &tv);

                status[2] = 'F';

    return NULL;

    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

static void init_spi() {
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
    spi_transfer.msb = 0;
    spi_transfer.msb_offset = 0;
    spi_transfer.msb_count = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb_offset = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb_count = 0;
    spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    spi_transfer.delay = 0;
    spi_transfer.speed_hz = SPI_CLOCK;
    spi_transfer.use_spi_device = 1;
    spi_transfer.transfer_mode = SPI_MODE;
    spi_transfer.cs = SPI_CS;
    spi_transfer.cs_lines = SPI_CS_PIN;
    spi_transfer.cs_lines_count = 1;

    if ((SensorState.spi_fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to open SPI device");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to set SPI mode");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, SPI_CS) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to set SPI CS");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_CS, SPI_CS) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to read SPI CS");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BITS_PER_WORD, 16) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to set SPI bits per word");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MAX_SPEED_HZ, SPI_CLOCK) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to set SPI max speed");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MAX_SPEED_HZ, &SensorState.spi_max_speed) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to read SPI max speed");
    }
}

static void init_i2c() {
    if ((SensorState.i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to open I2C device");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to set I2C address");
    }
}

static void init_sensor() {
    if ((SensorState.sensor_fd = open("/dev/sensors", O_RDONLY)) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to open sensor device");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.sensor_fd, SIOCSGPIO, &SensorState.spi_cs) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to set GPIO CS");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.sensor_fd, SIOCGI2C, &SensorState.i2c_fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to get I2C device");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.sensor_fd, SIOCGSPI, &SensorState.spi_fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to get SPI device");
    }
    if (ioctl(SensorState.sensor_fd, SIOCGSENSOR, &SensorState.distance) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to get sensor distance");
    }
}

static void read_distance() {
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
    spi_transfer.msb = 0;
    spi_transfer.msb_offset = 0;
    spi_transfer.msb_count = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb_offset = 0;
    spi_transfer.lsb_count = 0;
    spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    spi_transfer.delay = 0;
    spi_transfer.speed_hz = SPI_CLOCK;
    spi_transfer.use_spi_device = 1;
    spi_transfer.transfer_mode = SPI_MODE;
    spi_transfer.cs = SPI_CS;
    spi_transfer.cs_lines = SPI_CS_PIN;
    spi_transfer.cs_lines_count = 1;

    if (ioctl(SensorState.i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &spi_transfer) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to read I2C data");
    }
    if (read(SensorState.sensor_fd, &SensorState.distance, sizeof(SensorState.distance)) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to read sensor distance");
    }
    if (SensorState.distance < 200 || SensorState.distance > 5000) {
        handle_error("Invalid sensor distance");
    }
}

static void write_log() {
    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to open log file");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "Writing to log file...\n");
    if (fputs(LOG_HEADER, SensorState.fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to write log header");
    }
    if (fputs("timestamp,millimeters\n", SensorState.fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to write log header");
    }
    if (fputs("timestamp,millimeters\n", SensorState.fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to write log header");
    }
    if (fprintf(SensorState.fd, "%ld,%d\n", (long)time(NULL), SensorState.distance) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to write log data");
    }
    if (fclose(SensorState.fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to close log file");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "Log file written successfully\n");
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    SensorState s;
    s.fd = NULL;
    s.spi_fd = 0;
    s.i2c_fd = 0;
    s.sensor_fd = 0;
    s.distance = 0;
    s.error = 0;

    init_spi();
    init_i2c();
    init_sensor();

    while (1) {
        read_distance();
        write_log();
        usleep(100000);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define SI1145_ADDR 0x60

#define PS1_DATA0 0x13
#define PS1_DATA1 0x14

#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define RETRY_DELAY_MS 100

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int retry_count;
    int retry_delay;
} Si1145State;

void handleSigint(int signum) {
    if (Si1145State->fd > 0) {
        close(Si1145State->fd);
    }
    if (Si1145State->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(Si1145State->i2c_fd);
    }
    if (Si1145State->log_fd > 0) {
        close(Si1145State->log_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handleSigterm(int signum) {
    handleSigint(signum);
}

int i2cOpen(int *fd) {
    *fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (*fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2cClose(int fd) {
    if (close(fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2cWrite(int fd, unsigned char *buf, int len) {
    if (write(fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2cRead(int fd, unsigned char *buf, int len) {
    if (read(fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read from I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int si1145Init(Si1145State *state) {
    if (i2cOpen(&state->i2c_fd) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(state->i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, SI1145_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        return -1;
    }
    state->retry_count = 0;
    state->retry_delay = RETRY_DELAY_MS;
    state->fd = open("proximity_log.txt", O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (state->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int si1145ReadProximity(Si1145State *state) {
    unsigned char buf[2];
    int retries = 0;
    while (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
        if (i2cRead(state->i2c_fd, buf, 2) < 0) {
            if (retries < MAX_RETRIES - 1) {
                usleep(state->retry_delay);
            } else {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        unsigned int proximity = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1];
        if (proximity == 0) {
            printf("Proximity value is 0, retrying...\n");
            retries++;
        } else {
            char timestamp[20];
            struct tm *now;
            time_t t = time(NULL);
            now = localtime(&t);
            strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", now);
            fprintf(state->fd, "%s %u\n", timestamp, proximity);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    Si1145State state;
    if (si1145Init(&state) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    signal(SIGINT, handleSigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handleSigterm);
    while (1) {
        if (si1145ReadProximity(&state) < 0) {
            printf("Failed to read proximity data, exiting...\n");
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define SI7005_ADDR 0x76
#define CONFIG_REG 0x16
#define TEMP_REG 0x41
#define HUMID_REG 0x42
#define CONFIG_REG_VALUE 0x00

#define I2C_TIMEOUT 10
#define READ_INTERVAL 2000

int i2c_fd = -1;
int config_written = 0;
int temp_read = 0;
int humidity_read = 0;

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        printf("I2C error: %d\n", err);
        i2c_fd = -1;
        config_written = 0;
        temp_read = 0;
        humidity_read = 0;
        if (i2c_fd != -1) {
            close(i2c_fd);
        }
        i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
        if (i2c_fd < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdma_request req;
    int err;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);

    // Open I2C bus
    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set I2C timeout
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SET_TIMEOUT, I2C_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C timeout");
        handle_i2c_error(errno);
    }

    // Set I2C address
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SET_ADDRESS, SI7005_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C address");
        handle_i2c_error(errno);
    }

    // Write CONFIG register
    msg[0].addr = SI7005_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD | I2C_M_WRITE;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg[0].data[0] = CONFIG_REG;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, msg, 1, &req) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write CONFIG register");
        handle_i2c_error(errno);
    }
    config_written = 1;

    // Read temperature and humidity
    while (1) {
        if (!config_written) {
            continue;
        }

        msg[0].addr = SI7005_ADDR;
        msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD | I2C_M_WRITE;
        msg[0].len = 1;
        msg[0].data[0] = CONFIG_REG;
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, msg, 1, &req) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read CONFIG register");
            handle_i2c_error(errno);
        }

        if (msg[0].data[0] != CONFIG_REG_VALUE) {
            printf("Failed to configure sensor\n");
            handle_i2c_error(errno);
        }

        msg[1].addr = SI7005_ADDR;
        msg[1].flags = I2C_M_RD | I2C_M_WRITE;
        msg[1].len = 1;
        msg[1].data[0] = TEMP_REG;
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, msg, 2, &req) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read temperature");
            handle_i2c_error(errno);
        }
        temp_read = 1;

        msg[1].addr = SI7005_ADDR;
        msg[1].flags = I2C_M_RD | I2C_M_WRITE;
        msg[1].len = 1;
        msg[1].data[0] = HUMID_REG;
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, msg, 2, &req) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read humidity");
            handle_i2c_error(errno);
        }
        humidity_read = 1;

        if (temp_read && humidity_read) {
            double temp = (msg[1].data[0] << 8) / 16384.0;
            double humidity = (msg[1].data[0] << 8) / 16384.0;
            printf("Temperature: %.2f°C, Humidity: %.2f%%\n", temp, humidity);
            fflush(stdout);
            sleep(READ_INTERVAL / 1000);
            temp_read = 0;
            humidity_read = 0;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

        handle_error("Failed to read from I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_write(int fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (write(fd, buf, size) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to write to I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_ioctl(int fd, uint8_t *cmd, size_t size) {
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, cmd) < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to issue I2C ioctl");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int crc8_check(uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    uint8_t crc = CRC8_INIT;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        crc ^= buf[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x01) {
                crc = (crc >> 1) ^ CRC8_POLYNOMIAL;
            } else {
                crc >>= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

static void log_data(SensorData* data, float temp, float humidity) {
    if (data->log_opened) {
        struct timeval tv;
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        char timestamp[128];
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), LOG_FORMAT, &tv);
        if (fprintf(data->log_fd, "%s,%f,%f\n", timestamp, temp, humidity) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to log data\n");
        }
    }
}

static void handle_i2c_error(SensorData* data, int error) {
    if (data->initialized) {
        if (error == -1) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        } else if (error == -2) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C timeout\n");
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", error);
        }
    }
}

void i2c_open(int *fd) {
    *fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (*fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_close(int fd) {
    close(fd);
}

void i2c_write(int fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t len) {
    if (write(fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_read(int fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t len) {
    if (read(fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read from I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_ioctl(int fd, int cmd, uint8_t *buf, size_t len) {
    if (ioctl(fd, cmd, buf) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to execute I2C ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_read_status(int fd, uint8_t *buf) {
    i2c_ioctl(fd, I2C_IOC_GSTAT, buf, 1);
}

#define SHT35_CRC_LEN 2

static void handle_signal(int signum) {

static void init_sht35(SHT35Context *ctx) {

    if (buffer[11] != SHT35_CRC_LEN) {

    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg ioctl_msg;
    msg[0].addr = SHT35_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_MSG_WRITE;

    ioctl_msg.request_iovlen = 1;
    ioctl_msg.iovctl = I2C_I2C_RDWR;
    ioctl_msg.iovctlen = 1;
    ioctl_msg.iovdata = buffer;
    ioctl_msg.iovctlen = SHT35_MEAS_RESULT_LEN + SHT35_CRC_LEN;
    ioctl_msg.timeout = SHT35_MEAS_TIMEOUT;

        return;
    }

    buffer[1] = SHT35_MEAS_RESULT_LEN;
    buffer[2] = (uint8_t)(temperature + 40) * 100;
    buffer[3] = (uint8_t)(temperature + 40) % 100;
    buffer[4] = SHT35_MEAS_RESULT_LEN;
    buffer[5] = SHT35_MEAS_RESULT_LEN;

static uint16_t crc16(const void *data, size_t len) {
    uint16_t crc = 0;
    uint8_t *ptr = (uint8_t *)data;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= *ptr++;
        crc = (crc << 8) | (crc >> 8);
        crc ^= *ptr++;
        crc = (crc << 8) | (crc >> 8);
    }
    return crc;
}

static void log_data(double temperature, double humidity) {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%06Z", timeinfo);
    double offset_temperature = 2 * sin(2 * M_PI * (time(NULL) / 3600));
    double offset_humidity = 5 * sin(2 * M_PI * (time(NULL) / 3600));
    double logged_temperature = temperature + offset_temperature;
    double logged_humidity = humidity + offset_humidity;
    if (isnan(logged_temperature) || isnan(logged_humidity)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "NaN values logged\n");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "Logged temperature: %.2f°C\n", logged_temperature);
    fprintf(stderr, "Logged humidity: %.2f%%\n");
    if (SHT35Context->log_fd < 0) {
        return;
    }
    fprintf(SHT35Context->log_fd, "%s %.2fC %.2f%%\n", buffer, logged_temperature, logged_humidity);
    fflush(SHT35Context->log_fd);
}

int main() {
    SHT35Context ctx;
    ctx.retries = 3;
    ctx.last_error = 0;
    ctx.i2c_bus = 1;
    init_sht35(&ctx);
    if (ctx.last_error != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C initialization failed: %s\n", strerror(ctx.last_error));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    ctx.log_fd = open("environmental_data.txt", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (ctx.log_fd < 0) {
        ctx.last_error = errno;
        fprintf(stderr, "File open failed: %s\n", strerror(ctx.last_error));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);
    while (1) {
        double temperature, humidity;
        for (int i = 0; i < ctx.retries; i++) {
            if (ctx.last_error == 0) {
                read_sht35(&ctx, &temperature, &humidity);
                if (ctx.last_error == 0) {
                    log_data(temperature, humidity);
                    break;
                }
            }
            usleep(1000 * 1000); // 1 second delay
        }
        if (ctx.last_error != 0) {
            log_data(NAN, NAN);
        }
    }
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

    }
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, addr) < 0) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    return fd;

    data->pressure[0] = buf[0];
    data->temperature[0] = buf[1];
    data->scale[0] = buf[2];
    data->crc[0] = buf[8];
}

    buf[0] = cmd;
    if (write(fd, buf, 1) < 0) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

}

}

    buf[0] = CMD_SET_REG;
    buf[1] = reg;
    buf[2] = val;
    if (write(fd, buf, 3) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write I2C register command");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_get_reg(int fd, uint8_t reg, uint8_t *val) {
    uint8_t buf[2];
    buf[0] = CMD_GET_REG;
    buf[1] = reg;
    if (write(fd, buf, 2) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write I2C register command");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (read(fd, buf, 2) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C register data");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    *val = buf[1];

    data->temperature[0] = buf[1];
    data->scale[0] = buf[2];
    data->crc[0] = buf[8];

    if (read(fd, buf, 2) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C data");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    data->pressure[0] = buf[0];
    data->temperature[0] = buf[1];
}

void i2c_read_scale(int fd, uint8_t *scale) {
    uint8_t buf[1];
    if (read(fd, buf, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C data");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    *scale = buf[0];
}

void i2c_read_crc(int fd, uint8_t *crc) {
    uint8_t buf[1];
    if (read(fd, buf, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C data");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    *crc = buf[0];

void i2c_validate_crc(int fd, SensorData *data) {
    uint8_t crc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

        if (crc & 0x80) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    uint8_t scale = data->scale[0];
    *pressure = (float)((data->pressure[0] << 8) / scale);

void i2c_convert_temperature(SensorData *data, float *temperature) {

    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    i2c_stop(&state->i2c_fd, &state);
    i2c_close(&state->i2c_fd);
    close(state->airflow_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

    int i2c_fd;
    float pressure, temperature;
    SensorData data;
    struct sigaction sa;

    sa.sa_sigaction = i2c_handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    i2c_start(&i2c_fd, &state);

        i2c_send_cmd(state.i2c_fd, CMD_CONT);
        i2c_read_pressure_temperature(state.i2c_fd, &data);
        i2c_read_scale(state.i2c_fd, &data.scale[0]);
        i2c_read_crc(state.i2c_fd, &data.crc[0]);
        i2c_validate_crc(state.i2c_fd, &data);
        i2c_convert_pressure(&data, &pressure);
        i2c_convert_temperature(&data, &temperature);
        i2c_log_data(pressure, temperature);
        sleep(1);
    }

    return 0;
}

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int log_fd;
    struct timeval start_time;
    struct timeval end_time;
} SensorData;

static void handle_error(const char *msg) {
    perror(msg);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

static void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (SensorData::s_data.log_fd > 0) {
        close(SensorData::s_data.log_fd);
    }
    close(SensorData::s_data.i2c_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

static void init_sensor_data(SensorData *s) {
    s->fd = fileno(stdin);
    s->i2c_fd = -1;
    s->log_fd = -1;
    s->start_time.tv_sec = 0;
    s->start_time.tv_usec = 0;
}

static void init_log_file(SensorData *s) {
    s->log_fd = open("pressure_log.txt", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (s->log_fd < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to open log file");
    }
}

static void close_sensor_data(SensorData *s) {
    if (s->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(s->i2c_fd);
    }
    if (s->log_fd > 0) {
        close(s->log_fd);
    }
}

static void read_i2c_response(I2CResponse *resp) {
    resp->address = I2C_ADDR;
    resp->cmd = CMD_READ;
    resp->len = CMD_LEN_RESPONSE;
    resp->crc = 0;
    resp->data[0] = 0;
    resp->data[1] = 0;
    resp->data[2] = 0;
    resp->data[3] = 0;
    resp->data[4] = 0;
    resp->data[5] = 0;
    resp->data[6] = 0;
    resp->data[7] = 0;
    resp->data[8] = 0;
    resp->crc = 0;
    ssize_t bytes = write(SensorData::s_data.i2c_fd, resp, sizeof(*resp));
    if (bytes < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to write to I2C bus");
    }
    bytes = read(SensorData::s_data.i2c_fd, resp, sizeof(*resp));
    if (bytes < 0) {
        handle_error("Failed to read from I2C bus");
    }
    if (bytes != sizeof(*resp)) {
        handle_error("Failed to read I2C response");
    }
    resp->crc = resp->data[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        resp->crc ^= resp->data[i];
    }
    resp->crc = (resp->crc >> 4) ^ (resp->crc & 0xF) << 4;
    resp->crc ^= CRC8_POLY;
}

static void validate_crc8(I2CResponse *resp) {
    uint8_t crc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        crc ^= resp->data[i];
    }
    crc = (crc >> 4) ^ (crc & 0xF) << 4;
    crc ^= CRC8_POLY;
    if (crc != resp->crc) {
        handle_error("CRC8 validation failed");
    }
}

static void read_pressure(I2CResponse *resp) {
    uint32_t pressure = (resp->data[0] << 24) | (resp->data[1] << 16) | (resp->data[2] << 8) | resp->data[3];
    pressure = pressure / 1000.0;
    printf("Pressure: %.2f Pa\n", pressure);
}

static void log_pressure(I2CResponse *resp) {
    char buffer[128];
    gettimeofday(&SensorData::s_data.end_time, NULL);
    double elapsed_time = (SensorData::s_data.end_time.tv_sec - SensorData::s_data.start_time.tv_sec) * 1000000.0 + (SensorData::s_data.end_time.tv_usec - SensorData::s_data.start_time.tv_usec);
    elapsed_time /= 1000000.0;
    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%.2f Pa at %ld seconds\n", (double)pressure, elapsed_time);
    write(SensorData::s_data.log_fd, buffer, strlen(buffer));
}

static void main_loop(SensorData *s) {
    while (1) {
        gettimeofday(&s->start_time, NULL);
        read_i2c_response(&s->sensor_data);
        validate_crc8(&s->sensor_data.sensor_data);
        read_pressure(&s->sensor_data.sensor_data);
        log_pressure(&s->sensor_data.sensor_data);
        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds
    }
}

int main() {
    SensorData s;
    init_sensor_data(&s);
    init_log_file(&s);
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);
    while (1) {
        main_loop(&s);
    }
    close_sensor_data(&s);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <math.h>

#define STLM75_ADDR 0x90
#define BUFFER_SIZE 10
#define LED_PIN 17

typedef struct {
    float data[BUFFER_SIZE];
    float sum;
    int next;
} CircularBuffer;

void init_buffer(CircularBuffer *buf) {
    buf->sum = 0.0;
    buf->next = 0;
}

void add_to_buffer(CircularBuffer *buf, float value) {
    buf->data[buf->next] = value;
    buf->sum += value;
    buf->next = (buf->next + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
}

float get_average(CircularBuffer *buf) {
    return buf->sum / (float)BUFFER_SIZE;
}

void cleanup(CircularBuffer *buf) {
    free(buf);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        // Turn off LED
        digitalWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
        // Close I2C handle
        close(i2c_fd);
        // Invoke library's cleanup call
        cleanup(&buffer);
        // Exit program
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    // Initialize signal handler
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    // Initialize I2C device
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, STLM75_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        cleanup(&buffer);
        return 1;
    }

    // Initialize buffer

    init_buffer(buf);

    // Initialize LED

        cleanup(&buffer);
        return 1;
    }

    // Initialize I2C read

        perror("i2c_read");
        cleanup(&buffer);
        return 1;
    }

#define I2C_DEV_NAME "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS

#define PRESSURE_OFFSET 0
#define TEMPERATURE_OFFSET 1
#define SCALE_FACTOR_OFFSET 2

#define CRC8_POLYNOMIAL 0x07
#define CRC8_INIT 0xFF

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_handle *handle;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
} I2CHandle;

static int i2c_open(I2CHandle *handle) {
    handle->fd = open(I2C_DEV_NAME, O_RDWR);
    if (handle->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_close(I2CHandle *handle) {
    if (handle->fd >= 0) {
        close(handle->fd);
    }
    if (handle->handle) {
        gpiod_close(handle->handle);
    }
    if (handle->line) {
        gpiod_line_unref(handle->line);
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_ioctl(I2CHandle *handle, int cmd, void *buf, int len) {
    if (handle->fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(handle->fd, cmd, buf) < 0) {
        perror("I2C ioctl failed");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_read(I2CHandle *handle, void *buf, int len) {
    if (handle->fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (len < 9) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (i2c_ioctl(handle, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR, I2C_READ) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (read(handle->fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C data");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_crc8(const void *buf, int len, int poly, int init) {
    uint8_t crc = init;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        uint8_t data = ((uint8_t *)buf)[i];
        crc = (crc << 1) ^ (data == 0 ? init : (data ^ crc) & 0xFF);
    }
    return crc;
}

static int i2c_validate_crc8(const void *buf, int len, int poly, int init) {
    uint8_t crc = i2c_crc8(buf, len, poly, init);
    if (crc != init) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int i2c_read_data(I2CHandle *handle, void *buf, int len) {
    if (i2c_read(handle, buf, len) < 0) {
        return -1;

    if (i2c_validate_crc8(buf, len, CRC8_POLYNOMIAL, CRC8_INIT) < 0) {

#define CRC8_INIT 0x00

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    float pressure;
} AirflowData;

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int initialized;
} I2CDevice;

static void i2c_open(I2CDevice *dev) {
    dev->fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (dev->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void i2c_close(I2CDevice *dev) {
    if (dev->fd >= 0) {
        close(dev->fd);
    }
}

static ssize_t i2c_write(I2CDevice *dev, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (dev->initialized) {
        if (ioctl(dev->fd, I2C_RDWR, (unsigned long)dev->fd, buf, size) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to I2C device");
            return -1;
        }
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C device not initialized\n");
        return -1;
    }
    return size;
}

static ssize_t i2c_read(I2CDevice *dev, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (dev->initialized) {
        if (ioctl(dev->fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, buf, size, NULL, NULL) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read from I2C device");
            return -1;
        }
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C device not initialized\n");
        return -1;
    }
    return size;
}

#define I2C_BUS "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x40

#define HIH6130_I2C_ID_STATUS 0x01
#define HIH6130_I2C_ID_TEMP 0x02

static int i2c_fd;

static void i2c_init() {
    if (i2c_initialized) {
        return;
    }

    i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    i2c_initialized = true;
}

#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int attempts;
} I2CHandle;

void handle_i2c_error(int err, I2CHandle *handle) {
    if (err == -EIO) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C bus error\n");
    } else if (err == -EBUSY) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C bus busy\n");
    } else if (err == -ENODEV) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C device not found\n");
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", err);
    }
    handle->attempts++;
    if (handle->attempts < 3) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Reinitializing I2C handle...\n");
        handle->fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
        if (handle->fd < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open I2C device\n");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize I2C handle after 3 attempts\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_sensor_absent(int err, I2CHandle *handle) {
    if (err == -ENODEV) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor not found\n");
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "Unexpected sensor error\n");
    }
    handle->attempts++;
    if (handle->attempts < 3) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Reinitializing I2C handle...\n");
        handle->fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
        if (handle->fd < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open I2C device\n");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize I2C handle after 3 attempts\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_temperature(I2CHandle *handle) {
    int err;
    char buf[32];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data ioctl_data;
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_client_data client_data;

    memset(&client_data, 0, sizeof(client_data));
    client_data.addr = TMP117_ADDR;

    msg[0].addr = client_data.addr;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x3C; // Read temperature register

    ioctl_data.msgs = msg;
    ioctl_data.nmsgs = 1;

    err = ioctl(handle->fd, I2C_RDWR, &ioctl_data);
    if (err < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(err, handle);
    }

    if (err == 0) {
        read(handle->fd, buf, 7);
        int temperature = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1];
        temperature = (temperature - 0x800) / 0x80;
        if (temperature < 0) {
            temperature = -temperature;
        }
        printf("%s, Temperature: %d.00 C\n", 
            asctime(gmtime(&time(NULL))), temperature);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum, siginfo_t *siginfo, void *context) {
    if (signum == SIGINT) {
        if (handle->fd > 0) {
            close(handle->fd);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    I2CHandle handle = {0, 0};
    handle.fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (handle.fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open I2C device\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    struct i2c_client_data client_data;
    client_data.addr = TMP117_ADDR;

    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data ioctl_data;
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];

    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x3C; // Read temperature register

    ioctl_data.nmsgs = 1;

    int err = ioctl(handle.fd, I2C_RDWR, &ioctl_data);
    if (err < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(err, &handle);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);

    while (1) {
        read_temperature(&handle);
        sleep(1);
    }

    return 0;
}

#define TEMP_OFFSET 0x02

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    uint16_t slpm;
    uint16_t temp;

void i2c_init(int *i2c_fd) {
    *i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (*i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_reinit(int *i2c_fd) {
    close(*i2c_fd);
    *i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (*i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to re-open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_read(int *i2c_fd, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    int retries = 0;
    while (retries < I2C_RETRIES) {
        if (read(*i2c_fd, buf, len) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            i2c_reinit(i2c_fd);
            retries++;
        } else {
            if (len == 4) {
                return;
            } else {
                perror("Invalid I2C data length");
                i2c_reinit(i2c_fd);
                retries++;
            }
        }
    }
    perror("Failed to read I2C data after retries");
    i2c_reinit(i2c_fd);
}

void i2c_write(int *i2c_fd, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    int retries = 0;
    while (retries < I2C_RETRIES) {
        if (write(*i2c_fd, buf, len) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write I2C data");
            i2c_reinit(i2c_fd);
            retries++;
        } else {
            return;
        }
    }
    perror("Failed to write I2C data after retries");
    i2c_reinit(i2c_fd);
}

void i2c_read_flow_data(int *i2c_fd, FlowData *data) {
    uint8_t buf[4];
    i2c_read(i2c_fd, buf, 4);
    data->timestamp = (uint32_t)buf[0] << 24 | (uint32_t)buf[1] << 16 | (uint32_t)buf[2] << 8 | (uint32_t)buf[3];
    data->slpm = (uint16_t)(buf[SLPM_OFFSET] & SLPM_MASK);
    data->temp = (uint16_t)(buf[TEMP_OFFSET] & TEMP_MASK);
}

void i2c_read_temp_data(int *i2c_fd, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    i2c_read(i2c_fd, buf, len);
    if (len == 2) {
        return;
    } else {
        perror("Invalid I2C data length");
        i2c_reinit(i2c_fd);
    }
}

void i2c_read_temp_data(int *i2c_fd, uint16_t *temp) {
    uint8_t buf[2];
    i2c_read_temp_data(i2c_fd, buf, 2);
    *temp = (uint16_t)(buf[0] << 8 | buf[1]);

void i2c_write_flow_data(int *i2c_fd, FlowData *data) {

void i2c_write_temp_data(int *i2c_fd, uint16_t *temp) {

        }

        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }

#define CRC8_INIT 0x00

#define I2C_READ_TIMEOUT 45
#define I2C_WRITE_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_READ_BYTES 9
#define I2C_READ_OFFSET 0
#define I2C_READ_LENGTH 8
#define I2C_READ_CRC_OFFSET 8
#define I2C_READ_CRC_LENGTH 1

#define I2C_READ_RESULT_OK 0
#define I2C_READ_RESULT_ERROR -1
#define I2C_WRITE_RESULT_OK 0
#define I2C_WRITE_RESULT_ERROR -1

#define LOG_FILE "airflow.log"

typedef struct {
    uint64_t timestamp;
    double differential_pressure;
    double temperature;
} AirflowData;

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int i2c_result;
    int crc_ok;
    int pressure_ok;
} SensorData;

static void handle_sensor_error(SensorData *sensor, int error_code) {
    if (sensor->i2c_result == I2C_READ_RESULT_ERROR) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C read error: %d\n", error_code);
    } else if (sensor->i2c_result == I2C_WRITE_RESULT_ERROR) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C write error: %d\n", error_code);
    } else if (!sensor->crc_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "CRC mismatch\n");
    } else if (!sensor->pressure_ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Pressure exceeds 5.0 Pa\n");
    }
}

static void handle_sensor_close(SensorData *sensor) {
    if (sensor->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(sensor->i2c_fd);
    }
    if (sensor->fd > 0) {
        close(sensor->fd);
    }
    sensor->i2c_result = I2C_WRITE_RESULT_OK;
    sensor->crc_ok = 1;
    sensor->pressure_ok = 1;
}

static int i2c_read(SensorData *sensor, uint8_t *buffer) {
    struct i2c_msg msg;
    struct i2c_rdma_request request;
    struct i2c_rdma_return reply;
    int ret;

    msg.addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg.flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg.buf = buffer;
    msg.len = I2C_READ_BYTES;

    request.request = msg;
    request.request_size = sizeof(struct i2c_msg);

    ret = ioctl(sensor->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &request);
    if (ret < 0) {
        return I2C_READ_RESULT_ERROR;
    }

    ret = read(sensor->i2c_fd, buffer, I2C_READ_BYTES);
    if (ret < 0) {
        return I2C_READ_RESULT_ERROR;
    }

    return I2C_READ_RESULT_OK;
}

static int i2c_write(SensorData *sensor, uint8_t *buffer) {
    struct i2c_msg msg;
    struct i2c_rdma_request request;
    struct i2c_rdma_return reply;
    int ret;

    msg.addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg.flags = I2C_M_RD | I2C_M_RDMA;
    msg.buf = buffer;
    msg.len = I2C_READ_BYTES;

    request.request = msg;
    request.request_size = sizeof(struct i2c_msg);

    ret = ioctl(sensor->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &request);
    if (ret < 0) {
        return I2C_WRITE_RESULT_ERROR;
    }

    return I2C_WRITE_RESULT_OK;
}

static int crc8(uint8_t *data, int len, uint8_t init) {
    uint8_t crc = init;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x01) {
                crc = (crc >> 1) ^ CRC8_POLYNOMIAL;
            } else {
                crc >>= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

static void log_data(AirflowData *data) {
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }

    fprintf(log_file, "%llu,%f,%f\n", data->timestamp, data->differential_pressure, data->temperature);
    fclose(log_file);
}

static void handle_signal(int signum) {
    SensorData sensor;
    sensor.fd = 0;
    sensor.i2c_fd = 0;
    sensor.i2c_result = 0;
    sensor.crc_ok = 1;
    sensor.pressure_ok = 1;

    handle_sensor_close(&sensor);

    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_rdma_return reply;
    SensorData sensor;
    AirflowData data;
    uint8_t buffer[I2C_READ_BYTES];
    int ret;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    sensor.fd = open("/dev/ttyAMA0", O_RDWR);
    if (sensor.fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open UART");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    ret = ioctl(sensor.fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    sensor.i2c_fd = ret;
    sensor.i2c_result = ret;

    while (1) {
        data.timestamp = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
        ret = i2c_read(&sensor, buffer);
        if (ret == I2C_READ_RESULT_OK) {
            data.differential_pressure = (double)buffer[I2C_READ_OFFSET] * 0.1;
            data.temperature = (double)(buffer[I2C_READ_OFFSET + 1] - 0.5) * 0.1;

            }
            if (data.differential_pressure > 5.0) {
                sensor.pressure_ok = 0;
            }
            log_data(&data);
        } else {
            handle_sensor_error(&sensor, ret);
        }

        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

cleanup:
    handle_sensor_close(&sensor);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#define SI7021_REVISION 0x3D

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    gpiod_handle_t handle;
    gpiod_line_mfd_t *gpio;
    gpiod_line_t *i2c;
} Si7021Handler;

void i2c_read(Si7021Handler *handler, int reg, int *value) {
    int retries = 0;
    while (retries < 3) {
        if (ioctl(handler->fd, I2C_RDWR, (unsigned long)SI7021_ADDR, (unsigned long)reg, (unsigned long)value) < 0) {
            if (errno == EIO) {
                printf("I2C read error: %s\n", strerror(errno));
                retries++;
            } else {
                printf("I2C read error: %s\n", strerror(errno));
                return;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
}

void i2c_write(Si7021Handler *handler, int reg, int value) {
    int retries = 0;
    while (retries < 3) {
        if (ioctl(handler->fd, I2C_RDWR, (unsigned long)SI7021_ADDR, (unsigned long)reg, (unsigned long)value) < 0) {
            if (errno == EIO) {
                printf("I2C write error: %s\n", strerror(errno));
                retries++;
            } else {
                printf("I2C write error: %s\n", strerror(errno));
                return;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
}

void si7021_init(Si7021Handler *handler) {
    handler->fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (handler->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpiod_err_t err;
    handler->handle = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod", &err);
    if (err) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    handler->gpio = gpiod_get_line_table(handler->handle);
    if (!handler->gpio) {
        perror("Failed to get line table");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    handler->i2c = gpiod_get_line_by_number(handler->handle, 0);
    if (!handler->i2c) {
        perror("Failed to get I2C line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpiod_set_pullup(handler->i2c, 0);
    gpiod_set_edge(handler->i2c, GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING);
    gpiod_enable(handler->i2c, 1);
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define I2C_SLAVE 0x70
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 10
#define I2C_READ_BYTES 3
#define I2C_READ_TIMEOUT 5

#define CRC8_POLYNOMIAL 0x31

typedef struct {
    int i2c_fd;
    int log_fd;
} I2CLogContext;

static void handle_signal(int signum, siginfo_t *siginfo, void *context) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (I2CLogContext.i2c_fd != -1) {
            close(I2CLogContext.i2c_fd);
        }
        if (I2CLogContext.log_fd != -1) {
            close(I2CLogContext.log_fd);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_sigaction = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART | SA_SIGINFO;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    I2CLogContext context;
    context.i2c_fd = -1;
    context.log_fd = -1;

    // Open I2C device
    context.i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (context.i2c_fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set slave address
    if (ioctl(context.i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_SLAVE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(context.i2c_fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Open log file
    context.log_fd = open("temperature_log.txt", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (context.log_fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        close(context.i2c_fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    while (1) {
        // Wait for I2C read timeout
        if (wait_read_timeout(context.i2c_fd, I2C_READ_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
            perror("I2C read timeout");
            continue;
        }

        // Read I2C data
        uint8_t data[I2C_READ_BYTES];
        ssize_t bytes_read = read(context.i2c_fd, data, I2C_READ_BYTES);
        if (bytes_read != I2C_READ_BYTES) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            continue;
        }

        // Verify CRC8
        uint8_t crc = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < I2C_READ_BYTES - 1; i++) {
            crc = crc8(crc, data[i], CRC8_POLYNOMIAL);
        }
        if (crc != data[I2C_READ_BYTES - 1]) {
            perror("CRC8 mismatch");
            continue;
        }

        // Read temperature
        float temperature = (data[0] * 256.0 + data[1]) / 163.84;
        // Write to log file
        char timestamp[32];
        struct tm *now = localtime(&time(NULL));
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", now);
        fprintf(context.log_fd, "%s %f\n", timestamp, temperature);
        fflush(context.log_fd);

        // Wait for 5 seconds
        if (sleep(5) == -1) {
            perror("Failed to sleep");
            continue;
        }
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

static int wait_read_timeout(int fd, int timeout) {
    struct timespec ts;
    ts.tv_sec = timeout / 1000;
    ts.tv_nsec = (timeout % 1000) * 1000;
    return nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
}

static uint8_t crc8(uint8_t crc, uint8_t data, uint8_t poly) {
    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        crc = (crc & 0x80) ? (crc ^ data) : crc;
        crc <<= 1;
        if (crc & 0x80) {

    }

            perror("accept");
            continue;
        }

        if (write(client_fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0) {
            perror("write");
            close(client_fd);
            continue;
        }

        ssize_t bytes_received;

                continue;
            }
        }

            perror("read");
            close(client_fd);
            continue;
        }

        // Close client socket
        close(client_fd);
    }

    gpiod_device_destroy(ctx.device);
    gpiod_release_resources(ctx.device);

#include <stdio.h>

#define DS18B20_PIN "/sys/bus/w1/devices/28-00000..."
#define DS18B20_FILE "/sys/bus/w1/devices/28-00000..."
#define RELAY_PIN 17
#define PWM_PIN 18
#define LOG_FILE "greenhouse.log"

#define MAX_READS 10
#define LOG_INTERVAL 5

typedef struct {
    double setpoint;
    double Kp;
    double Ki;
    double Kd;
} PIDParameters;

typedef struct {
    double temperature;
    double pidOutput;
    double pwmDuty;
    int relayState;
} SensorData;

static int fd;
static int logFd;
static PIDParameters pidParams;
static SensorData sensorData;
static int sensorPresent = 0;
static int sensorAbsent = 0;
static int busError = 0;

static void handleSignal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (fd > 0) {
            close(fd);
        }
        if (logFd > 0) {
            close(logFd);
        }
        if (sensorData.relayState == 1) {
            digitalWrite(RELAY_PIN, 0);
        }
        if (sensorData.pwmDuty > 0) {
            pwmWrite(PWM_PIN, 0);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

static int readSensor() {
    char filename[128];
    snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s/w1_slave", DS18B20_FILE);
    int fd = open(filename, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        busError = 1;
        return -1;
    }
    char buffer[128];
    read(fd, buffer, 128);
    close(fd);
    if (sscanf(buffer, "t=%lf", &sensorData.temperature) < 1) {
        busError = 1;
        return -1;
    }
    if (busError) {
        busError = 0;
        return -1;
    }
    char crcBuffer[3];
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        crcBuffer[i] = buffer[17 + 2 * i];
    }
    int crc = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        crc ^= crcBuffer[i];
        crc = (crc << 2) | (crc >> 6);
    }
    if (crc != (buffer[17] - '0' + (buffer[18] - '0') * 10)) {
        busError = 1;
        return -1;
    }
    sensorPresent = 1;
    return 0;
}

    pidParams.setpoint = atoi(argv[1]);
    pidParams.Kp = atof(argv[2]);
    pidParams.Ki = atof(argv[3]);
    pidParams.Kd = atof(argv[4]);
}

static double computePID() {
    double error = sensorData.temperature - pidParams.setpoint;
    double pidOutput = pidParams.Kp * error + pidParams.Ki * error * sensorData.temperature + pidParams.Kd * error * fabs(error);
    return pidOutput;
}

    if (dutyCycle > 100) {
        dutyCycle = 100;

        dutyCycle = 0;

    if (dutyCycle > 0) {
        pwmWrite(PWM_PIN, dutyCycle);
    } else {
        pwmWrite(PWM_PIN, 0);
    }
}

            messages[1].addr = AHT20_ADDR;
            messages[1].flags = I2C_M_RD;

            messages[2].addr = AHT20_ADDR;

                perror(error);
                if (retries < AHT20_RETRY - 1) {
                    usleep(AHT20_PAUSE * 1000);
                }
            }
        }

            snprintf(error, sizeof(error), "Failed to read I2C device at 0x%02X after %d retries", AHT20_ADDR, AHT20_RETRY);

        } else {

        }
