#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/param.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

#define BMP280_I2C_ADDR 0x76
#define BMP280_TEMP_REG 0x00
#define BMP280_PRES_REG 0x08
#define BMP280_CONTROL_REG 0xF4
#define BMP280_CONTROL_TEMP_MODE 0x02
#define BMP280_CONTROL_PRE_MODE 0x08
#define BMP280_CONTROL_STANDBY_MODE 0x08
#define BMP280_CONTROL_POWER_DOWN 0x00

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"

#define JSON_BUF_SIZE 256

typedef struct {
    int sock;
    struct sockaddr_in server_addr;
} UDPConnection;

UDPConnection udp_conn;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    close(udp_conn.sock);
    close(i2c_fd);
    exit(0);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    close(udp_conn.sock);
    close(i2c_fd);
    exit(0);
}

int i2c_fd;

int i2c_open(const char *dev) {
    int fd;
    if ((fd = open(dev, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c device");
        return -1;
    }
    return fd;
}

int i2c_read(int fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (read(fd, buf, size) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read from i2c device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2c_write(int fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (write(fd, buf, size) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to i2c device");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2c_ioctl(int fd, unsigned char *buf, size_t size) {
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, BMP280_I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set i2c slave address");
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, BMP280_CONTROL_REG, buf, size) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read control register");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int bmp280_read_temp(int fd, uint8_t *buf) {
    if (i2c_ioctl(fd, buf, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int bmp280_read_pres(int fd, uint8_t *buf) {
    if (i2c_ioctl(fd, buf, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int bmp280_read_data(int fd, uint8_t *buf) {
    if (bmp280_read_temp(fd, buf) < 0 || bmp280_read_pres(fd, buf + 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int bmp280_init(int fd) {
    uint8_t control_reg[1] = {BMP280_CONTROL_REG};
    control_reg[0] |= BMP280_CONTROL_TEMP_MODE;
    control_reg[0] |= BMP280_CONTROL_PRE_MODE;
    control_reg[0] |= BMP280_CONTROL_STANDBY_MODE;
    if (i2c_ioctl(fd, control_reg, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int bmp280_read_json(char *buf, int *temp, int *pres) {
    char json_buf[JSON_BUF_SIZE];
    snprintf(json_buf, JSON_BUF_SIZE, "{\"temperature\":%.2f, \"pressure\":%.2f}", *temp, *pres);
    strcpy(buf, json_buf);
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    i2c_fd = i2c_open(I2C_DEV);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    if (bmp280_init(i2c_fd) < 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    UDPConnection udp_conn;
    udp_conn.sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    if (udp_conn.sock < 0) {
        perror("Failed to create UDP socket");
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&udp_conn.server_addr, 0, sizeof(udp_conn.server_addr));
    udp_conn.server_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
    udp_conn.server_addr.sin_port = htons(5000);
    inet_pton(AF_INET, "192.168.1.100", &udp_conn.server_addr.sin_addr);

    if (connect(udp_conn.sock, (struct sockaddr *)&udp_conn.server_addr, sizeof(udp_conn.server_addr)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to connect to UDP server");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        uint8_t buf[3] = {BMP280_TEMP_REG, BMP280_PRES_REG, 0};
        if (bmp280_read_data(i2c_fd, buf) < 0) {
            continue;
        }

        int temp = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1];
        int pres = (buf[1] << 8) | buf[2];

        char json_buf[JSON_BUF_SIZE];
        bmp280_read_json(json_buf, &temp, &pres);

        if (sendto(udp_conn.sock, json_buf, strlen(json_buf), 0, (struct sockaddr *)&udp_conn.server_addr, sizeof(udp_conn.server_addr)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to send UDP message");
            continue;
        }

        sleep(5);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <unistd.h>

#include <linux/hwmon/hwmon2.h>
#include <linux/hwmon/hwmon2_reg.h>

#include <linux/hwmon/hwmon2_gpio.h>
#include <linux/hwmon/hwmon2_dev.h>
#include <linux/hwmon/hwmon2_dev_ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c/i2c-dev.h>
#include <linux/i2c/i2c_smbus.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <time.h>

#define BMP180_ADDR 0x76
#define I2C_BUS 1
#define GPIO24 24
#define ALERT_PIN GPIO24
#define BUFFER_SIZE 120
#define PRESSURE_OFFSET 0x88
#define PRESSURE_REG 0x08
#define PRESSURE_ALTITUDE_REG 0x0A
#define PRESSURE_SEALEVEL_PASCALS 1013.25

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    float pressure;
} PressureSample;

typedef struct {
    PressureSample buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    uint32_t head;
    uint32_t tail;
    uint32_t count;
    float average;
} PressureBuffer;

PressureBuffer pressureBuffer;

void i2cError(const char *message) {
    perror(message);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void gpioError(const char *message) {
    perror(message);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void timerError(const char *message) {
    perror(message);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handleI2CError(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        i2cError("Failed to open I2C device");
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handleGPIOError(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        gpioError("Failed to set GPIO24");
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handleTimerError(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        timerError("Failed to set timer");
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handleSIGINT(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT) {
        // Close I2C interface
        close(i2c_fd);
        // Reset GPIO24
        if (gpio_fd > 0) {
            ioctl(gpio_fd, HWMON2_GPIO_SET, 0);
        }
        // Terminate driver library
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

void initI2C() {
    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        handleI2CError("Failed to open I2C device");
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, BMP180_ADDR) < 0) {
        handleI2CError("Failed to set I2C slave address");
    }
}

void initGPIO() {
    gpio_fd = open("/dev/hwmon/hwmon2", O_RDWR);
    if (gpio_fd < 0) {
        gpioError("Failed to open GPIO device");
    }
    if (ioctl(gpio_fd, HWMON2_GPIO_GET, ALERT_PIN) == 0) {
        ioctl(gpio_fd, HWMON2_GPIO_SET, 0);
    } else {
        gpioError("GPIO24 is already set");
    }
}

void initTimer() {
    hwmon2_timer_fd = open("/sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/device/pwm1_enable", O_RDWR);
    if (hwmon2_timer_fd < 0) {
        timerError("Failed to open timer device");
    }
    if (ioctl(hwmon2_timer_fd, HWMON2_TIMER_SET, 0) < 0) {
        timerError("Failed to set timer");
    }
    hwmon2_timer_fd = open("/sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/device/pwm1", O_RDWR);
    if (hwmon2_timer_fd < 0) {
        timerError("Failed to open timer device");
    }
    if (ioctl(hwmon2_timer_fd, HWMON2_TIMER_SET, 50) < 0) {
        timerError("Failed to set timer");
    }
}

void initBuffer() {
    pressureBuffer.head = 0;
    pressureBuffer.tail = 0;
    pressureBuffer.count = 0;
    pressureBuffer.average = 0;
}

void addSample(uint32_t timestamp, float pressure) {
    if (pressureBuffer.count < BUFFER_SIZE) {
        pressureBuffer.buffer[pressureBuffer.head].timestamp = timestamp;
        pressureBuffer.buffer[pressureBuffer.head].pressure = pressure;
        pressureBuffer.head = (pressureBuffer.head + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
        pressureBuffer.count++;
    } else {
        pressureBuffer.tail = (pressureBuffer.tail + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
    }
}

void computeAverage() {
    float sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < pressureBuffer.count; i++) {
        sum += pressureBuffer.buffer[i].pressure;
    }
    pressureBuffer.average = sum / pressureBuffer.count;
}

void checkAlert() {
    if (pressureBuffer.count > 0) {
        float currentPressure = pressureBuffer.buffer[pressureBuffer.head].pressure;
        if (fabs(currentPressure - pressureBuffer.average) > 5) {
            if (gpio_fd > 0) {
                ioctl(gpio_fd, HWMON2_GPIO_SET, ALERT_PIN);
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "Alert: Pressure deviates by more than 5 hPa from average\n");
        }
    }
}

void readPressure() {
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, (uint8_t *) &pressure_reg, 1) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read pressure register\n");
        return;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, (uint8_t *) &pressure_altitude_reg, 1) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read altitude register\n");
        return;
    }
    float pressure = (float)((pressure_reg & 0xFF00) >> 8) * 256 + (float)(pressure_reg & 0xFF);
    pressure += (float)((pressure_altitude_reg & 0xFF00) >> 8) * 256 + (float)(pressure_altitude_reg & 0xFF);
    pressure -= PRESSURE_OFFSET;
    pressure /= 16384.0;
    pressure += PRESSURE_SEALEVEL_PASCALS;
    addSample(time(NULL), pressure);
    computeAverage();
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handleSIGINT);
    initI2C();
    initGPIO();
    initTimer();
    initBuffer();
    readPressure();
    while (1) {
        readPressure();
        checkAlert();
        usleep(500000); // 0.5 seconds
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include <pthread.h>
#include <semaphore.h>
#include <sys/errno.h>
#include <sys/time.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x5C
#define BUFFER_SIZE 60
#define GPIO18 18
#define LED_ON 1
#define LED_OFF 0

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int temp_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int buffer_index;
    int buffer_count;
    sem_t mutex;
    double running_avg;
} SensorData;

void *update_led(void *arg) {
    SensorData *sensor = (SensorData *)arg;
    while (1) {
        sem_wait(&sensor->mutex);
        double temp = sensor->running_avg;
        if (temp > 28.0) {
            digitalWrite(GPIO18, LED_ON);
        } else {
            digitalWrite(GPIO18, LED_OFF);
        }
        sem_post(&sensor->mutex);
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second
    }
    return NULL;
}

void *read_sensor(void *arg) {
    SensorData *sensor = (SensorData *)arg;
    while (1) {
        int i2c_fd = sensor->i2c_fd;
        if (i2c_fd < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C reinitialized\n");
            i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
            if (i2c_fd < 0) {
                perror("I2C open");
                return NULL;
            }
            ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
        }
        int result = i2c_smbus_read_byte_data(i2c_fd, 0x00);
        if (result < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C read error\n");
            i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
            if (i2c_fd < 0) {
                perror("I2C open");
                return NULL;
            }
            ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
        }
        sensor->temp_buffer[sensor->buffer_index] = (double)result;
        sensor->buffer_index = (sensor->buffer_index + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
        sensor->buffer_count = (sensor->buffer_count + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
        if (sensor->buffer_count == BUFFER_SIZE) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
                sum += sensor->temp_buffer[i];
            }
            sensor->running_avg = sum / BUFFER_SIZE;
        }
        sem_post(&sensor->mutex);
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second
    }
    return NULL;
}

void *init_gpio(void *arg) {
    SensorData *sensor = (SensorData *)arg;
    int fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("GPIO open");
        return NULL;
    }
    struct gpiod_chip *chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("GPIO chip open");
        return NULL;
    }
    struct gpiod_line *line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO18);
    if (!line) {
        perror("GPIO line open");
        return NULL;
    }
    if (line->direction != GPIOD_LINE_DIR_INPUT) {
        fprintf(stderr, "GPIO18 is not an input line\n");
        return NULL;
    }
    if (line->value != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "GPIO18 is not initially low\n");
        return NULL;
    }
    gpiod_chip_release_line(chip, line);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    sensor->gpio_fd = fd;
    return NULL;
}

void *cleanup(void *arg) {
    SensorData *sensor = (SensorData *)arg;
    if (sensor->gpio_fd >= 0) {
        close(sensor->gpio_fd);
    }
    if (sensor->i2c_fd >= 0) {
        close(sensor->i2c_fd);
    }
    free(sensor);
    return NULL;
}

int main() {
    SensorData *sensor = malloc(sizeof(SensorData));
    if (!sensor) {
        perror("Memory allocation");
        return 1;
    }
    sensor->fd = -1;
    sensor->i2c_fd = -1;
    sensor->buffer_index = 0;
    sensor->buffer_count = 0;
    sensor->running_avg = 0.0;
    sem_init(&sensor->mutex, 0, 1);

    pthread_t update_led_thread, read_sensor_thread;
    pthread_create(&update_led_thread, NULL, update_led, sensor);
    pthread_create(&read_sensor_thread, NULL, read_sensor, sensor);

    if (init_gpio(sensor) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO initialization");
        return 1;
    }

    sensor->fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (sensor->fd < 0) {
        perror("I2C open");
        return 1;
    }
    ioctl(sensor->fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);

    pthread_join(update_led_thread, NULL);
    pthread_join(read_sensor_thread, NULL);

    sem_destroy(&sensor->mutex);
    free(sensor);
    return 0;
}

**Note:** The `digitalWrite` function is not part of the standard C library. To use it, you need to include the `gpio.h` header file and link against the `libgpiod` library. The `digitalWrite` function is a wrapper for the `gpiod` library's `gpiod_line_set_value` function.

Here's how you can include and use `digitalWrite`:

```c
#include <gpiod.h>

void digitalWrite(int pin, int value) {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    int fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("GPIO open");
        return;
    }
    chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("GPIO chip open");
        return;
    }
    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, pin);
    if (!line) {
        perror("GPIO line open");
        return;
    }
    if (line->direction != GPIOD_LINE_DIR_INPUT) {
        fprintf(stderr, "GPIO%d is not an input line\n", pin);
        return;
    }
    if (line->value != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "GPIO%d is not initially low\n", pin);
        return;
    }
    gpiod_chip_release_line(chip, line);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    if (value == LED_ON) {
        line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, pin);
        if (line) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(chip, line, 1);
        }
    } else {
        line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, pin);
        if (line) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(chip, line, 0);
        }
    }
    gpiod_chip_release_line(chip, line);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
}

gcc -o sensor sensor.c -lgpiod -lpigpio -pthread
```

static int dht22_read_data(int pin) {
    int fd = -1;
    int data[40];
    int checksum = 0;
    int i;

    fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open SPI device");
        return -1;
    }

    // Set SPI mode to 0 (8-bit, 800 kHz)
    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_SET_MODE, 0) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SPI mode");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    // Set SPI speed to 800 kHz
    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_SET_SPEED, 8000000) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SPI speed");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    // Set SPI data mode to 0 (MSB first)
    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_SET_DATA_MODE, 0) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SPI data mode");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    // Set SPI bus to pin 4
    if (ioctl(fd, SPI_SET_CS, pin) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SPI bus to pin %d", pin);
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    // Pull the line low for at least 1 ms
    if (write(fd, &0, 1) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to pull line low");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    usleep(DHT22_TIMEOUT);

    // Capture the full 40-bit response
    for (i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        if (read(fd, &data[i], 1) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read data");
            close(fd);
            return -1;
        }
    }

    // Calculate the checksum
    for (i = 0; i < 40; i += 2) {
        checksum += data[i] << 8 | data[i + 1];
    }

    // Validate the checksum
    if (checksum != data[40] << 8 | data[41]) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Checksum mismatch");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    // Return the temperature and humidity values
    return (int)(data[0] << 8 | data[1]) / 10.0;

#define CPU_TEMP_FILE "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp"
#define COOLING_DEVICE_FILE "/sys/class/thermal/cooling_device0/cur_state"
#define MAX_STATE 3
#define LOG_FILE "/var/log/fan_control.log"
#define POLL_INTERVAL 5
#define LOG_FORMAT "[%d] %s: %s"

typedef enum {
    STATE_OFF,
    STATE_LOW,
    STATE_MEDIUM,
    STATE_HIGH
} FanState;

FanState speedMap[] = {STATE_OFF, STATE_LOW, STATE_MEDIUM, STATE_HIGH};

int coolingDeviceFd;
FanState currentState;
FanState desiredState;
char coolingDeviceName[256];
char coolingDeviceMaxState[256];

void initCoolingDevice() {
    int fd = open(COOLING_DEVICE_FILE, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open cooling device file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    coolingDeviceFd = fd;
    read(fd, coolingDeviceName, sizeof(coolingDeviceName));
    read(fd, coolingDeviceMaxState, sizeof(coolingDeviceMaxState));
    if (atoi(coolingDeviceMaxState) < 0 || atoi(coolingDeviceMaxState) > MAX_STATE) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid max state for cooling device %s\n", coolingDeviceName);
        close(fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    currentState = atoi(coolingDeviceMaxState);
}

void logEvent(const char *event, const char *message) {
    char logEntry[256];
    snprintf(logEntry, sizeof(logEntry), LOG_FORMAT, (int)time(NULL), event, message);
    FILE *logFile = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (logFile) {
        fprintf(logFile, "%s\n", logEntry);
        fclose(logFile);
    } else {
        perror("Failed to log event");
    }
}

void handleSignal(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        logEvent("Shutdown", "Received signal");
        write(coolingDeviceFd, "0", 1);
        close(coolingDeviceFd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

void updateFanState() {
    int temp;
    char tempStr[10];
    int fd = open(CPU_TEMP_FILE, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open CPU temperature file");
        return;
    }
    read(fd, tempStr, sizeof(tempStr));
    temp = atoi(tempStr);
    close(fd);

    desiredState = speedMap[temp / 10];
    if (desiredState < 0 || desiredState > MAX_STATE) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid temperature value for cooling device %s\n", coolingDeviceName);
        return;
    }

    if (desiredState != currentState) {
        logEvent("Fan state change", "Changing fan state to %d for cooling device %s", desiredState, coolingDeviceName);
        write(coolingDeviceFd, &desiredState, sizeof(desiredState));
        currentState = desiredState;
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handleSignal;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    initCoolingDevice();

    while (1) {
        updateFanState();
        sleep(POLL_INTERVAL);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <math.h>

#define PWM_PIN 18
#define PWM_FREQ 25000
#define PWM_DUTY_MIN 0
#define PWM_DUTY_MAX 100
#define LOG_FILE "cooling_log.csv"

typedef struct {
    int fd_pwm;
    int fd_temp;
    int fd_log;
    struct timeval start_time;
    double temp;
    double duty_cycle;
} CoolingState;

void cleanup(CoolingState *state) {
    if (state->fd_pwm > 0) {
        ioctl(state->fd_pwm, PWM_SET_DUTY, 0);
        close(state->fd_pwm);
    }
    if (state->fd_temp > 0) {
        close(state->fd_temp);
    }
    if (state->fd_log > 0) {
        close(state->fd_log);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum, siginfo_t *siginfo, void *context) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        CoolingState state;
        state.fd_pwm = ioctl(open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR), GPIO_GET_DEVICE, PWM);
        if (state.fd_pwm > 0) {
            ioctl(state.fd_pwm, PWM_SET_DUTY, 0);
            cleanup(&state);
            exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    CoolingState state;
    state.fd_pwm = ioctl(open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR), GPIO_GET_DEVICE, PWM);
    if (state.fd_pwm <= 0) {
        perror("Failed to open PWM device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    state.fd_temp = open("/dev/input/thermal", O_RDONLY);
    if (state.fd_temp <= 0) {
        perror("Failed to open temperature device");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    state.fd_log = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (state.fd_log <= 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (write(state.fd_log, "timestamp,temperature,duty_cycle\n", 32) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write header to log file");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct gpio_pwm *gpio_pwm = (struct gpio_pwm *)malloc(sizeof(struct gpio_pwm));
    gpio_pwm->fd = state.fd_pwm;
    gpio_pwm->freq = PWM_FREQ;
    gpio_pwm->duty = 0;
    ioctl(state.fd_pwm, PWM_SET_DUTY, gpio_pwm->duty);

    struct gpio_thermal *gpio_thermal = (struct gpio_thermal *)malloc(sizeof(struct gpio_thermal));
    gpio_thermal->fd = state.fd_temp;
    ioctl(gpio_thermal->fd, GPIO_GET_TEMPERATURE, &gpio_thermal->temp);

    gettimeofday(&state.start_time, NULL);

    while (1) {
        struct gpio_thermal *gpio_thermal = (struct gpio_thermal *)malloc(sizeof(struct gpio_thermal));
        gpio_thermal->fd = state.fd_temp;
        ioctl(gpio_thermal->fd, GPIO_GET_TEMPERATURE, &gpio_thermal->temp);

        gettimeofday(&state.start_time, NULL);
        double timestamp = (state.start_time.tv_sec + state.start_time.tv_usec / 1e6) * 1000;

        double duty_cycle = interpolate_temp(gpio_thermal->temp);
        if (duty_cycle < 0 || duty_cycle > 100) {
            duty_cycle = 0;
        }

        if (write(state.fd_log, "%f,%f,%f\n", timestamp, gpio_thermal->temp, duty_cycle) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to log file");
            cleanup(&state);
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        ioctl(state.fd_pwm, PWM_SET_DUTY, duty_cycle);

        sleep(5);
    }

    cleanup(&state);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

double interpolate_temp(double temp) {
    if (temp <= 40) {
        return 0;
    } else if (temp >= 70) {
        return 100;
    } else {
        return (temp - 40) / (70 - 40) * (100 - 0) + 0;
    }
}

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int flow1_fd;
    int flow2_fd;
} I2CHandle;

void handle_i2c_error(int fd, int err) {
    if (err) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C error on %d: %d\n", fd, err);
        close(fd);
    }
}

void handle_flow_error(int fd, int err) {
    if (err) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Flow error on %d: %d\n", fd, err);
        close(fd);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        I2CHandle handle;
        handle.fd = 0;
        handle.flow1_fd = 0;
        handle.flow2_fd = 0;

        if (handle.flow1_fd != 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(handle.flow1_fd, -1);
        }
        if (handle.flow2_fd != 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(handle.flow2_fd, -1);
        }

        gpiod_exit();
        exit(0);
    }
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO18 18
#define LOG_FILE "encoder_log.txt"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
} EncoderState;

void cleanup(EncoderState *state) {
    if (state->fd != -1) {
        close(state->fd);
    }
    if (state->chip) {
        gpiod_chip_unexport(state->chip);
        gpiod_chip_free(state->chip);
    }
    if (state->line) {
        gpiod_line_free(state->line);
    }
    if (state->edge) {
        gpiod_edge_free(state->edge);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    cleanup((EncoderState *)NULL);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    EncoderState state;
    state.fd = -1;
    state.chip = NULL;
    state.line = NULL;
    state.edge = NULL;

    // Initialize GPIO
    state.fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (state.fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct gpiod_chip *chip = gpiod_chip_open(state.fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod_chip");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct gpiod_line *line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO17 line");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct gpiod_edge *edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (!edge) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO17 edge");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Configure GPIO17 as open-drain output with internal pull-up
    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line, GPIOD_LINE_PULL_UP) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO17 pull-up");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line, GPIOD_LINE_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO17 mode");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Initialize GPIO18
    line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO18, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO18 line");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (!edge) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO18 edge");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Configure GPIO18 as open-drain output with internal pull-up
    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line, GPIOD_LINE_PULL_UP) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO18 pull-up");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line, GPIOD_LINE_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO18 mode");
        cleanup(&state);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Initialize state machine
    int a, b, count = 0, position = 0, last_time = 0, last_count = 0;
    char buffer[256];

    while (1) {
        // Read current state
        a = gpiod_line_read(line);
        b = gpiod_line_read(gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO18, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN)->edge->line->edge->line);

        // Update timestamp
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        if (now == last_time) {
            continue;
        }
        last_time = now;

        // Update position
        if (a != last_count || b != last_count) {
            count = (a << 1) | b;
            position = (count * 360) / 256;
            if (position > 360) {
                position = 360;
            }
            if (position < 0) {
                position = 0;
            }

            // Log position
            snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%ld %f\n", now, position);
            write(state.fd, buffer, strlen(buffer));

            // Reset last_count
            last_count = count;
        }
    }

    cleanup(&state);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <string.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x0d
#define SENSOR_LOG_FILE "adpd144ri_log.txt"
#define IR_THRESHOLD 2000
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 100

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    uint16_t red;
    uint16_t ir;
} SensorReading;

void log_sensor_reading(const char *filename, const SensorReading *reading) {
    FILE *file = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (!file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(file, "%ld,%u,%u\n", reading->timestamp, reading->red, reading->ir);
    fclose(file);
}

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", err);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sensor_absent() {
    fprintf(stderr, "Sensor absent\n");
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Received SIGINT signal, shutting down\n");
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Received SIGTERM signal, shutting down\n");
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct iocb iocb;
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    int i2c_fd;
    int err;
    SensorReading reading;
    time_t timestamp;
    int gpio17_fd;
    int ir_exceeded = 0;
    struct sigaction sa;

    // Set up signal handlers
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    // Open I2C bus
    snprintf(msg[0].addr, I2C_ADDR, I2C_ADDR);
    snprintf(msg[0].buf, I2C_BUF_SIZE, "0x00");
    msg[0].len = I2C_BUF_SIZE;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up I2C communication
    err = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (err < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(err);
    }

    // Initialize I2C message structure
    memset(&iocb, 0, sizeof(iocb));
    iocb.mio.iov_base = msg;
    iocb.mio.iov_len = 2;

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read sensor data
        timestamp = time(NULL);
        reading.timestamp = timestamp;
        err = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, &iocb);
        if (err < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(err);
        }

        // Parse I2C data
        if (msg[0].buf[0] == 0x00) {
            reading.red = (msg[1].buf[0] << 8) | msg[1].buf[1];
            reading.ir = (msg[2].buf[0] << 8) | msg[2].buf[1];
        } else {
            handle_sensor_absent();
        }

        // Log sensor reading
        log_sensor_reading(SENSOR_LOG_FILE, &reading);

        // Check IR threshold
        if (reading.ir > IR_THRESHOLD) {
            ir_exceeded = 1;
        } else {
            ir_exceeded = 0;
        }

        // Write to GPIO17
        gpio17_fd = open("/dev/gpiod/major:17", O_WRONLY);
        if (gpio17_fd < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open GPIO17");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (ir_exceeded) {
            write(gpio17_fd, "1", 1);
        } else {
            write(gpio17_fd, "0", 1);
        }
        close(gpio17_fd);

        // Sleep for sample interval
        usleep(SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <math.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_DEVICE_ADDRESS 0x40
#define ADPD144RI_SENSOR_ID 0x00
#define ADPD144RI_INFRARED_REG 0x00
#define ADPD144RI_THRESHOLD 2000
#define LED_GPIO 17

#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_ERROR -1
#define I2C_SUCCESS 0
#define I2C_READ_ERROR -2
#define I2C_WRITE_ERROR -3
#define I2C_CONNECTION_ERROR -4
#define I2C_BUS_NOT_FOUND -5

#define LOG_FILE "adpd144ri_log.txt"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int sensor_fd;
    int led_fd;
    int log_fd;
    int running;
    int timeout;
    struct timeval last_read;
} ADPD144RIConfig;

void adpd144ri_log(int value) {
    static FILE *log_file = NULL;
    static char buffer[256];
    static int first_read = 1;

    if (!log_file) {
        log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "w");
        if (!log_file) {
            perror("Failed to open log file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    if (first_read) {
        fprintf(log_file, "timestamp,reading\n");
        first_read = 0;
    }

    gettimeofday(&adpd144ri_log->last_read, NULL);
    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%ld,%d\n", adpd144ri_log->last_read.tv_sec, value);
    if (fwrite(buffer, 1, strlen(buffer), log_file) != strlen(buffer)) {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
        fclose(log_file);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void adpd144ri_read(int sensor_fd, int *reading) {
    int i2c_error = 0;
    uint8_t buffer[1];
    uint16_t value;

    for (i2c_error = 0; i2c_error < I2C_TIMEOUT; i2c_error++) {
        if (read(sensor_fd, buffer, 1) < 0) {
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
                usleep(100000); // 100ms
            } else {
                i2c_error = I2C_READ_ERROR;
                break;
            }
        } else if (buffer[0] != ADPD144RI_SENSOR_ID) {
            i2c_error = I2C_CONNECTION_ERROR;
            break;
        } else {
            value = (uint16_t) buffer[0];
            *reading = value;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (i2c_error) {
        if (i2c_error == I2C_CONNECTION_ERROR) {
            perror("Failed to read from I2C device");
        } else {
            perror("Failed to read from I2C device");
        }
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void adpd144ri_write(int sensor_fd, uint8_t *buffer, int length) {
    int i2c_error = 0;
    uint8_t *ptr = buffer;
    int bytes_written = 0;

    for (i2c_error = 0; i2c_error < I2C_TIMEOUT; i2c_error++) {
        if (write(sensor_fd, ptr, length) < 0) {
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
                usleep(100000); // 100ms
            } else {
                i2c_error = I2C_WRITE_ERROR;
                break;
            }
        } else {
            bytes_written = length;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (i2c_error) {
        if (i2c_error == I2C_WRITE_ERROR) {
            perror("Failed to write to I2C device");
        } else {
            perror("Failed to write to I2C device");
        }
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void adpd144ri_init(ADPD144RIConfig *config) {
    config->fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (config->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->sensor_fd = config->fd;
    config->led_fd = open("/dev/gpiod/major:28/device", O_RDWR);
    if (config->led_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO17");
        close(config->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (config->log_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        close(config->fd);
        close(config->led_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->running = 1;
    config->timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT;
    gettimeofday(&config->last_read, NULL);
}

void adpd144ri_cleanup(ADPD144RIConfig *config) {
    if (config->running) {
        adpd144ri_stop(config);
    }

    if (config->sensor_fd >= 0) {
        close(config->sensor_fd);
    }

    if (config->led_fd >= 0) {
        close(config->led_fd);
    }

    if (config->log_fd >= 0) {
        close(config->log_fd);
    }

    close(config->fd);
}

void adpd144ri_stop(ADPD144RIConfig *config) {
    if (config->running) {
        config->running = 0;
        adpd144ri_cleanup(config);
    }
}

void adpd144ri_signal_handler(int signal) {
    adpd144ri_stop(&config);
    adpd144ri_cleanup(&config);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    ADPD144RIConfig config;

    signal(SIGINT, adpd144ri_signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, adpd144ri_signal_handler);

    adpd144ri_init(&config);

    while (config.running) {
        int reading = 0;
        adpd144ri_read(config.sensor_fd, &reading);

        adpd144ri_log(reading);

        if (reading > ADPD144RI_THRESHOLD) {
            if (write(config.led_fd, &LED_GPIO, sizeof(LED_GPIO)) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to write to GPIO17");
                close(config.sensor_fd);
                close(config.led_fd);
                close(config.log_fd);
                close(config.fd);
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }

        usleep(100000); // 100ms
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x34

#define IAQ_INDEX ((eCO2 * 0.1) + (TVOC * 0.2) + 50)

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int eCO2;
    int TVOC;
} SensorData;

void sigint_handler(int signum) {
    if (SensorData->fd > 0) {
        close(SensorData->fd);
    }
    if (SensorData->eCO2 > 0) {
        close(SensorData->eCO2);
    }
    if (SensorData->TVOC > 0) {
        close(SensorData->TVOC);
    }
    if (SensorData->fp > 0) {
        fclose(SensorData->fp);
    }
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct iocb iocb;
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg rdwr_msg;
    SensorData sensor_data;
    char line[256];
    FILE *fp;

    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);

    sensor_data.fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (sensor_data.fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&iocb, 0, sizeof(iocb));
    iocb.mostsignificantbyte = I2C_MSB;
    iocb.ioctl = I2C_SMBUS_READBYTE;
    iocb.addr = I2C_ADDR;

    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x00;

    if (ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_SMBUS_I2CMSG ioctl, msg, 1, &rdwr_msg) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to send I2C message");
        return 1;
    }

    if (rdwr_msg.msgs_num > 0) {
        if (rdwr_msg.msgs[0].err) {
            perror("I2C read error");
            return 1;
        }
        sensor_data.eCO2 = msg[0].data[0];
        if (sensor_data.eCO2 == 0) {
            printf("eCO2 sensor not detected\n");
            return 1;
        }
    } else {
        printf("I2C read failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&iocb, 0, sizeof(iocb));
    iocb.mostsignificantbyte = I2C_MSB;
    iocb.ioctl = I2C_SMBUS_READBYTE;
    iocb.addr = I2C_ADDR;

    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x01;

    if (ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_SMBUS_I2CMSG ioctl, msg, 1, &rdwr_msg) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to send I2C message");
        return 1;
    }

    if (rdwr_msg.msgs_num > 0) {
        if (rdwr_msg.msgs[0].err) {
            perror("I2C read error");
            return 1;
        }
        sensor_data.TVOC = msg[0].data[0];
        if (sensor_data.TVOC == 0) {
            printf("TVOC sensor not detected\n");
            return 1;
        }
    } else {
        printf("I2C read failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    fp = fopen("air_quality_log.csv", "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        sprintf(line, "%d,%d\n", IAQ_INDEX, sensor_data.TVOC);
        if (fwrite(line, strlen(line), 1, fp) != 1) {
            perror("Failed to write to log file");
            return 1;
        }

        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds

        if (sensor_data.eCO2 > 0) {
            ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_SMBUS_I2CMSG ioctl, msg, 1, &rdwr_msg);
            if (rdwr_msg.msgs_num > 0) {
                if (rdwr_msg.msgs[0].err) {
                    perror("I2C read error");
                    return 1;
                }
                sensor_data.eCO2 = msg[0].data[0];
            } else {
                printf("I2C read failed\n");
                return 1;
            }
        } else {
            printf("eCO2 sensor not detected\n");
            return 1;
        }

        if (sensor_data.TVOC > 0) {
            ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_SMBUS_I2CMSG ioctl, msg, 1, &rdwr_msg);
            if (rdwr_msg.msgs_num > 0) {
                if (rdwr_msg.msgs[0].err) {
                    perror("I2C read error");
                    return 1;
                }
                sensor_data.TVOC = msg[0].data[0];
            } else {
                printf("I2C read failed\n");
                return 1;
            }
        } else {
            printf("TVOC sensor not detected\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO_MAJOR 4
#define GPIO_MINOR 0
#define GPIO_BASE 0x40000000
#define GPIO_OFFSET 0x20000000

#define TTP223_TAMPER "ttp223_tamper"

#define TTP223_TIMEOUT 500000000  // 5 seconds in nanoseconds

int ttp223_fd;
struct gpiod_chip *chip;
struct gpiod_line *line;
struct gpiod_edge *edge;
struct gpiod_event *event;
struct timespec timeout;

void cleanup(void) {
    if (line) {
        gpiod_line_put(line);
        line = NULL;
    }
    if (edge) {
        gpiod_edge_put(edge);
        edge = NULL;
    }
    if (event) {
        gpiod_event_put(event);
        event = NULL;
    }
    if (chip) {
        gpiod_chip_put(chip);
        chip = NULL;
    }
    if (ttp223_fd > 0) {
        close(ttp223_fd);
        ttp223_fd = -1;
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main(void) {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    timeout.tv_sec = 0;
    timeout.tv_nsec = TTP223_TIMEOUT;

    ttp223_fd = open("/dev/input/touchscreen", O_RDONLY);
    if (ttp223_fd < 0) {
        perror("open touchscreen");
        cleanup();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_open(GPIO_MAJOR, GPIO_MINOR, GPIO_BASE, GPIO_OFFSET);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        cleanup();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, TTP223_TAMPER);
    if (!line) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        cleanup();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (!edge) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        cleanup();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    event = gpiod_edge_request_event(edge, 0);
    if (!event) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_request_event");
        cleanup();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_edge_enable(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) {
        printf("Edge detection enabled\n");
    } else {
        perror("gpiod_edge_enable");
        cleanup();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        poll(&timeout, 1, 100);
        if (ttp223_fd < 0) {
            perror("ttp223_fd");
            cleanup();
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (gpiod_event_get(event)) {
            if (gpiod_line_get_value(line) == 1) {
                // Touch detected
                printf("Touch detected\n");
                clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &timeout);
                while (timeout.tv_sec < 5) {
                    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &timeout);
                    if (timeout.tv_sec >= 5) {
                        printf("Intrusion detected\n");
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

                    gpiod_line_free(line);
                    gpiod_edge_free(edge);
                    gpiod_event_free(event);
                    gpiod_loop_free(loop);
                    gpiod_chip_request_pwm(chip, line, &loop);
                    gpiod_chip_request_pwm_frequency(chip, line, loop, PWM_FREQ);
                    gpiod_chip_request_pwm_mode(chip, line, loop, GPIOD_PWM_MODE_ON);
                    gpiod_chip_request_pwm_duty(chip, line, loop, 0);
                    gpiod_chip_request_pwm_period(chip, line, loop, 1000000 / PWM_FREQ);
                    gpiod_chip_request_pwm_start(chip, line, loop, 1);
                    result = gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
                    if (result < 0) {

                        close(fd);
                        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
                        gpiod_line_free(line);
                        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
                        gpiod_event_free(event);
                        gpiod_loop_free(loop);
                        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
                    }
                    strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&tv.tv_sec));

                        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
                        gpiod_event_free(event);
                        gpiod_loop_free(loop);
                        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;

void i2c_init() {
    i2c_handle.fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_handle.fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_handle.fd, I2C_SLAVE, OPT3001_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    i2c_handle.i2c_timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT;
}

void i2c_cleanup() {
    if (i2c_handle.fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_handle.fd);
    }
}

void i2c_read_data(uint8_t *buf, int length) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        buf[i] = 0;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        if (i2c_handle.i2c_timeout > 0) {
            i2c_handle.i2c_timeout--;
            if (i2c_handle.i2c_timeout == 0) {
                perror("I2C timeout");
                return;
            }
        } else {
            i2c_handle.i2c_timeout = I2C_TIMEOUT;
        }

        if (write(i2c_handle.fd, buf + i, 1) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to I2C device");
            return;
        }

        if (read(i2c_handle.fd, buf + i, 1) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read from I2C device");
            return;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < TTP226_MAX_LINES; i++) {
        if (line_fd[i] > 0) {
            close(line_fd[i]);

        line_state[i] = 0;

        struct pollfd pollfds[TTP226_MAX_LINES + 1];

    if (TMAG5170->csv_file) {

    }
    TMAG5170->initialized = false;
    TMAG5170->csv_opened = false;
    free(TMAG5170);
}

    TMAG5170 *tmag5170 = malloc(sizeof(TMAG5170));
    if (!tmag5170) {
        perror("Memory allocation failed");
        return 1;
    }

    tmag5170->i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (tmag5170->i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;

        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;
    }

    tmag5170->initialized = true;

    // Configure sensor
    uint8_t config = 0x00;
    config |= TMAG5170_CNTL_REG_ENABLE;
    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &config, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure sensor");
        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;
    }

    config = 0x01;
    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &config, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {

        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &config, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {

        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;

    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &config, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set range to 50 mT");
        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;

    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &tmag5170->x, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {

        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;
    }
    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &tmag5170->y, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {

        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;

    if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &tmag5170->z, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {

        return 1;

    if (!tmag5170->csv_file) {

        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;

    if (!fputs("timestamp,X,Y,Z\n", tmag5170->csv_file)) {

        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;

    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to register SIGINT handler");
        free(tmag5170);
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read sensor values
        if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &tmag5170->x, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read X value");
            continue;
        }
        if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &tmag5170->y, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read Y value");
            continue;
        }
        if (ioctl(tmag5170->i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &tmag5170->z, TMAG5170_ADDR) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read Z value");
            continue;
        }

        // Read timestamp
        char timestamp[20];
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&now));

        // Write to CSV file
        if (fprintf(tmag5170->csv_file, "%s,%d,%d,%d\n", timestamp, tmag5170->x, tmag5170->y, tmag5170->z) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to CSV file");
            free(tmag5170);
            return 1;
        }

        // Sleep for 100 ms
        usleep(100000);
    }

    free(tmag5170);
    return 0;
}

    int sensorB;

    int direction;

                        sem_post(&sensor->mutex);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        sem_post(&sensor->mutex);
        usleep(1000); // 1ms
    }
    return NULL;
}

    ret = gpiod_set_direction(led2_fd, GPIOD_DIR_OUT);

        return ret;
    }

    ret = gpiod_set_value(led1_fd, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_set_value");
        return ret;
    }

    ret = gpiod_set_value(led2_fd, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_set_value");
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int init_sensors(void) {
    int ret;

    ret = gpiod_set_direction(sensor1_fd, GPIOD_DIR_IN);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_set_direction");
        return ret;
    }

    ret = gpiod_set_direction(sensor2_fd, GPIOD_DIR_IN);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_set_direction");
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int read_sensor(int fd, int *value) {
    int ret;

    ret = gpiod_get_value(fd, value);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_get_value");
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int write_led(int fd, int value) {
    int ret;

    ret = gpiod_set_value(fd, value);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_set_value");
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int handle_touch_event(int pin, long timestamp, int state) {
    TouchEvent event;
    event.pin = pin;
    event.timestamp = timestamp;
    event.state = state;

    if (buffer_index < BUFFER_SIZE) {
        buffer[buffer_index] = event;
        buffer_index = (buffer_index + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
    } else {
        overflow_count++;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int cleanup_gpio(void) {
    int ret;

    ret = gpiod_destroy(sensor1_fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_destroy");
        return ret;
    }

    ret = gpiod_destroy(sensor2_fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_destroy");
        return ret;
    }

    ret = gpiod_destroy(led1_fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_destroy");
        return ret;
    }

    ret = gpiod_destroy(led2_fd);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_destroy");
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        write_led(led1_fd, 0);
        write_led(led2_fd, 0);
        cleanup_gpio();
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Shutdown complete. Logging buffer contents:");
        for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
            TouchEvent event = buffer[i];
            if (event.state == 1) {
                syslog(LOG_INFO, "Sensor %d touched at %ld", event.pin, event.timestamp);
            } else {
                syslog(LOG_INFO, "Sensor %d released at %ld", event.pin, event.timestamp);
            }
        }
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Overflow count: %d", overflow_count);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct timeval tv;
    int ret;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    init_gpio();
    init_leds();
    init_sensors();

    while (1) {
        tv.tv_sec = 0;
        tv.tv_usec = DEBOUNCE_MS * 1000;
        ret = gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("gettimeofday");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        int value1, value2;
        read_sensor(sensor1_fd, &value1);
        read_sensor(sensor2_fd, &value2);

        int state1 = value1 ? 1 : 0;
        int state2 = value2 ? 1 : 0;

        if (state1 != buffer[buffer_index - 1].state || state2 != buffer[buffer_index - 1].state) {
            handle_touch_event(SENSOR1_PIN, tv.tv_sec * 1000 + tv.tv_usec / 1000, state1);
            handle_touch_event(SENSOR2_PIN, tv.tv_sec * 1000 + tv.tv_usec / 1000, state2);
        }

        if (state1 == 1) {
            write_led(led1_fd, 1);
        } else {
            write_led(led1_fd, 0);
        }

        if (state2 == 1) {
            write_led(led2_fd, 1);
        } else {
            write_led(led2_fd, 0);
        }

        usleep(DEBOUNCE_MS * 1000);
    }

    return EXIT_FAILURE;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>

#include <signal.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define LOG_FILE "/var/log/rain_events.log"
#define LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %s"

int main() {
    int fd, state, prev_state = 1;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct timespec ts;
    char message[256];
    FILE *log_file;

    fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open /dev/gpiod");
        return 1;
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO17);
    if (!line) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    line->direction = GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN;
    line->edge = GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_RISING;
    line->pull = GPIOD_LINE_PUD_UP;
    if (gpiod_line_request_edge(chip, line, edge)) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        return 1;
    }

    log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("fopen");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        state = gpiod_line_get_value(line);
        if (state != prev_state) {
            prev_state = state;
            if (state == 0) {
                strftime(message, sizeof(message), LOG_FORMAT, localtime(&ts.tv_sec));
                fprintf(log_file, "%s Rain Detected\n", message);
            } else {
                fprintf(log_file, "%s No Rain\n", message);
            }
            fflush(log_file);
        }
        nanosleep(&ts, &ts);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, [](int sig) {
        if (log_file) {
            fclose(log_file);
        }
        gpiod_line_request_edge(chip, line, 0);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        close(fd);
    });

    signal(SIGTERM, [](int sig) {
        if (log_file) {
            fclose(log_file);
        }
        gpiod_line_request_edge(chip, line, 0);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        close(fd);
    });

    return 0;
}

void i2c_init() {

        gpiod_line_put(line, GPIOD_LINE_CTRL, GPIOD_LINE_STATE_OFF);

    sa.sa_flags = 0;

        perror("Failed to request event");

    if (event == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to request event");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    char buffer[128];

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <errno.h>

#define LOG_FILE "path_log.csv"
#define SENSOR_COUNT 3
#define SAMPLE_RATE_MS 50
#define BUFFER_SIZE 1024

typedef struct {
    int timestamp;
    int left;
    int middle;
    int right;
} SensorReading;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    // Release GPIO lines
    for (int i = 0; i < SENSOR_COUNT; i++) {
        int fd = gpio_get_fd(i);
        if (fd != -1) {
            gpio_free(fd);
        }
    }

    // Close the GPIO chip
    int fd = gpio_get_fd(-1);
    if (fd != -1) {
        gpio_close(fd);
    }

    // Flush and close the log file
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file) {
        fclose(log_file);
    }

    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    // Register the signal handler
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    // Initialize GPIO library
    int gpio_fd = gpio_init();
    if (gpio_fd == -1) {
        perror("gpio_init failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up the log file
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "w");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("fopen failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up the timestamp format
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    char timestamp_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    strftime(timestamp_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f", localtime(&tv.tv_sec));

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Get current time
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        char timestamp_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
        strftime(timestamp_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f", localtime(&tv.tv_sec));

        // Read sensor values
        SensorReading readings[SENSOR_COUNT];
        for (int i = 0; i < SENSOR_COUNT; i++) {
            int fd = gpio_get_fd(i);
            if (fd == -1) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get GPIO fd for sensor %d\n", i);
                continue;
            }
            int value = gpio_get_value(fd);
            readings[i].timestamp = tv.tv_sec * 1000 + tv.tv_usec / 1000;
            readings[i].left = (i == 0) ? value : 0;
            readings[i].middle = (i == 1) ? value : 0;
            readings[i].right = (i == 2) ? value : 0;
        }

        // Write to log file
        for (int i = 0; i < SENSOR_COUNT; i++) {
            fprintf(log_file, "%s,%d,%d,%d\n", timestamp_buffer, readings[i].left, readings[i].middle, readings[i].right);
        }

        // Sleep for sample rate
        usleep(SAMPLE_RATE_MS * 1000);
    }

    // Clean up
    fclose(log_file);
    gpio_close(gpio_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define FLAME_SENSOR_GPIO 17
#define BUZZER_GPIO 18
#define ALERT_LOG_FILE "alert_log.txt"
#define BUZZER_ON_TIME 2000  // 2 seconds

int flame_sensor_fd;
int buzzer_fd;
FILE *log_file;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (log_file) {
            fprintf(log_file, "System stopped\n");
            fclose(log_file);
        }
        if (buzzer_fd) {
            gpio_set_value(buzzer_fd, GPIO_EDGE_OFF);
        }
        if (flame_sensor_fd) {
            gpiod_device_free(flame_sensor_fd);
        }
        if (buzzer_fd) {
            gpiod_device_free(buzzer_fd);
        }
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct timespec ts;
    char log_buffer[256];
    time_t now;

    // Initialize signal handlers
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    // Initialize GPIO driver
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, FLAME_SENSOR_GPIO)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIO_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((flame_sensor_fd = gpiod_line_fd(line)) == -1) {
        perror("gpiod_line_fd");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((buzzer_fd = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, BUZZER_GPIO)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((buzzer_edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(buzzer_fd, GPIO_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((buzzer_fd = gpiod_line_fd(buzzer_fd)) == -1) {
        perror("gpiod_line_fd");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up logging
    if (!(log_file = fopen(ALERT_LOG_FILE, "a"))) {
        perror("fopen");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Write startup message
    fprintf(log_file, "System started\n");
    fclose(log_file);

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read sensor value
        if (gpiod_line_get_value(flame_sensor_fd, &now, NULL) == -1) {
            perror("gpiod_line_get_value");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        // Check for HIGH-to-LOW transition
        if (now == 1) {
            // Log the event
            ts.tv_sec = now / 1000;
            ts.tv_nsec = (now % 1000) * 1000000;
            strftime(log_buffer, sizeof(log_buffer), "FLAME DETECTED %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\n", localtime(&ts.tv_sec));
            fprintf(log_file, log_buffer);
            fclose(log_file);
            fprintf(log_file, "FLAME DETECTED\n");
            // Buzz the buzzer
            if (gpio_set_value(buzzer_fd, GPIO_EDGE_ON) == -1) {
                perror("gpio_set_value");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
            sleep(BUZZER_ON_TIME / 1000);
            if (gpio_set_value(buzzer_fd, GPIO_EDGE_OFF) == -1) {
                perror("gpio_set_value");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }

        // Sleep for 100ms
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define SENSOR_1 1
#define SENSOR_2 2
#define LOG_FILE "/var/log/tilt_events.log"
#define LOG_FORMAT "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, Sensor %d tilted\n"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
} Sensor;

void handle_sensor_error(Sensor *sensor, int error) {
    if (error == -EIO) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Chip open failure\n");
    } else if (error == -EBUSY) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Line request failure\n");
    } else if (error == -ENODEV) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Read error\n");
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "Unknown error\n");
    }
    free(sensor);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        for (Sensor *sensor = sensors; sensor; sensor = sensor->next) {
            if (sensor->line) {
                gpiod_line_close(sensor->line);
            }
            free(sensor);
        }
        close(log_fd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line1, *line2;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge1, *edge2;
    struct gpiod_event *event1, *event2;
    struct gpiod_loop *loop;
    struct gpiod_loop *loop1, *loop2;
    struct gpiod_loop *current_loop;
    struct gpiod_event *current_event;
    struct timeval tv;
    char buffer[128];
    FILE *log_fd = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_fd) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_signal) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to install SIGINT handler");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to install SIGTERM handler");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if ((line1 = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, 17, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error((Sensor *)NULL, -EBUSY);
        goto cleanup;
    }
    if ((line2 = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, 18, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error((Sensor *)NULL, -EBUSY);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    Sensor *sensor1 = malloc(sizeof(Sensor));
    sensor1->fd = line1->fd;
    sensor1->chip = chip;
    sensor1->line = line1;
    Sensor *sensor2 = malloc(sizeof(Sensor));
    sensor2->fd = line2->fd;
    sensor2->chip = chip;
    sensor2->line = line2;

    if ((edge1 = gpiod_line_request_edge(line1, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error(sensor1, -EIO);
        goto cleanup;
    }
    if ((edge2 = gpiod_line_request_edge(line2, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error(sensor2, -EIO);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((event1 = gpiod_edge_request_event(edge1, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 0)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error(sensor1, -EIO);
        goto cleanup;
    }
    if ((event2 = gpiod_edge_request_event(edge2, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 0)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error(sensor2, -EIO);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((loop1 = gpiod_event_request_loop(event1, GPIOD_LOOP_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error(sensor1, -EIO);
        goto cleanup;
    }
    if ((loop2 = gpiod_event_request_loop(event2, GPIOD_LOOP_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        handle_sensor_error(sensor2, -EIO);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    current_loop = loop1;
    current_event = event1;

    tv.tv_sec = 0;
    tv.tv_usec = 50;

    while (1) {
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        if (tv.tv_sec >= 1) {
            tv.tv_sec = 0;
            tv.tv_usec = 0;
        }

        if (gpiod_loop_poll(current_loop, &tv) == 0) {
            if (current_event->edge == GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING) {
                if (current_event->line == line1) {
                    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), LOG_FORMAT, SENSOR_1);
                    fprintf(log_fd, buffer);
                } else if (current_event->line == line2) {
                    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), LOG_FORMAT, SENSOR_2);
                    fprintf(log_fd, buffer);
                }
            }
        }

        current_event = gpiod_loop_get_next_event(current_loop);
    }

cleanup:
    if (current_event) {
        gpiod_event_free(current_event);
    }
    if (current_loop) {
        gpiod_loop_free(current_loop);
    }
    if (loop1) {
        gpiod_loop_free(loop1);
    }
    if (loop2) {
        gpiod_loop_free(loop2);
    }
    if (event1) {
        gpiod_event_free(event1);
    }
    if (event2) {
        gpiod_event_free(event2);
    }
    if (edge1) {
        gpiod_edge_free(edge1);
    }
    if (edge2) {
        gpiod_edge_free(edge2);
    }
    if (line1) {
        gpiod_line_close(line1);
    }
    if (line2) {
        gpiod_line_close(line2);
    }
    if (sensor1) {
        free(sensor1);
    }
    if (sensor2) {
        free(sensor2);
    }
    if (chip) {
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    }
    fclose(log_fd);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;

} GPIO;

    GPIO *gpio = (GPIO *)malloc(sizeof(GPIO));
    gpio->fd = -1;
    gpio->chip = NULL;
    gpio->line = NULL;
    gpio->value = 0;

    if (gpio->line) {
        gpiod_line_free(gpio->line);
    }
    if (gpio->chip) {
        gpiod_chip_free(gpio->chip);
    }
    free(gpio);

    if (gpio->fd != -1) {
        close(gpio->fd);
    }

    if (gpio->line) {
        gpiod_line_unref(gpio->line);
    }
    if (gpio->chip) {
        gpiod_chip_unref(gpio->chip);
    }

    if (gpio->fd != -1) {
        close(gpio->fd);
    }

    printf("Graceful shutdown initiated.\n");
    gpio->value = 0;
    if (gpio->line) {
        gpiod_line_set_value(gpio->line, gpio->value);
    }
    if (gpio->chip) {
        gpiod_chip_unexport(gpio->chip);

    if (gpio->fd != -1) {
        close(gpio->fd);

    free(gpio);

    if ((line2 = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip2, GPIO27)) == NULL) {

    if ((gpio2.line = gpiod_line_ref(line2)) == NULL) {

    if ((gpio2.chip = gpiod_chip_ref(chip2)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to reference chip2");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((gpio2.value = gpiod_line_get_value(line2)) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to get value from line2");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((gpio2.chip->export = gpiod_chip_export(chip2)) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to export chip2");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((gpio2.chip->unexport = gpiod_chip_unexport(chip2)) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to unexport chip2");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Initialize LED

    led.chip = NULL;
    led.line = NULL;
    led.value = 0;

    if ((led.fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
        goto cleanup;

    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open(led.fd)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open chip");
        goto cleanup;

    if ((lined = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO22)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get line");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((event = gpiod_line_get_event(lined)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get event");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((led.line = gpiod_line_ref(lined)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to reference line");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((led.chip = gpiod_chip_ref(chip)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to reference chip");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((led.value = gpiod_line_get_value(lined)) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to get value from line");
        goto cleanup;

    }

    if ((led.chip->unexport = gpiod_chip_unexport(chip)) == -1) {

        goto cleanup;

    if (gpio1.line) {

        running = false;
        gpio_set_value(17, 0); // Turn off LED

    }

    uint64_t current_time = 0;
    uint64_t peak_time = 0;
    uint64_t peak_duration = 0;
    uint64_t peak_count = 0;

    while (running) {
        current_time = (uint64_t)time(NULL) * 1000; // Milliseconds since epoch

                peak_duration += 100;

        }

        if (!running) {
            break;
        }

        // Sleep for 125 µs
        usleep(125);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define ALS_I2C_ADDR 0x29
#define ALS_I2C_BUS 1
#define ALS_I2C_FILE "/dev/i2c-" ALS_I2C_BUS

#define ALS_I2C_REG_LSB 0x00
#define ALS_I2C_REG_MSB 0x01
#define ALS_I2C_REG_RAW 0x02

#define ALS_I2C_TIMEOUT 100

volatile sig_atomic_t exit_flag = 0;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    exit_flag = 1;
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg messages[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg ioctl_msg;
    int i2c_fd;
    int raw_value;
    int err;

    // Set up signal handler for Ctrl+C
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);

    // Open I2C bus
    i2c_fd = open(ALS_I2C_FILE, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set I2C bus speed to 400 kHz
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SET_SPEED, 400000000) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C bus speed");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set I2C timeout
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SET_TIMEOUT, ALS_I2C_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C timeout");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Prepare message for reading ALS registers
    messages[0].addr = ALS_I2C_ADDR;
    messages[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    messages[0].data[0] = ALS_I2C_REG_LSB;
    messages[0].data[1] = 0;

    // Prepare message for reading ALS registers
    messages[0].addr = ALS_I2C_ADDR;
    messages[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    messages[0].data[0] = ALS_I2C_REG_MSB;
    messages[0].data[1] = 0;

    // Prepare message for writing ALS register
    messages[0].addr = ALS_I2C_ADDR;
    messages[0].flags = I2C_M_WRITE;
    messages[0].data[0] = ALS_I2C_REG_RAW;
    messages[0].data[1] = 0;

    while (!exit_flag) {
        // Read LSB and MSB registers
        err = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, messages, 2);
        if (err < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read ALS registers");
            close(i2c_fd);
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        // Combine LSB and MSB registers into a single 16-bit raw value
        raw_value = messages[0].data[0] << 8 | messages[0].data[1];

        // Log the raw sensor reading to the console
        printf("Raw ALS sensor reading: 0x%04X\n", raw_value);

        // Sleep for 100 ms
        usleep(100000);
    }

    // Clean up
    close(i2c_fd);

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("open_i2c: failed to set slave address");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;

    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdlist_ioctl msg_list;
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].data[0] = I2C_SET_LINE;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg_list.msgs = msg;
    msg_list.nummsgs = 1;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &msg_list) < 0) {
        perror("set_line: failed to set line");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int get_line(int line) {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdlist_ioctl msg_list;
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].data[0] = I2C_GET_LINE;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg[0].data[1] = line;
    msg[0].len = 2;
    msg_list.msgs = msg;

    }

    struct i2c_rdlist_ioctl msg_list;

    msg[0].data[0] = I2C_LINE_READ;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg[0].data[1] = line;
    msg[0].len = 2;
    msg_list.msgs = msg;
    msg_list.nummsgs = 1;

        perror("read_line: failed to read line");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int get_value(int line) {
    int value;

    }

    }

    return value;

    int right = get_value(GPIO4);

    if (left < 0 || middle < 0 || right < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    printf("SIGINT received, exiting...\n");
    exit(0);
}

int open_i2c() {
    i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd == -1) {
        perror("open_i2c: failed to open i2c bus");
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("open_i2c: failed to set slave address");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int set_line(int line) {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdlist_ioctl msg_list;
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].data[0] = I2C_SET_LINE;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg_list.msgs = msg;
    msg_list.nummsgs = 1;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &msg_list) < 0) {
        perror("set_line: failed to set line");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int get_line(int line) {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdlist_ioctl msg_list;
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].data[0] = I2C_GET_LINE;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg[0].data[1] = line;
    msg[0].len = 2;
    msg_list.msgs = msg;
    msg_list.nummsgs = 1;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &msg_list) < 0) {
        perror("get_line: failed to get line");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int read_line(int line) {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdlist_ioctl msg_list;
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].data[0] = I2C_LINE_READ;
    msg[0].len = 1;
    msg[0].data[1] = line;
    msg[0].len = 2;
    msg_list.msgs = msg;
    msg_list.nummsgs = 1;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &msg_list) < 0) {
        perror("read_line: failed to read line");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int get_value(int line) {
    int value;
    if (get_line(line) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (read_line(line) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    value = msg_list.msgs[0].data[1];
    return value;
}

        return -1;
    }

}
