#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <sys/signal.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <math.h>

#define I2C_BUS "/dev/i2c-1"
#define BH1750_ADDR 0x23
#define BUFFER_SIZE 60
#define LED_GPIO 17

typedef struct {
    uint8_t data[3];
    uint32_t lux;
    uint32_t count;
} BH1750Data;

static BH1750Data buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
static uint32_t buffer_index = 0;
static uint32_t buffer_full = 0;
static uint32_t buffer_empty = 0;

static int i2c_fd;
static int led_fd;

static void i2c_open() {
    i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, BH1750_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void i2c_close() {
    close(i2c_fd);
}

static void i2c_read() {
    if (buffer_full) {
        return;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read from I2C bus");
        return;
    }
    if (buffer_index >= BUFFER_SIZE) {
        buffer_empty = 1;
    }
    buffer[buffer_index].lux = (buffer[buffer_index].data[0] << 16) |
                               (buffer[buffer_index].data[1] << 8) |
                               buffer[buffer_index].data[2];
    buffer_index = (buffer_index + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
}

static void i2c_write() {
    if (buffer_empty) {
        return;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_WRITE, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to I2C bus");
        return;
    }
    buffer_empty = 0;
}

static void i2c_loop() {
    i2c_read();
    i2c_write();
}

static void gpio_open() {
    led_fd = open("/sys/class/gpio/gpio" __FILE__, O_RDWR);
    if (led_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void gpio_close() {
    close(led_fd);
    unexport(LED_GPIO);
}

static void gpio_write(int value) {
    if (write(led_fd, &value, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to GPIO");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void gpio_loop() {
    struct timespec ts;
    ts.tv_sec = 1;
    ts.tv_nsec = 0;
    nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    gpio_write(1);
    nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    gpio_write(0);
}

static void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT) {
        gpio_close();
        i2c_close();
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

static void init() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    i2c_open();
    gpio_open();
    buffer_index = 0;
    buffer_full = 0;
    buffer_empty = 0;
}

static void cleanup() {
    gpio_close();
    i2c_close();
}

int main() {
    init();
    while (1) {
        i2c_loop();
        if (buffer_full) {
            uint32_t lux = buffer[buffer_index].lux;
            float avg_lux = 0.0f;
            if (buffer_empty) {
                avg_lux = (float) lux;
            } else {
                avg_lux = (float) (buffer[buffer_index].lux + buffer[buffer_empty].lux) / 2.0f;
            }
            float duty_cycle = 0.5f + (avg_lux / 1000.0f) * 0.5f;
            int duty = (int) (duty_cycle * 1000);
            gpio_write(duty / 10);
        }
    }
    cleanup();
    return 0;
}

        perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up an edge detection event
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_create_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_create_edge");
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if ((event = gpiod_edge_create_event(edge, NULL)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_create_event");
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the event to trigger on both rising and falling edges
    if (gpiod_event_set_edge(event, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_event_set_edge");
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the event to trigger on both rising and falling edges
    if (gpiod_event_set_value(event, 1) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_event_set_value");
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up the event handler
    if (gpiod_event_enable(event) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_event_enable");
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the delay
    delay.tv_sec = 0;
    delay.tv_nsec = 750000000; // 750 ms

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Set the line to high (on) state
        if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 1) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
            gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
            gpiod_close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        printf("LED ON\n");
        fflush(stdout);

        // Sleep for 750 ms
        nanosleep(&delay, NULL);

        // Set the line to low (off) state
        if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
            gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
            gpiod_close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        printf("LED OFF\n");
        fflush(stdout);

        // Sleep for 750 ms
        nanosleep(&delay, NULL);
    }

    // Handle SIGINT
    signal(SIGINT, [](int sig) {
        // Cleanly turn off the LED
        if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
            gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
            gpiod_close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        // Terminate the driver library
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);

        // Release all driver resources
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        gpiod_chip_unref(fd);

        // Exit with code 0
        return 0;
    });

    return 0;
}

    if (gpiod_set_pwm(line, PWM_FREQ, PWM_RESOLUTION, 0, 0, 0)) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM for GPIO PIN_B");
        return 1;
    }

    state = gpiod_get_state(line);
    if (state == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get state for GPIO PIN_R");
        return 1;
    }

    edge = gpiod_get_edge(state, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get edge for GPIO PIN_R");
        return 1;
    }

    value = gpiod_get_value(edge);
    if (value == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get value for GPIO PIN_R");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        int r = rand() % PWM_RESOLUTION;
        int g = rand() % PWM_RESOLUTION;
        int b = rand() % PWM_RESOLUTION;

        req.tv_sec = 0;
        req.tv_nsec = 1000000000 / 100; // 10 ms

        clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, 0, &req, NULL);

        if (gpiod_set_value(value, r, g, b)) {
            perror("Failed to set PWM value");
            return 1;
        }

        req.tv_sec = 0;
        req.tv_nsec = 1000000000 / 100; // 10 ms

        clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, 0, &req, NULL);

        if (gpiod_get_value(value, &r, &g, &b)) {
            perror("Failed to get PWM value");
            return 1;
        }

        if (rand() % 100 == 0) {
            r = rand() % PWM_RESOLUTION;
            g = rand() % PWM_RESOLUTION;
            b = rand() % PWM_RESOLUTION;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <sys/i2c.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <wiringPi.h>
#include <wiringPiI2C.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x0d
#define ALS_LSB 0x00
#define ALS_MSB 0x01
#define LED_PIN 18

#define LED_PWM_MAX 255
#define LED_PWM_MIN 0
#define LED_PWM_RANGE LED_PWM_MAX - LED_PWM_MIN

#define LOG_FILE "color_log.csv"
#define LOG_HEADER "timestamp,ALS,red,green,blue\n"

#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_RETRIES 3

#define SIGNAL_HANDLERS {SIGINT, SIGTERM}

int i2c_fd;
wiringPiI2C_t *i2c;
int led_pwm;
int log_fd;

void i2c_error_handler(int err, int retries) {
    fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", err);
    if (retries > 0) {
        usleep(100000); // 100ms delay
        i2c_error_handler(err, retries - 1);
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C failed to initialize\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void signal_handler(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Received signal %d, shutting down\n", sig);
        if (log_fd > 0) {
            close(log_fd);
        }
        if (i2c_fd > 0) {
            close(i2c_fd);
        }
        if (led_pwm > 0) {
            pwmWrite(led_pwm, 0);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

    wiringPiSetupGpio();
    i2c = wiringPiI2COpen(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR);
    if (i2c == NULL) {
        i2c_error_handler(-1, I2C_RETRIES);
    }

    led_pwm = wiringPiSPISetupDataMode(0);
    if (led_pwm < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "LED PWM setup failed\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(log_fd, "%s", LOG_HEADER);

    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data data[1];
    data[0].IoC_cmd = I2C_RDWR;
    data[0].IoC_rdwr.adr = I2C_ADDR;
    data[0].IoC_rdwr.msgs = msg;

    for (int i = 0; i < I2C_RETRIES; i++) {
        msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[0].len = 2;
        msg[0].buf = (unsigned char *) {0x00, 0x00};

        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, data) == -1) {
            i2c_error_handler(errno, I2C_RETRIES);
        }

        if (msg[0].buf[0] == 0x00 && msg[0].buf[1] == 0x01) {
            break;
        }

        usleep(100000); // 100ms delay
    }

    if (msg[0].buf[0] != 0x00 || msg[0].buf[1] != 0x01) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize sensor\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        struct timeval tv;
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        long timestamp = (long) tv.tv_sec * 1000000 + tv.tv_usec;

        unsigned char data[2];
        if (wiringPiI2CReadData(i2c, data) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C read error\n");
            continue;
        }

        unsigned int alsp = (data[0] << 8) | data[1];
        unsigned int red = 0;
        unsigned int green = 0;
        unsigned int blue = 0;

        // Assuming the sensor provides red, green, and blue channels in the same format
        // as the ALS LSB and MSB
        red = (data[0] << 8) | data[1];
        green = (data[0] << 8) | data[1];
        blue = (data[0] << 8) | data[1];

        fprintf(log_fd, "%ld,%d,%d,%d,%d\n", timestamp, alsp, red, green, blue);

        int pwm = (int) ((double) alsp * (double) LED_PWM_MAX / (double) 65535.0);
        pwm = max(0, min(pwm, LED_PWM_MAX));
        pwmWrite(led_pwm, pwm);

        usleep(500000); // 500ms delay
    }

    return 0;
}

int max(int a, int b) {
    return (a > b) ? a : b;
}

int min(int a, int b) {
    return (a < b) ? a : b;
}

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    fclose(log_file);
    impact_count++;

        if (magnitude > IMPACT_THRESHOLD) {

        }
        usleep(50000); // 50ms
    }

    init_i2c();
    read_data();
    main_loop();
    return 0;
}

#define ACCEL_Y 0x02

void handle_sigint(int signum) {

int i2c_open(int bus, int addr) {
    int fd;
    fd = open("/dev/i2c-" bus, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c bus");
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, addr) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set slave address");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }
    return fd;
}

    }
    return n;
}

        return -1;

    return n;

    if (n < 0) {
        return;
    }
    mag[0] = (float) buf[MAG_X] * 0.00098;
    mag[1] = (float) buf[MAG_Y] * 0.00098;
    mag[2] = (float) buf[MAG_Z] * 0.00098;
}

void compute_heading(float *accel, float *mag, float *heading) {
    float x, y, z, mx, my, mz, hx, hy, hz;
    x = accel[0];
    y = accel[1];
    z = accel[2];
    mx = mag[0];
    my = mag[1];
    mz = mag[2];
    hx = x / sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
    hy = y / sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
    hz = z / sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
    hx = hx - mx;
    hy = hy - my;
    hz = hz - mz;
    hx = hx / sqrt(hx * hx + hy * hy + hz * hz);
    hy = hy / sqrt(hx * hx + hy * hy + hz * hz);
    *heading = atan2(hy, hx) * 180.0 / M_PI;
    *heading = *heading + 90.0;
    *heading = *heading * TILT_COMPENSATION;
}

void log_data(float *accel, float *gyro, float *mag, float heading) {
    char filename[256];
    struct timeval tv;
    FILE *fp;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    sprintf(filename, "compass_log_%d.txt", (int) tv.tv_sec);
    if (access(filename, F_OK) == 0) {
        fp = fopen(filename, "a");
    } else {
        fp = fopen(filename, "w");
        fprintf(fp, "timestamp,heading,accel_x,accel_y,accel_z,mag_x,mag_y,mag_z\n");
    }
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }
    fprintf(fp, "%ld,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f\n", (long) tv.tv_sec + tv.tv_usec / 1e6, heading, accel[0], accel[1], accel[2], mag[0], mag[1], mag[2]);
    fclose(fp);
}

int main() {
    LSM303DLHC lsm;
    float accel[3], gyro[3], mag[3], heading;
    int i, n;
    struct sigaction sa;

    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    init_lsm303dlhc(&lsm);
    if (lsm.fd < 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        read_accel(&lsm, accel);
        read_gyro(&lsm, gyro);
        read_mag(&lsm, mag);
        compute_heading(accel, mag, &heading);
        log_data(accel, gyro, mag, heading);
        usleep(100000);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <gpiod.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"

#define SENSOR2_ADDR 0x41
#define SAMPLE_RATE 10000

    int fd;
    int sensor1_fd;
    int sensor2_fd;
    gpiod_device_t *dev;
    gpiod_line_mixin_t *line_mix;
    gpiod_line_t *line1;
    gpiod_line_t *line2;
} I2CManager;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (I2CManager->fd > 0) {
        close(I2CManager->fd);
    }
    if (I2CManager->sensor1_fd > 0) {
        close(I2CManager->sensor1_fd);
    }
    if (I2CManager->sensor2_fd > 0) {
        close(I2CManager->sensor2_fd);
    }
    if (I2CManager->dev) {
        gpiod_device_unref(I2CManager->dev);
    }
    if (I2CManager->line_mix) {
        gpiod_line_mix_unref(I2CManager->line_mix);
    }
    if (I2CManager->line1) {
        gpiod_line_unref(I2CManager->line1);
    }
    if (I2CManager->line2) {
        gpiod_line_unref(I2CManager->line2);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>
#include <linux/gpiod.h>

#define SPI_DEV "/dev/spi0.0"
#define CS_PIN 8
#define SPI_MODE 3
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_READ_SINGLE_REGISTER 0x80

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
} SpiDevice;

void spi_init(SpiDevice *device) {
    device->fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (device->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    device->spi_transfer.msb = 0;
    device->spi_transfer.msbs = 0;
    device->spi_transfer.lsb = 0;
    device->spi_transfer.lbsb = 0;
    device->spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;
    device->spi_transfer.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    device->spi_transfer.bits_per_word = 8;
    device->spi_transfer.mode = SPI_MODE;
    device->spi_transfer.first_byte_only = 0;

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI mode");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MOSI, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI MOSI");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MISO, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI MISO");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SCLK, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI SCLK");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_LSB, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI LSB");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, 1 << CS_PIN) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI CS");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SPEED, &SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI speed");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, &SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI mode");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_LSB, &SPI_READ_SINGLE_REGISTER) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI LSB");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void spi_read(SpiDevice *device, int address, double *gyro, double *accel) {
    device->spi_transfer.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&address;
    device->spi_transfer.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&(*gyro);
    device->spi_transfer.len = 2;
    device->spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;

    if (ioctl(device->fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &device->spi_transfer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI data");
        close(device->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    *gyro = (double)((*gyro & 0xFF) * 0.02);
    *accel = (double)((*accel & 0xFF) * 0.00025);
}

void sig_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        SpiDevice device;
        spi_init(&device);
        close(device.fd);
        gpiod_close(&device.gpio);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = sig_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);

    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set signal handler");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    SpiDevice device;
    spi_init(&device);

    double gyro[3], accel[3];

    while (1) {
        spi_read(&device, SPI_READ_SINGLE_REGISTER, gyro, accel);
        printf("%.2f %.2f %.2f %.2f %.2f %.2f\n", gyro[0], gyro[1], gyro[2], accel[0], accel[1], accel[2]);
        sleep(0.1);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define MPU6886_ADDR 0x68

#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_RETRIES 3

int i2c_fd;

void i2c_read(int fd, int addr, int reg, int *value, int size) {
    int retries = 0;
    ssize_t bytes_read;
    char buffer[2];

    while (retries < I2C_RETRIES) {
        if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, addr, reg, I2C_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl");
            return;
        }

        bytes_read = read(fd, buffer, size);
        if (bytes_read < 0) {
            perror("read");
            return;
        }

        if (bytes_read == size) {
            *value = (int)buffer[0] << 8 | (int)buffer[1];
            return;
        }

        retries++;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read from I2C address %d after %d retries\n", addr, retries);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

int main() {
    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, MPU6886_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        close(i2c_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    int accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z;

    while (1) {
        i2c_read(i2c_fd, MPU6886_ADDR, 0x43, &accel_x, 2);
        i2c_read(i2c_fd, MPU6886_ADDR, 0x44, &accel_y, 2);
        i2c_read(i2c_fd, MPU6886_ADDR, 0x45, &accel_z, 2);
        i2c_read(i2c_fd, MPU6886_ADDR, 0x47, &gyro_x, 2);
        i2c_read(i2c_fd, MPU6886_ADDR, 0x48, &gyro_y, 2);
        i2c_read(i2c_fd, MPU6886_ADDR, 0x49, &gyro_z, 2);

        printf("Accelerometer: %d %d %d\n", accel_x, accel_y, accel_z);
        printf("Gyroscope: %d %d %d\n", gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z);

        sleep(0.05);
    }

    close(i2c_fd);
    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x1906
#define I2C_SPEED 1000000
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100

#define IMU_LOG_FILE "imu_log.csv"

#define BUFFER_SIZE 6

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    float x, y, z;
    float gx, gy, gz;
} imu_data_t;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    if (csv_fd != -1) {
        close(csv_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdma_request request;
    struct i2c_client_data client_data;
    struct i2c_msg *msg_ptr;
    int i2c_fd;
    int csv_fd;
    imu_data_t data;
    char *buffer;
    char *line;
    char *newline;
    struct timeval tv;
    int status;
    bool success;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Open I2C bus
    i2c_fd = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, I2C_SPEED, I2C_TIMEOUT);
    if (i2c_fd == -1) {
        perror("i2c_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up I2C request
    request.request = I2C_RMDA_READ;
    request.flags = I2C_RMDA_NO_WAIT;
    request.addr = I2C_ADDR;
    request.len = BUFFER_SIZE * 2;

    // Prepare buffer for data
    buffer = malloc(request.len);
    if (buffer == NULL) {
        perror("malloc");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open CSV file
    csv_fd = open(IMU_LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (csv_fd == -1) {
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Initialize timestamp
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    data.timestamp = (uint32_t) tv.tv_sec * 1000000 + (uint32_t) tv.tv_usec;

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Prepare I2C message
        msg_ptr = msg;
        msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[0].len = request.len;
        memcpy(msg[0].buf, buffer, request.len);

        // Send I2C request
        status = i2c_request_write(i2c_fd, msg, 1, &request);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("i2c_request_write");
            continue;
        }

        // Read I2C response
        status = i2c_request_read(i2c_fd, msg, 1, &request);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("i2c_request_read");
            continue;
        }

        // Check I2C status
        if (msg[0].status) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", msg[0].status);
            continue;
        }

        // Parse I2C data
        for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE * 2; i += 2) {
            data.x += *(uint16_t *) (buffer + i);
            data.y += *(uint16_t *) (buffer + i + 2);
            data.z += *(uint16_t *) (buffer + i + 4);
            data.gx += *(uint16_t *) (buffer + i + 6);
            data.gy += *(uint16_t *) (buffer + i + 8);
            data.gz += *(uint16_t *) (buffer + i + 10);
        }

        // Convert to float
        data.x /= 16384.0f;
        data.y /= 16384.0f;
        data.z /= 16384.0f;
        data.gx /= 131.072f;
        data.gy /= 131.072f;
        data.gz /= 131.072f;

        // Write to CSV
        line = malloc(strlen(IMU_LOG_FILE) + 100 + 1);
        snprintf(line, strlen(IMU_LOG_FILE) + 100, "%s,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f\n", IMU_LOG_FILE, data.timestamp, data.x, data.y, data.z, data.gx, data.gy, data.gz, data.gx, data.gy);
        if (write(csv_fd, line, strlen(line)) < 0) {
            perror("write");
            continue;
        }

        // Print to stdout
        printf("%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f,%f\n", data.timestamp, data.x, data.y, data.z, data.gx, data.gy, data.gz, data.gx, data.gy);

        // Update timestamp
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        data.timestamp = (uint32_t) tv.tv_sec * 1000000 + (uint32_t) tv.tv_usec;

        // Sleep for 100ms
        usleep(100000);
    }

    // Close resources
    free(buffer);
    free(line);
    close(csv_fd);
    close(i2c_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <wiringPi.h>
#include <wiringPiGpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define ACC_ID 0x19
#define ACC_ID_REGISTER 0x00
#define ACC_ID_VALUE 0x48
#define LED_PIN 17
#define LED_ON_TIME 500000  // 500ms in microseconds
#define POLL_INTERVAL 100000  // 100ms in microseconds

int i2c_fd;
int acc_id;

void init_i2c() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, ACC_ID) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (read(i2c_fd, &acc_id, sizeof(acc_id)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C ID");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (acc_id != ACC_ID_VALUE) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor ID mismatch: expected 0x48, got 0x%02x\n", acc_id);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup() {
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }

    if (wiringPiGpioIsSet(LED_PIN)) {
        digitalWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
    }

    if (remove("impact_log.txt") < 0) {
        perror("Failed to remove log file");
    }
}

void log_reading(int axis, int value) {
    char buffer[256];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    FILE *log_file;

    rawtime = time(NULL);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);

    log_file = fopen("impact_log.txt", "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file for writing");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(log_file, "%s %d %d\n", buffer, axis, value);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void handle_error(int error_code, const char *message) {
    fprintf(stderr, "%s: %d\n", message, error_code);
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

int main() {
    wiringPiSetupGpio();
    wiringPiGpioSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    wiringPiGpioSetPullUpDnControl(LED_PIN, PI_DISABLE);

    init_i2c();

    while (1) {
        int axis_values[3];
        int axis;
        int max_value = 0;

        for (axis = 0; axis < 3; axis++) {
            int value;
            if (read(i2c_fd, &value, sizeof(value)) < 0) {
                handle_error(errno, "Failed to read I2C data");
            }

            axis_values[axis] = value;
            if (value > max_value) {
                max_value = value;
            }
        }

        if (max_value > 2048) {
            digitalWrite(LED_PIN, 1);
            delayMicroseconds(LED_ON_TIME);
            digitalWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
        }

        for (axis = 0; axis < 3; axis++) {
            log_reading(axis, axis_values[axis]);
        }

        delayMicroseconds(POLL_INTERVAL);
    }

    return 0;
}
```

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W that continuously polls the digital output (DO) of a KY-026 Flame Sensor Module connected to GPIO17 (BCM numbering, physical pin 11) on the GPIO bus every 500 ms, enables the internal pull‑up resistor on that line because the sensor’s open‑collector output is active‑LOW (LOW indicates flame, HIGH indicates no flame), and writes each reading to an append‑mode file named flame_events.log with an immediately flushed line formatted as “YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS – Flame detected: YES” when the pin reads LOW or “… NO” when it reads HIGH; when a flame is detected the program must also print the message “FLAME DETECTED!” to the console, and it must check that the driver initialization succeeded, verify that the log file handle is valid, and treat any sensor read error (e.g., the API returning PI_BAD_GPIO) by logging an error line instead of a false positive; a SIGINT handler should be installed so that pressing Ctrl‑C sets a flag that cleanly exits the polling loop, and on any exit path the program must close the log file if open and call the library’s cleanup function.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define LOG_FILE "flame_events.log"
#define LOG_FORMAT "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS – Flame detected: %s"

#define FLAME_DETECTED "YES"
#define NO_FLAME "NO"

#define LOG_FILE_OPEN_ERROR "Failed to open log file"
#define LOG_FILE_WRITE_ERROR "Failed to write to log file"
#define DRIVER_INIT_ERROR "Driver initialization failed"
#define SENSOR_READ_ERROR "Sensor read error"

#define LOG_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE "%s %s"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_handle *handle;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    int pin;
    int pull_up;
    int last_value;
    int flame_detected;
    int running;
    int sigint_received;
} FlameSensorState;

FlameSensorState state;

void sigint_handler(int sig) {
    state.sigint_received = 1;
}

void cleanup() {
    if (state.fd > 0) {
        close(state.fd);
    }
    if (state.handle) {
        gpiod_handle_close(state.handle);
    }
    if (state.line) {
        gpiod_line_unref(state.line);
    }
}

void init_driver() {
    if (gpiod_init(&state.handle) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, DRIVER_INIT_ERROR);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpiod_new_line(&state.handle, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT, &state.line) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, DRIVER_INIT_ERROR);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpiod_request_pull_up(state.line, 1) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, DRIVER_INIT_ERROR);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    state.pin = GPIO17;
    state.pull_up = 1;
    state.last_value = 0;
    state.flame_detected = 0;
    state.running = 1;
    state.sigint_received = 0;
    state.fd = 0;
}

void read_sensor() {
    int value;
    if (gpiod_get_value(state.line, &value) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SENSOR_READ_ERROR);
        return;
    }
    state.last_value = value;
    if (state.last_value == 0) {
        state.flame_detected = 1;
    } else {
        state.flame_detected = 0;
    }
}

void write_log() {
    if (state.fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, LOG_FILE_OPEN_ERROR);
        return;
    }
    char buffer[128];
    struct tm *now;
    time_t t;
    t = time(NULL);
    now = localtime(&t);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), LOG_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE, now);
    buffer[strcspn(buffer, "\n")] = 0;
    if (fprintf(state.fd, buffer) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, LOG_FILE_WRITE_ERROR);
        return;
    }
    fflush(state.fd);
}

void print_message() {
    if (state.flame_detected) {
        printf("FLAME DETECTED!\n");
    }
}

void loop() {
    while (state.running) {
        read_sensor();
        write_log();
        print_message();
        usleep(500000); // 500ms
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);
    init_driver();
    state.fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_APPEND | O_CREAT | O_WRONLY, 0644);
    if (state.fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, LOG_FILE_OPEN_ERROR);
        cleanup();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    loop();
    cleanup();
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>

#include <sys/ioctl.h>

#include <signal.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO27 27
#define FILENAME "conveyor_log.txt"
#define LOG_INTERVAL_MS 50
#define LOG_BUF_SIZE 1024

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    int value;
} Sensor;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Graceful shutdown initiated.\n");
        for (Sensor *sensor = sensors; sensor; sensor = sensor->next) {
            if (sensor->line) {
                gpiod_line_close(sensor->line);
            }
        }
        gpiod_chip_free(sensor->chip);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    struct timespec ts;
    char log_buf[LOG_BUF_SIZE];
    FILE *log_file;
    int count = 0;
    int halt = 0;
    int status;
    int i;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod chip");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_INPUT);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO17 line");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO27, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_INPUT);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO27 line");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        status = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("Failed to request edge");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        status = gpiod_line_request_event(line, GPIOD_EVENT_EDGE);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("Failed to request event");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    log_file = fopen(FILENAME, "w");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        ts.tv_sec = count / 100;
        ts.tv_nsec = (count % 100) * 1000000000;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

        status = gpiod_line_read_value(line, &line->value);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read GPIO value");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (line == sensors[0].line) {
            sensors[0].value = line->value;
        } else {
            sensors[0].value = 0;
        }

        status = gpiod_line_read_value(line, &line->value);
        if (status < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read GPIO value");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (line == sensors[1].line) {
            sensors[1].value = line->value;
        } else {
            sensors[1].value = 0;
        }

        if (sensors[0].value && sensors[1].value) {
            halt = 1;
        } else {
            halt = 0;
        }

        if (count % 100 == 0) {
            snprintf(log_buf, LOG_BUF_SIZE, "%ld,%d,%d\n", ts.tv_sec, sensors[0].value, sensors[1].value);
            fprintf(log_file, "%s", log_buf);
        }

        if (halt) {
            printf("Conveyor halted at %ld ms\n", ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000000);
            break;
        }

        count++;
        usleep(LOG_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (sensors[i].line) {
            gpiod_line_close(sensors[i].line);
        }
    }
    gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

    }

    if (reg & 0x80) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor not found or not in active mode\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    reg &= ~0x80; // Clear the standby bit
    if (write(fd, &reg, 1) < 0) {
        perror("write MMA8452 control register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, MMA8452_I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (read(fd, &reg, 1) < 0) {
        perror("read MMA8452 control register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    reg |= 0x02; // Set data rate to 100 Hz
    if (write(fd, &reg, 1) < 0) {
        perror("write MMA8452 control register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, MMA8452_I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (read(fd, &reg, 1) < 0) {
        perror("read MMA8452 control register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((reg & 0x80) == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor not in active mode\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_accelerometer(int fd) {
    if (read(fd, &accel_data, 6) < 0) {
        perror("read accelerometer data");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    int x_raw = (accel_data[MMA8452_X_MSB] << 4) | (accel_data[MMA8452_X_LSB] >> 4);
    int y_raw = (accel_data[MMA8452_Y_MSB] << 4) | (accel_data[MMA8452_Y_LSB] >> 4);
    int z_raw = (accel_data[MMA8452_Z_MSB] << 4) | (accel_data[MMA8452_Z_LSB] >> 4);

    double tilt = asin(sqrt(pow((double)x_raw / 4096.0, 2) + pow((double)y_raw / 4096.0, 2) + pow((double)z_raw / 4096.0, 2))) * 180.0 / M_PI;

    if (tilt > 45.0) {
        fall_log[fall_log_index].timestamp = time(NULL);
        fall_log[fall_log_index].x_raw = x_raw;
        fall_log[fall_log_index].y_raw = y_raw;
        fall_log[fall_log_index].z_raw = z_raw;
        fall_log_index = (fall_log_index + 1) % MAX_LOG_ENTRIES;
        if (fall_log_index == 0) {
            fall_log_index = 0;
        }
        if (fwrite(fall_log, sizeof(FallLogEntry), 1, fopen(FALL_LOG_FILE, "a")) != 1) {
            perror("fwrite fall_log");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (close(fd) < 0) {
        perror("close I2C file descriptor");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (fclose(fall_log_file) < 0) {
        perror("fclose fall_log_file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    int fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fall_log_file = fopen(FALL_LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fall_log_file == NULL) {
        perror("open fall_log_file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    init_mma8452(fd);

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, MMA8452_I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (read(fd, &reg, 1) < 0) {
            perror("read MMA8452 WHO_AM_I");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (reg != 0x54) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Sensor identity mismatch\n");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        read_accelerometer(fd);

        usleep(1000000); // 10 ms delay
    }

    return 0;
}
```

**Note:** This code assumes that the MMA8452 is connected to the I2C bus at address 0x19. The `fall_log.txt` file is opened in append mode at startup and flushed after each entry. The program will exit cleanly when interrupted by SIGINT or SIGTERM. The accelerometer data is read in a single block and the tilt is calculated using the arctangent of the vector magnitude.

    struct timespec ts;

    fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return 1;
    }

    result = ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (result < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].len = 2;
    msg[0].data[0] = KY032_REG_IR1;
    msg[0].data[1] = KY032_REG_IR2;

    msg[1].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[1].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[1].len = 2;
    msg[1].data[0] = KY032_REG_IR1;
    msg[1].data[1] = KY032_REG_IR2;

    ioctl_msg.msgs = msg;
    ioctl_msg.nmsgs = 2;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);

    while (running) {
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        printf("Polling at %ld.%06ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);

        result = ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, &ioctl_msg);
        if (result < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C bus");
            break;
        }

        read(fd, buffer, 2);
        if (read(fd, buffer, 2) != 2) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C bus");
            break;
        }

        if (buffer[0] == 0) {
            printf("IR1: Obstacle detected at %ld.%06ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);
        } else {
            printf("IR1: Path clear at %ld.%06ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);
        }

        if (buffer[1] == 0) {
            printf("IR2: Obstacle detected at %ld.%06ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);
        } else {
            printf("IR2: Path clear at %ld.%06ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0);
        }

        usleep(IR_POLL_INTERVAL);
    }

    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x23
#define BH1750_REG_ADDR 0x00
#define BH1750_CONTROL_REG_ADDR 0x01
#define BH1750_CONTROL_REG_VALUE 0x3F

#define MAX_CONVERSION_TIME 180
#define LOG_FILE "light_log.txt"
#define LOG_FORMAT "Timestamp: %s, Lux: %d\n"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int addr;
    int control_reg_value;
} BH1750Config;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (BH1750Config.config.fd > 0) {
        close(BH1750Config.config.fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int i2c_open(const char *dev) {
    int fd;
    if ((fd = open(dev, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, BH1750Config.config.addr) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        return -1;
    }
    return fd;
}

int i2c_write(BH1750Config *config, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    if (write(config->fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to I2C bus");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2c_read(BH1750Config *config, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    if (read(config->fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read from I2C bus");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int i2c_close(BH1750Config *config) {
    if (config->fd > 0) {
        close(config->fd);
    }
    return 0;
}

int bh1750_init(BH1750Config *config) {
    config->fd = i2c_open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS);
    if (config->fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    config->addr = I2C_ADDR;
    config->control_reg_value = BH1750_CONTROL_REG_VALUE;

    uint8_t control_reg_buf[1] = {config->control_reg_value};
    if (i2c_write(config, control_reg_buf, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int bh1750_read(BH1750Config *config, uint8_t *buf) {
    if (i2c_read(config, buf, 2) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int bh1750_get_lux(BH1750Config *config) {
    uint8_t data[2] = {0, 0};
    if (bh1750_read(config, data) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return (uint16_t)data[0] << 8 | data[1];
}

void log_lux(BH1750Config *config, time_t timestamp, int lux) {
    FILE *fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }
    fprintf(fp, LOG_FORMAT, ctime(&timestamp), lux);
    fclose(fp);
}

int main() {
    BH1750Config config;
    config.config = config;
    config.config.fd = 0;
    config.config.addr = 0;
    config.config.control_reg_value = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    if (bh1750_init(&config) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to initialize BH1750 sensor");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    time_t timestamp;
    int lux;
    while (1) {
        timestamp = time(NULL);
        if (BH1750Config.config.fd > 0) {
            lux = bh1750_get_lux(&config);
            if (lux < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read lux value from BH1750 sensor");
                continue;
            }
            log_lux(&config, timestamp, lux);
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "BH1750 sensor not found or not connected\n");
        }

        if (sleep(5) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to sleep for 5 seconds");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO18 18
#define GPIO23 23
#define GPIO24 24
#define GPIO25 25

#define RELAY_1 0
#define RELAY_2 1
#define RELAY_3 2
#define RELAY_4 3

#define GPIO_MAJOR 4
#define GPIO_MINOR 16

#define RELAY_INTERVALS [2, 3, 5, 7]

int gpiod_fd;
struct gpiod_chip *chip;
struct gpiod_line *line[4];
int line_fd[4];
int line_state[4];
int line_count = 0;

void handle_error(int line_idx, int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Error handling GPIO line %d: %s\n", line_idx, strerror(err));
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void init_gpio() {
    gpiod_fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (gpiod_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(gpiod_fd, GPIO_MAJOR, GPIO_MINOR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get major and minor number");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    chip = gpiod_open(gpiod_fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod chip");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        line[i] = gpiod_get_line(chip, GPIO_MAJOR, GPIO_MINOR, RELAY_1 + i);
        if (!line[i]) {
            handle_error(i, errno);
        }
        line_fd[i] = line[i]->fd;
        line_state[i] = 0;
        line_count++;
    }
}

void set_relay(int line_idx, int state) {
    if (ioctl(line_fd[line_idx], GPI_SET_LINE_VAL, state) < 0) {
        handle_error(line_idx, errno);
    }
}

void toggle_relay(int line_idx) {
    set_relay(line_idx, line_state[line_idx] ? 0 : 1);
    line_state[line_idx] = !line_state[line_idx];
}

void set_interval(int line_idx, int interval) {
    struct gpiod_time interval_time;
    interval_time.tv_sec = interval;
    interval_time.tv_nsec = 0;

    if (ioctl(line_fd[line_idx], GPI_SET_LINE_INTERVAL, &interval_time) < 0) {
        handle_error(line_idx, errno);
    }
}

void init_relay_intervals() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        set_interval(i, RELAY_INTERVALS[i]);
    }
}

void cleanup() {
    for (int i = 0; i < line_count; i++) {
        gpiod_line_close(chip, line[i]);
    }
    gpiod_close(chip);
    close(gpiod_fd);
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

    init_gpio();
    init_relay_intervals();

    struct timeval start, end;
    gettimeofday(&start, NULL);

    while (1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            if (line_state[i] == 1) {
                toggle_relay(i);
            }
        }

        gettimeofday(&end, NULL);
        if ((end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000000 + (end.tv_usec - start.tv_usec) >= 1000000) {
            start.tv_sec = end.tv_sec;
            start.tv_usec = end.tv_usec;
        }

        usleep(1000000 - (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000000 - (end.tv_usec - start.tv_usec));
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <string.h>

#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/sigaction.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <math.h>

#define MPU6050_ADDRESS 0x68
#define MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG 0x1A
#define MPU6050_CONFIG 0x1C
#define MPU6050_ACCEL_CONFIG 0x1C
#define MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG_VALUE 0x01
#define MPU6050_CONFIG_VALUE 0x00
#define MPU6050_ACCEL_CONFIG_VALUE 0x08
#define MPU6050_GYRO_DATA 0x68
#define MPU6050_ACCEL_DATA 0x69
#define MPU6050_GYRO_DATA_SIZE 2
#define MPU6050_ACCEL_DATA_SIZE 2
#define BUFFER_SIZE 100
#define BUFFER_MASK (BUFFER_SIZE - 1)

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    double buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    double current_abs_vel;
    double prev_abs_vel;
    double prev_time;
    double current_time;
    double delta_time;
    double delta_abs_vel;
    double threshold;
    double callback;
} MPU6050Data;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (MPU6050Data->fd > 0) {
        close(MPU6050Data->fd);
    }
    exit(0);
}

void init_mpu6050(MPU6050Data *mpu6050) {
    if (mpu6050->fd < 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Set gyro configuration
    if (ioctl(mpu6050->fd, I2C_SLAVE, MPU6050_ADDRESS) < 0) {
        perror("I2C_SLAVE");
        return;
    }

    if (write(mpu6050->fd, &MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG, sizeof(MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }

    if (write(mpu6050->fd, &MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG_VALUE, sizeof(MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG_VALUE)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }

    // Set accelerometer configuration
    if (write(mpu6050->fd, &MPU6050_ACCEL_CONFIG, sizeof(MPU6050_ACCEL_CONFIG)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }

    if (write(mpu6050->fd, &MPU6050_ACCEL_CONFIG_VALUE, sizeof(MPU6050_ACCEL_CONFIG_VALUE)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }

    // Set gyro configuration
    if (write(mpu6050->fd, &MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG, sizeof(MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }

    if (write(mpu6050->fd, &MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG_VALUE, sizeof(MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG_VALUE)) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }
}

void read_mpu6050(MPU6050Data *mpu6050) {
    if (mpu6050->fd < 0) {
        return;
    }

    if (ioctl(mpu6050->fd, I2C_M_RD, MPU6050_GYRO_DATA) < 0) {
        perror("I2C_M_RD");
        return;
    }

    if (read(mpu6050->fd, mpu6050->buffer, MPU6050_GYRO_DATA_SIZE * 2) < 0) {
        perror("read");
        return;
    }

    mpu6050->current_abs_vel = sqrt(mpu6050->buffer[0] * mpu6050->buffer[0] + mpu6050->buffer[1] * mpu6050->buffer[1]);
    mpu6050->current_time = (double)time(NULL);
    mpu6050->delta_time = mpu6050->current_time - mpu6050->prev_time;
    mpu6050->prev_abs_vel = mpu6050->current_abs_vel;
    mpu6050->prev_time = mpu6050->current_time;

    if (mpu6050->callback) {
        if (mpu6050->current_abs_vel > mpu6050->threshold) {
            mpu6050->callback(mpu6050->current_abs_vel);
        }
    }
}

void write_callback(void *arg) {
    MPU6050Data *mpu6050 = (MPU6050Data *)arg;
    if (mpu6050->current_abs_vel > mpu6050->threshold) {
        printf("Angular velocity exceeds threshold: %f degrees/second\n", mpu6050->current_abs_vel);
    }
}

int main() {
    MPU6050Data mpu6050;
    mpu6050.fd = -1;
    mpu6050.threshold = 50.0;
    mpu6050.callback = write_callback;

    // Open I2C device
    if ((mpu6050.fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set slave address
    if (ioctl(mpu6050.fd, I2C_SLAVE, MPU6050_ADDRESS) < 0) {
        perror("I2C_SLAVE");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Initialize MPU6050
    init_mpu6050(&mpu6050);

    // Set up signal handler
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) == -1) {
        perror("sigaction");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        read_mpu6050(&mpu6050);
    }

cleanup:
    if (mpu6050.fd > 0) {
        close(mpu6050.fd);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <syslog.h>

#define CO2_LOG_FILE "co2_log.json"
#define CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE "co2_error.log"
#define UART_DEV "/dev/serial0"
#define BAUD_RATE 9600
#define TXD_GPIO 14
#define RXD_GPIO 15
#define CMD_LEN 9
#define TIMEOUT_MS 100
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 5000
#define JSON_HEADER "{\"timestamp\": \"\", \"ppm\": 0, \"error\": false}"
#define JSON_HEADER_LEN 50

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int timeout;
    int retry_count;
    bool checksum_ok;
    bool error;
} Co2Monitor;

static void sigint_handler(int signum) {
    Co2Monitor* monitor = (Co2Monitor*)malloc(sizeof(Co2Monitor));
    monitor->fd = -1;
    monitor->timeout = 0;
    monitor->retry_count = 0;
    monitor->checksum_ok = false;
    monitor->error = false;
    free(monitor);
    close(monitor->fd);
    unlink(UART_DEV);
    unlink(CO2_LOG_FILE);
    unlink(CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
    exit(0);
}

static void log_error(const char* message, const char* filename) {
    FILE* error_log = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (!error_log) {
        perror("Failed to open error log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(error_log, "%s\n", message);
    fclose(error_log);
}

static void log_data(const char* message, const char* filename) {
    FILE* log_file = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(log_file, "%s\n", message);
    fclose(log_file);
}

static void send_command(Co2Monitor* monitor) {
    struct termios tty;
    tcgetattr(monitor->fd, &tty);
    cfmakeraw(&tty);
    tcsetattr(monitor->fd, TCSANOW, &tty);
    char cmd[CMD_LEN] = "CO2,";
    write(monitor->fd, cmd, CMD_LEN);
    monitor->timeout = TIMEOUT_MS;
    monitor->retry_count = 0;
}

static void read_response(Co2Monitor* monitor) {
    char buffer[CMD_LEN + 1];
    int len = read(monitor->fd, buffer, CMD_LEN);
    if (len < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read response");
        log_error("Failed to read response", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
        return;
    }
    if (len != CMD_LEN) {
        log_error("Invalid response length", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
        return;
    }
    char checksum = buffer[CMD_LEN - 1];
    int checksum_sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < CMD_LEN - 1; i++) {
        checksum_sum += buffer[i];
    }
    if (checksum != checksum_sum) {
        log_error("Checksum mismatch", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
        return;
    }
    monitor->checksum_ok = true;
    monitor->error = false;
}

static void sample_data(Co2Monitor* monitor) {
    char timestamp[20];
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    long long timestamp_ms = (long long)tv.tv_sec * 1000 + (long long)tv.tv_usec / 1000;
    snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%lld", timestamp_ms);
    char json[JSON_HEADER_LEN + CMD_LEN + 1];
    snprintf(json, sizeof(json), "%s, \"%s\", %d, false", JSON_HEADER, timestamp, 0);
    write(monitor->fd, json, sizeof(json));
    monitor->timeout = TIMEOUT_MS;
    monitor->retry_count = 0;
}

static void process_response(Co2Monitor* monitor) {
    if (monitor->checksum_ok) {
        char ppm_str[5];
        sscanf(monitor->buffer, "%s", ppm_str);
        int ppm = atoi(ppm_str);
        char json[JSON_HEADER_LEN + CMD_LEN + 1];
        snprintf(json, sizeof(json), "%s, \"%s\", %d, false", JSON_HEADER, monitor->timestamp, ppm);
        write(monitor->fd, json, sizeof(json));
        log_data(json, CO2_LOG_FILE);
        printf("%s\n", json);
    } else {
        log_error("Checksum mismatch", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
    }
}

static void close_monitor(Co2Monitor* monitor) {
    if (monitor->fd != -1) {
        close(monitor->fd);
    }
    unlink(UART_DEV);
    unlink(CO2_LOG_FILE);
    unlink(CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
}

static void init_monitor(Co2Monitor* monitor) {
    monitor->fd = open(UART_DEV, O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (monitor->fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open UART device");
        log_error("Failed to open UART device", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    struct termios tty;
    tcgetattr(monitor->fd, &tty);
    cfmakeraw(&tty);
    tcsetattr(monitor->fd, TCSANOW, &tty);
    monitor->timeout = TIMEOUT_MS;
    monitor->retry_count = 0;
    monitor->checksum_ok = false;
    monitor->error = false;
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, sigint_handler);
    Co2Monitor monitor;
    init_monitor(&monitor);
    while (1) {
        send_command(&monitor);
        while (monitor.timeout > 0) {
            usleep(1000);
            monitor.timeout--;
        }
        if (monitor.retry_count >= 3) {
            log_error("Timeout", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
            continue;
        }
        read_response(&monitor);
        if (monitor.error) {
            log_error("Checksum mismatch", CO2_ERROR_LOG_FILE);
            continue;
        }
        sample_data(&monitor);
        process_response(&monitor);
        monitor.retry_count++;
        usleep(SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);
    }
    close_monitor(&monitor);
    return 0;
}

typedef struct {
    float heading;
    float compensated_heading;
} BufferEntry;

typedef struct {
    BufferEntry buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int head, tail;
    int count;
} CircularBuffer;

CircularBuffer buffer;

void init_buffer() {
    buffer.head = 0;
    buffer.tail = 0;
    buffer.count = 0;
}

void add_to_buffer(float heading) {
    if (buffer.count < BUFFER_SIZE) {
        buffer.buffer[buffer.tail].heading = heading;
        buffer.buffer[buffer.tail].compensated_heading = heading;
        buffer.tail = (buffer.tail + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
        buffer.count++;
    } else {
        buffer.buffer[buffer.tail].heading = heading;
        buffer.buffer[buffer.tail].compensated_heading = heading;
        buffer.tail = (buffer.tail + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
        buffer.buffer[buffer.head].compensated_heading = heading;
        buffer.head = (buffer.head + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
        buffer.count = BUFFER_SIZE;
    }
}

float get_compensated_heading(float heading) {
    return heading - 100.0 + 50.0;
}

int i2c_read(float *heading) {
    int fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return -1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    float data[6];
    int n = 0;
    int timeout = 0;
    while (timeout < I2C_TIMEOUT) {
        if (read(fd, data, 6) != 6) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            close(fd);
            return -1;
        }
        if (data[0] == 0x02) {
            *heading = atan2(data[4], data[3]) * 180.0 / M_PI;
            return 0;
        }
        usleep(1000);
        timeout++;
    }

    perror("I2C timeout");
    close(fd);
    return -1;
}

void handle_i2c_error() {
    printf("I2C error: retrying...\n");
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Received signal %d, exiting...\n", signum);
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    init_buffer();

    int fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device");
        return 1;
    }

    struct gpiod_chip *chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    struct gpiod_line *line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, 17);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO line");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    struct gpiod_edge *edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (!edge) {
        perror("Failed to request edge");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_line_request_handler(edge, handle_gpio_handler);
    gpiod_chip_request_handler(chip, handle_chip_handler);
    gpiod_chip_open_fd(chip, fd);
    gpiod_chip_enable(chip, edge);

    while (1) {
        float heading;
        if (i2c_read(&heading) < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error();
            continue;
        }

        add_to_buffer(heading);

        if (buffer.count > 0) {
            float avg_heading = 0.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < buffer.count; i++) {
                avg_heading += buffer.buffer[i].compensated_heading;
            }
            avg_heading /= buffer.count;
            if (fabs(avg_heading - TARGET_HEADING) > DEVIATION_THRESHOLD) {
                gpiod_line_set_value(line, 1);
            } else {
                gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0);
            }
        }

        usleep(100000); // 100ms
    }

    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    gpiod_line_free(line);
    gpiod_chip_free(chip);
    close(fd);

    return 0;
}

void handle_gpio_handler(struct gpiod_edge *edge, struct gpiod_line *line, int state) {

}

void handle_chip_handler(struct gpiod_chip *chip, struct gpiod_line *line, int state) {
    printf("Chip state changed to %d\n", state);
}

#define BH1750_ADDR 0x23
#define BH1750_REG 0x00
#define BH1750_REG_DATA 0x01

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_FILE "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS

#define LOG_FILE "lighting_log.txt"

#define RED_RELAY 17
#define GREEN_RELAY 27
#define BLUE_RELAY 22

#define RED_THRESHOLD 50
#define GREEN_THRESHOLD 150
#define BLUE_THRESHOLD 300

#define LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S,%d,%d,%d"

typedef enum {
    BH1750_OK,
    BH1750_ERROR,
    BH1750_SENSOR_NOT_PRESENT
} BH1750_STATUS;

typedef enum {
    RELAY_OFF,
    RELAY_ON
} RELAY_STATE;

typedef struct {
    int i2c_fd;
    int red_relays[3];
    int green_relays[3];
    int blue_relays[3];
    int log_fd;
    char log_buffer[256];
} BH1750_LOGGER;

void log_to_file(BH1750_LOGGER *logger) {
    if (logger->log_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open log file: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *timeinfo = localtime(&now);
    snprintf(logger->log_buffer, sizeof(logger->log_buffer), LOG_FORMAT, timeinfo->tm_year + 1900, timeinfo->tm_mon + 1, timeinfo->tm_mday, timeinfo->tm_hour, timeinfo->tm_min, timeinfo->tm_sec);
    logger->log_buffer[sizeof(logger->log_buffer) - 1] = '\0';
    if (write(logger->log_fd, logger->log_buffer, strlen(logger->log_buffer)) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to write to log file: %s", strerror(errno));
    }
}

void set_relay_state(int relay, RELAY_STATE state) {
    if (relay < 0 || relay >= 3) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Invalid relay index: %d", relay);
        return;
    }

    if (state == RELAY_ON) {
        if (gpio_set_value(relay, 1) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set relay %d to ON: %s", relay, strerror(errno));
        }
    } else {
        if (gpio_set_value(relay, 0) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set relay %d to OFF: %s", relay, strerror(errno));
        }
    }
}

void init_gpio() {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (gpio_set_direction(i, GPIO_DIR_OUT) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set GPIO %d to output: %s", i, strerror(errno));
        }
    }
}

void cleanup_gpio() {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (gpio_set_value(i, 0) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set GPIO %d to OFF: %s", i, strerror(errno));
        }
    }
}

void init_i2c() {
    int i2c_fd = open(I2C_FILE, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open I2C bus: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, BH1750_ADDR) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set I2C slave address: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    BH1750_LOGGER logger = {i2c_fd, {0}, {0}, {0}, open(LOG_FILE, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_APPEND), 0};
    if (logger.log_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open log file: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    if (ioctl(logger.i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &logger) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialize I2C: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    init_gpio();
}

void cleanup_i2c() {
    close(logger.i2c_fd);
    close(logger.log_fd);
    cleanup_gpio();
}

void handle_sensor_error(BH1750_LOGGER *logger) {
    syslog(LOG_ERR, "BH1750 sensor error: %s", strerror(errno));
    cleanup_i2c();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sensor_not_present(BH1750_LOGGER *logger) {
    syslog(LOG_ERR, "BH1750 sensor not present: %s", strerror(errno));
    cleanup_i2c();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void read_light_level(BH1750_LOGGER *logger) {
    int status;
    uint16_t data;

    if (ioctl(logger.i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, BH1750_REG, 1, &data, 2, 0) < 0) {
        handle_sensor_error(logger);
        return;
    }

    logger->log_buffer[0] = '\0';
    snprintf(logger->log_buffer, sizeof(logger->log_buffer), "%d", data);
    logger->log_buffer[sizeof(logger->log_buffer) - 1] = '\0';

    if (write(logger.i2c_fd, &data, 2) < 0) {
        handle_sensor_error(logger);
        return;
    }

    logger->log_buffer[sizeof(logger->log_buffer) - 1] = '\0';
    status = (data & 0xFF00) >> 8;
    data = data & 0x00FF;

    if (status == 0) {
        logger->log_buffer[sizeof(logger->log_buffer) - 1] = '\0';
        snprintf(logger->log_buffer, sizeof(logger->log_buffer), "%d,%d", data, status);
    } else {
        logger->log_buffer[sizeof(logger->log_buffer) - 1] = '\0';
        snprintf(logger->log_buffer, sizeof(logger->log_buffer), "%d,%d,%d", data, status, 0);
    }

    if (write(logger.i2c_fd, logger->log_buffer, strlen(logger->log_buffer)) < 0) {
        handle_sensor_error(logger);
        return;
    }

    logger->log_buffer[sizeof(logger->log_buffer) - 1] = '\0';
    int lux = data;
    if (lux < RED_THRESHOLD) {
        set_relay_state(0, RELAY_ON);
    } else if (lux < GREEN_THRESHOLD) {
        set_relay_state(0, RELAY_OFF);
        set_relay_state(1, RELAY_ON);
    } else if (lux < BLUE_THRESHOLD) {
        set_relay_state(0, RELAY_OFF);
        set_relay_state(1, RELAY_OFF);
        set_relay_state(2, RELAY_ON);
    } else {
        set_relay_state(0, RELAY_OFF);
        set_relay_state(1, RELAY_OFF);
        set_relay_state(2, RELAY_OFF);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    cleanup_i2c();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    BH1750_LOGGER logger;
    init_i2c();

    while (1) {
        read_light_level(&logger);
        log_to_file(&logger);
        usleep(120 * 1000);
        usleep(1000 * 1000);
    }

    return 0;
}

#define ACCEL_Y_OFFSET 0x05
#define ACCEL_Z_OFFSET 0x06

#include <stdio.h>

#include <linux/i2c_smbus.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x29
#define RELAY_PIN 18
#define POLL_INTERVAL 100000  // 100ms

volatile sig_atomic_t sigint_received = false;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    sigint_received = true;
    // Cleanly release resources
    close_i2c();
    digitalWrite(RELAY_PIN, 0);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void close_i2c() {
    if (i2c_device_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_device_fd);
        i2c_device_fd = -1;
    }
}

void digitalWrite(int pin, int value) {
    if (gpio_fd != -1) {
        int ret = ioctl(gpio_fd, GPIO_GET_DIR, pin);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("ioctl GPIO_GET_DIR");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        ret = ioctl(gpio_fd, GPIO_SET_DIR, pin, value);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("ioctl GPIO_SET_DIR");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    // Initialize signal handler for SIGINT
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Initialize GPIO driver
    if ((gpio_fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open /dev/gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set GPIO18 to output mode
    if (ioctl(gpio_fd, GPIO_GET_MODE, RELAY_PIN) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl GPIO_GET_MODE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(gpio_fd, GPIO_SET_MODE, RELAY_PIN, GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl GPIO_SET_MODE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Initialize I2C device
    if ((i2c_device_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open /dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_device_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Initialize VL53L1X driver
    if (vl53l1x_init(i2c_device_fd) < 0) {
        perror("vl53l1x_init");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Main loop
    while (!sigint_received) {
        // Read distance
        uint16_t distance = vl53l1x_get_distance(i2c_device_fd);
        if (distance == VL53L1X_ERROR) {
            fprintf(stderr, "VL53L1X error: %d\n", distance);
        } else {
            // Print distance
            printf("%d cm\n", distance);

            // Set relay based on distance
            if (distance <= 50) {
                digitalWrite(RELAY_PIN, 1);
            } else {
                digitalWrite(RELAY_PIN, 0);
            }
        }

        // Poll every 100ms
        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL);
    }

    return 0;

#define GPIO17 17

#define GPIO22 22

#define LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S,%ld,%d,%d,%d,%d"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    int pin;
    int mode;
    int value;
    int edge;
} GPIOHandler;

void log_event(int pin, int value, int timestamp) {
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(log_file, LOG_FORMAT, time(NULL), pin, value);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    for (GPIOHandler *handler = handlers; handler; handler = handler->next) {
        if (handler->line) {
            gpiod_line_request_stop(handler->line);
            gpiod_line_unref(handler->line);
        }
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    int handlers_count = 4;
    GPIOHandler *handlers = calloc(handlers_count, sizeof(GPIOHandler));
    if (!handlers) {
        perror("Failed to allocate memory for handlers");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < handlers_count; i++) {
        handlers[i].pin = GPIO17 + i;
        handlers[i].fd = -1;
        handlers[i].chip = NULL;
        handlers[i].line = NULL;
        handlers[i].edge = NULL;
        handlers[i].mode = GPIOD_MODE_INPUT;
        handlers[i].value = 0;
        handlers[i].edge = GPIOD_EDGE_NONE;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < handlers_count; i++) {
        handlers[i].fd = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod");
        if (handlers[i].fd < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open gpiod device");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        handlers[i].chip = gpiod_chip_open(handlers[i].fd);
        if (handlers[i].chip == NULL) {
            perror("Failed to open gpiod chip");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        handlers[i].line = gpiod_chip_request_line(handlers[i].chip, handlers[i].pin);
        if (handlers[i].line == NULL) {
            perror("Failed to request line");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        handlers[i].edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(handlers[i].line, handlers[i].edge);
        if (handlers[i].edge == NULL) {
            perror("Failed to request edge");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (gpiod_line_request_mode(handlers[i].line, handlers[i].mode) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set mode");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (gpiod_line_request_value(handlers[i].line, handlers[i].value) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set value");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (gpiod_line_request_edge(handlers[i].line, handlers[i].edge) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set edge");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        handlers[i].next = handlers + (i + 1) % handlers_count;
    }

    int pwm_fd = gpiod_chip_request_pwm(handlers[0].chip, GPIO17);
    if (pwm_fd < 0) {

    gpiod_pwm_request_stop(pwm);

            gpiod_line_request_stop(handler->line);
            gpiod_line_unref(handler->line);
        }
    }

    gpiod_chip_request_stop(handlers[0].chip);

    gpiod_close(handlers[0].fd);

    free(handlers);

#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <wiringPi.h>
#include <wiringPiGpio.h>

#define I2C_FILE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define SI1145_ADDR 0x60
#define SI1145_AMBIENT_REG 0x03
#define SI1145_PROX_REG 0x0F
#define SI1145_RESET_REG 0x0E
#define SI1145_POWER_DOWN_REG 0x0D
#define SI1145_CONFIG_REG 0x0C
#define SI1145_CONTROL_REG 0x0B
#define SI1145_STATUS_REG 0x0A
#define SI1145_LED_REG 0x0F
#define SI1145_LED_ON 0x01
#define SI1145_LED_OFF 0x00

#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define RETRY_DELAY 10

#define LOG_FILE "biometric_log.txt"

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(log_fd);
    digitalWrite(17, 0);
    exit(0);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(log_fd);
    digitalWrite(17, 0);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    wiringPiGpioInit();
    wiringPiSetupGpio();
    pinMode(17, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(17, 0);

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);

    int i2c_fd = open(I2C_FILE, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, SI1145_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C nackt, SI1145_RESET_REG) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to reset sensor");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_CONFIG_REG) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read configuration register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_CONTROL_REG) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read control register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_STATUS_REG) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read status register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_PROX_REG) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read proximity register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_AMBIENT_REG) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read ambient light register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    char buffer[2];
    int retries = 0;
    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_AMBIENT_REG) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read ambient light register");
            retries++;
            if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
                usleep(RETRY_DELAY);
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read ambient light register after %d retries\n", retries);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (read(i2c_fd, buffer, 1) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read ambient light register");
            retries++;
            if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
                usleep(RETRY_DELAY);
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read ambient light register after %d retries\n", retries);
                break;
            }
        }

        int ambient = (int)buffer[0];

        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C.getOwnProperty, SI1145_PROX_REG) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read proximity register");
            retries++;
            if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
                usleep(RETRY_DELAY);
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read proximity register after %d retries\n", retries);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (read(i2c_fd, buffer, 1) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read proximity register");
            retries++;
            if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
                usleep(RETRY_DELAY);
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read proximity register after %d retries\n", retries);
                break;
            }
        }

        int proximity = (int)buffer[0];

        if (proximity > 100) {
            digitalWrite(17, 1);
        } else {
            digitalWrite(17, 0);
        }

        char log_line[100];
        snprintf(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%s,%d,%d", ctime(&current_time), ambient, proximity);
        if (write(log_fd, log_line, strlen(log_line)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to log file");
            break;
        }

        usleep(100000);
    }

    close(i2c_fd);
    close(log_fd);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO23 23
#define GPIO24 24
#define LOG_FILE "seismic_events.txt"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    int edge_type;
    int edge_count;
    int high_count;
    int high_start;
    int high_end;
    int high_duration;
    int high_duration_threshold;
    int high_duration_flag;
} SeismicSensor;

SeismicSensor sensors[2] = {{0}, {0}};

void handle_seismic_event(SeismicSensor *sensor) {
    char timestamp[128];
    struct timeval tv;
    struct tm *t;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    t = localtime(&tv.tv_sec);
    strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", t);
    fprintf(sensors[0].fd, "%s - Seismic event detected!\n", timestamp);
    fflush(sensors[0].fd);
    usleep(2000000); // 2 seconds
    if (sensors[0].line->direction == GPIOD_LINE_DIR_OUT) {
        gpio_set_value(sensors[0].line->number, 0);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            if (sensors[i].line) {
                gpio_set_value(sensors[i].line->number, 0);
            }
        }
        close(sensors[0].fd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

    result = gpiod_init();

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    d->fd_motor_a = gpiod_get_fd(d->fd_motor_a);
    if (d->fd_motor_a < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to get GPIO fd for Motor A: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    d->fd_motor_b = gpiod_new_line(MOTOR_B_PIN);
    if (d->fd_motor_b < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open GPIO line for Motor B: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    d->fd_motor_b = gpiod_get_fd(d->fd_motor_b);
    if (d->fd_motor_b < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to get GPIO fd for Motor B: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    d->fd_ena = gpiod_new_line(ENA_PIN);
    if (d->fd_ena < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open GPIO line for ENA: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    d->fd_ena = gpiod_get_fd(d->fd_ena);
    if (d->fd_ena < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to get GPIO fd for ENA: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    d->fd_enb = gpiod_new_line(ENB_PIN);

        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open GPIO line for ENB: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(d->fd);
        close(d->log_fd);
        return 1;
    }

        return 1;
    }
