static int set_motor_speed(int fd, int speed) {
    if (speed < -255 || speed > 255) {
        return 1;
    }
    return gpiod_set_value(fd, speed);
}

static int get_motor_speed(int fd) {
    int value;
    if (gpiod_get_value(fd, &value) < 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    return value;
}

static int get_tilt_error() {
    return (rand() % 21) - 10.0;
}

static int get_distance() {
    return (rand() % 198) + 2.0;
}

static int log_data(double tilt_error, double distance, int motor_a_speed, int motor_b_speed) {
    char buffer[256];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), LOG_FORMAT, timeinfo);
    fprintf(driver.log_fd, "%s,%f,%f,%d,%d\n", buffer, tilt_error, distance, motor_a_speed, motor_b_speed);
    fflush(driver.log_fd);
    return 0;
}

static int main() {
    Driver d;
    int ret = 0;
    int motor_a_speed = 0;
    int motor_b_speed = 0;
    double tilt_error = 0.0;
    double distance = 0.0;

    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint) == SIG_ERR) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SIGINT handler: %s", strerror(errno));
        return 1;
    }

    if (init_driver() < 0) {
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        tilt_error = get_tilt_error();
        distance = get_distance();

        if (distance < 20.0) {
            motor_a_speed = -128;
            motor_b_speed = -128;
        } else {
            motor_a_speed = 128;
            motor_b_speed = 128;
        }

        log_data(tilt_error, distance, motor_a_speed, motor_b_speed);

        if (set_motor_speed(driver.fd_motor_a, motor_a_speed) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set Motor A speed: %s", strerror(errno));
        }
        if (set_motor_speed(driver.fd_motor_b, motor_b_speed) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set Motor B speed: %s", strerror(errno));
        }

        usleep(5000000); // 50ms
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x29
#define INT_TIME 154
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL 500000  // 500 ms in microseconds

int i2c_fd;
int pi_fd;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    if (pi_fd != -1) {
        close(pi_fd);
    }
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg req;
    char buf[2];
    uint8_t data[4];
    uint32_t timestamp;
    FILE *fp;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    if ((pi_fd = pigpio_open(0)) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_open");
        return 1;
    }

    if ((i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
    req.msgs_count = 2;
    req.msgs[0].type = I2C_WRITE;
    req.msgs[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    req.msgs[0].len = 2;
    req.msgs[0].data[0] = 0x00;  // Set integration time
    req.msgs[0].data[1] = INT_TIME;

    memset(&msg[0], 0, sizeof(msg[0]));
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].len = 2;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x00;  // Read data
    msg[0].data[1] = 0x00;

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &req, msg) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return 1;
    }

    if (read(i2c_fd, data, 2) < 0) {
        perror("read");
        return 1;
    }

    if (write(pi_fd, data, 2) < 0) {
        perror("write");
        return 1;
    }

    fp = fopen("color_data.csv", "w");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return 1;
    }

    fprintf(fp, "timestamp,C,R,G,B\n");

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &req, msg) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl");
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C read/write failed\n");
            break;
        }

        if (read(i2c_fd, data, 2) < 0) {
            perror("read");
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C read failed\n");
            break;
        }

        if (write(pi_fd, data, 2) < 0) {
            perror("write");
            fprintf(stderr, "Pi write failed\n");
            break;
        }

        timestamp = time(NULL);
        fprintf(fp, "%lu,%d,%d,%d,%d\n", timestamp, data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]);

        usleep(SAMPLE_INTERVAL);
    }

    fclose(fp);
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(pi_fd);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <linux/i2c.h>
#include <linux/i2c_rdwr.h>
#include <linux/i2c_smbus.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define RELAY_COUNT 4
#define RELAY_PIN_BCM 4  // GPIO4
#define RELAY_PIN_BCM_1 17 // GPIO17
#define RELAY_PIN_BCM_2 27 // GPIO27
#define RELAY_PIN_BCM_3 22 // GPIO22

#define LOG_FILE "irrigation_log.txt"

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < RELAY_COUNT; i++) {
        gpiod_pin_t pin = gpiod_get_pin_by_number(RELAY_PIN_BCM + i);
        if (pin) {
            gpiod_pin_set_value(pin, GPIOD_PIN_VALUE_HIGH);
        }
    }
    close(log_file);
    gpiod_release_driver(driver);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    int log_file = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (log_file < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct gpiod_driver *driver;
    if ((driver = gpiod_new_driver()) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create driver");
        close(log_file);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_driver_add_newline(driver) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to add newline");
        close(log_file);
        gpiod_release_driver(driver);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < RELAY_COUNT; i++) {
        int pin = RELAY_PIN_BCM + i;
        if (gpiod_driver_add_pin(driver, pin, GPIOD_PIN_DIR_OUTPUT) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to add pin");
            close(log_file);
            gpiod_release_driver(driver);
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }

    if (gpiod_driver_open(driver, I2C_DEVICE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        close(log_file);
        gpiod_release_driver(driver);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_driver_start(driver) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to start driver");
        close(log_file);
        gpiod_release_driver(driver);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);

    srand(time(NULL));

    while (1) {
        int moisture = rand() % 100 + 30;
        char buffer[128];
        struct gpiod_pin *pin;
        int pin_value;

        snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%ld, ", (long)time(NULL));

        for (int i = 0; i < RELAY_COUNT; i++) {
            pin = gpiod_get_pin_by_number(RELAY_PIN_BCM + i);
            if (pin) {
                pin_value = gpiod_pin_get_value(pin);
                if (pin_value == GPIOD_PIN_VALUE_LOW) {
                    strcat(buffer, "ON, ");
                } else {
                    strcat(buffer, "OFF, ");
                }
            } else {
                strcat(buffer, "UNKNOWN, ");
            }
        }
        strcat(buffer, "\n");

        if (write(log_file, buffer, strlen(buffer)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to log file");
            close(log_file);
            gpiod_release_driver(driver);
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        int moisture_level = moisture < 30 ? 0 : 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < RELAY_COUNT; i++) {
            pin = gpiod_get_pin_by_number(RELAY_PIN_BCM + i);
            if (pin) {
                if (moisture_level) {
                    gpiod_pin_set_value(pin, GPIOD_PIN_VALUE_LOW);
                } else {
                    gpiod_pin_set_value(pin, GPIOD_PIN_VALUE_HIGH);
                }
            }
        }

        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds
    }

    close(log_file);
    gpiod_release_driver(driver);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

    if (ioctl(SensorData.i2c_fd, I2C_SET_ADDRESS, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C address");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Register I2C handle
    if ((SensorData.i2c_handle = ioctl(SensorData.i2c_fd, I2C_GET_HANDLE)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to register I2C handle");
        goto cleanup;

    // Open GPIO relay
    if ((SensorData.relay_fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Register GPIO handle
    if ((SensorData.relay_handle = ioctl(SensorData.relay_fd, I2C_GET_HANDLE)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to register GPIO handle");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Create GPIO chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_new()) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create GPIO chip");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Create GPIO line
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, RELAY_GPIO)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create GPIO line");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Create GPIO edge
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_create_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create GPIO edge");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Create GPIO state
    if ((state = gpiod_edge_create_state(edge, GPIOD_STATE_ACTIVE)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create GPIO state");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Set GPIO state
    if (gpiod_edge_set_state(edge, state) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO state");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Set GPIO direction to output
    if (gpiod_line_set_direction(line, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_OUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO direction");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Set GPIO value to 0 (inactive)
    if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Initialize SensorData
    SensorData.relay_fd = SensorData.relay_handle;
    SensorData.relay_handle = line;
    SensorData.line = line;
    SensorData.edge = edge;
    SensorData.state = state;
    SensorData.error = 0;
    SensorData.last_read = 0;
    SensorData.last_write = 0;
    SensorData.last_error = 0;
    SensorData.last_relay_state = 0;
    SensorData.last_timestamp = 0;

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read I2C data
        if (SensorData.error == 0) {
            msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
            msg[0].buf = &value;
            msg[0].len = sizeof(value);
            msg[0].flags = 0;
            if (ioctl(SensorData.i2c_handle, I2C_RDWR, msg) < 0) {
                SensorData.error = errno;
                goto cleanup;
            }
            SensorData.last_read = (int) value;
        }

            // Check if value exceeds threshold

                    if (gpiod_line_set_value(SensorData.line, RELAY_ACTIVE_HIGH) < 0) {
                        SensorData.error = errno;
                        goto cleanup;
                    }
                    SensorData.last_relay_state = 1;
                    relay_poll_attempts = 0;
                }
            } else {
                // Deactivate relay if triggered
                if (SensorData.last_relay_state == 1) {
                    if (gpiod_line_set_value(SensorData.line, 0) < 0) {
                        SensorData.error = errno;
                        goto cleanup;
                    }
                    SensorData.last_relay_state = 0;
                    relay_poll_attempts = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Write timestamp to log file
        timestamp = time(NULL);
        strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&timestamp));
        fprintf(stderr, "%s %f\n", buffer, SensorData.last_read);

        // Sleep for POLL_INTERVAL_MS
        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);

        // Check for errors
        if (SensorData.error > 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", strerror(SensorData.error));
            goto cleanup;
        }

        // Check if relay has been polled for POLL_ATTEMPTS times
        if (relay_poll_attempts >= POLL_ATTEMPTS) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Timeout error: register did not clear\n");
            goto cleanup;
        }

        relay_poll_attempts++;
    }

cleanup:
    // Close I2C device
    if (SensorData.i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(SensorData.i2c_fd);
    }

    // Close GPIO device
    if (SensorData.relay_fd > 0) {
        close(SensorData.relay_fd);
    }

    // Destroy GPIO line, edge, and state
    gpiod_edge_destroy(edge);
    gpiod_line_unref(SensorData.line);
    gpiod_edge_unref(SensorData.edge);
    gpiod_state_unref(SensorData.state);

    // Destroy GPIO chip
    gpiod_chip_destroy(chip);

    // Unexport I2C bus
    gpiod_unexport(I2C_BUS);

    // Exit
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <termios.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO18 18
#define GPIO21 21
#define GPIO22 22
#define PULSE_WIDTH_LOCK 2000
#define PULSE_WIDTH_UNLOCK 1000
#define PULSE_WIDTH_STOP 0

int fd;
gpiod_device_t *dev;
gpiod_line_mfd_t *line;
gpiod_line_t *line_lock, *line_unlock, *line_stop;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        line_lock->value = PULSE_WIDTH_STOP;
        line_unlock->value = PULSE_WIDTH_STOP;
        line_stop->value = PULSE_WIDTH_STOP;
        gpiod_line_write(dev, line_lock, 0);
        gpiod_line_write(dev, line_unlock, 0);
        gpiod_line_write(dev, line_stop, 0);
        gpiod_device_free(dev);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    dev = gpiod_open(fd);
    if (dev == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    line = gpiod_get_line(dev, GPIO18);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line for GPIO18");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    line_lock = gpiod_get_line(dev, GPIO21);
    if (line_lock == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line for GPIO21");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    line_unlock = gpiod_get_line(dev, GPIO22);
    if (line_unlock == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line for GPIO22");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    line_stop = gpiod_get_line(dev, GPIO18);
    if (line_stop == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line for GPIO18");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line, GPIOD_PULL_UP) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line pull");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line_lock, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line_lock, GPIOD_PULL_UP) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line pull");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line_unlock, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line_unlock, GPIOD_PULL_UP) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line pull");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line_stop, GPIOD_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line_stop, GPIOD_PULL_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line pull");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    gpiod_line_enable(line, 1);
    gpiod_line_enable(line_lock, 1);
    gpiod_line_enable(line_unlock, 1);
    gpiod_line_enable(line_stop, 1);

    int res;
    while (1) {
        struct pollfd pfd[4];
        pfd[0].fd = fd;
        pfd[0].events = POLLIN;
        pfd[1].fd = line->fd;
        pfd[1].events = POLLIN;
        pfd[2].fd = line_lock->fd;
        pfd[2].events = POLLIN;
        pfd[3].fd = line_unlock->fd;
        pfd[3].events = POLLIN;

        res = poll(pfd, 4, 1000);
        if (res < 0) {
            perror("poll failed");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        if (pfd[0].revents & POLLIN) {
            if (gpiod_line_read(line, 0) == 0) {
                printf("Lock button pressed\n");
                res = gpiod_line_write(dev, line_lock, PULSE_WIDTH_LOCK);
                if (res < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to write pulse width to GPIO21");
                    return EXIT_FAILURE;
                }
            } else {
                printf("Lock button released\n");
            }
        }

        if (pfd[1].revents & POLLIN) {
            if (gpiod_line_read(line_lock, 0) == 0) {
                printf("Unlock button pressed\n");
                res = gpiod_line_write(dev, line_unlock, PULSE_WIDTH_UNLOCK);
                if (res < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to write pulse width to GPIO22");
                    return EXIT_FAILURE;
                }
            } else {
                printf("Unlock button released\n");
            }
        }

        if (pfd[2].revents & POLLIN) {
            if (gpiod_line_read(line, 0) == 0) {
                printf("Lock button released\n");
            } else {
                printf("Lock button pressed\n");
                res = gpiod_line_write(dev, line_lock, PULSE_WIDTH_LOCK);
                if (res < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to write pulse width to GPIO21");
                    return EXIT_FAILURE;
                }
            }
        }

        if (pfd[3].revents & POLLIN) {
            if (gpiod_line_read(line_unlock, 0) == 0) {
                printf("Unlock button released\n");
            } else {
                printf("Unlock button pressed\n");
                res = gpiod_line_write(dev, line_unlock, PULSE_WIDTH_UNLOCK);
                if (res < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to write pulse width to GPIO22");
                    return EXIT_FAILURE;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#define BH1750_ADDR 0x23
#define I2C_BUS 1
#define GPIO_PIN 17
#define LOG_FILE "chicken_coop_log.txt"
#define DAWN_LUX 200
#define DUSK_LUX 50

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int gpio_fd;
    struct i2c_msg i2c_msg;
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg i2c_rdwr_msg;
    struct gpio_request request;
    struct gpio_event event;
    struct timeval last_read;
    int last_lux;
    int last_relay;
} SensorMonitor;

void init_sensor(SensorMonitor *sensor) {
    if ((sensor->fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(sensor->fd, I2C_SLAVE, BH1750_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    sensor->i2c_msg.addr = BH1750_ADDR;
    sensor->i2c_msg.flags |= I2C_M_RD;
    sensor->i2c_msg.buf = (unsigned char *) &sensor->last_lux;
    sensor->i2c_rdwr_msg.msgs = &sensor->i2c_msg;
    sensor->i2c_rdwr_msg.len = sizeof(sensor->i2c_msg);
    sensor->request.request = I2C_RDWR;
    sensor->request.flags = I2C_GIOCSAD;
    if (ioctl(sensor->fd, I2C_GIOCSAD, &sensor->request) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to enable I2C address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(sensor->fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to enable SMBus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if ((sensor->gpio_fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpio_request_new(&sensor->request, GPIO_PIN, GPIO_EDGE_FALL)) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (request_setup(&sensor->request, GPIO_EDGE_FALL, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (request_enable(&sensor->request) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to enable GPIO event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_lux(SensorMonitor *sensor) {
    if (ioctl(sensor->fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, I2C_SMBHCTL1_RD) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read lux");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(sensor->fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, I2C_SMBHCTL1_RD) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read lux");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (read(sensor->fd, &sensor->last_lux, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read lux");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

        if (gpio_set_value(&sensor->request, GPIO_HIGH) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    } else {
        if (gpio_set_value(&sensor->request, GPIO_LOW) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
    sensor->last_relay = state;
}

void log_data(SensorMonitor *sensor) {
    char buffer[128];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
    fprintf(stderr, "Logging: %s, Lux = %d, Relay = %d\n", buffer, sensor->last_lux, sensor->last_relay);
    fprintf(stderr, "Writing to log file: %s, Lux = %d, Relay = %d\n", buffer, sensor->last_lux, sensor->last_relay);
    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "Log file opened successfully\n");
    fprintf(stderr, "Writing to log file: %s, Lux = %d, Relay = %d\n", buffer, sensor->last_lux, sensor->last_relay);
    fprintf(stderr, "Closing log file\n");
    if (fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a")) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_signal(SensorMonitor *sensor, int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Received signal %d, shutting down\n", signum);
        log_data(sensor);
        if (sensor->gpio_fd > 0) {
            if (gpio_request_free(&sensor->request) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to free GPIO request");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
            if (request_disable(&sensor->request) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to disable GPIO event");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
            if (close(sensor->gpio_fd) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to close GPIO device");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }
        if (sensor->i2c_fd > 0) {
            if (close(sensor->i2c_fd) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to close I2C device");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }
        if (sensor->fd > 0) {
            if (close(sensor->fd) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to close I2C device");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "Exiting cleanly\n");
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    SensorMonitor sensor;
    init_sensor(&sensor);
    while (1) {
        read_lux(&sensor);
        if (sensor.last_lux < DUSK_LUX && sensor.last_lux > sensor.last_relay) {
            write_relay(&sensor, 1);
        } else if (sensor.last_lux > DAWN_LUX && sensor.last_lux < sensor.last_relay) {
            write_relay(&sensor, 0);
        }
        log_data(&sensor);
        usleep(180000); // Wait at least 180ms after issuing the mode command
    }
    return 0;
}

        goto cleanup;

        goto cleanup;

    return 0;

        if (line->last_value == 0) {
            if (line->last_time + DEBOUNCE_MS > clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &line->ts).tv_sec * 1000 + line->ts.tv_nsec / 1000) {

                        goto cleanup;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (write(line->fd, "0", 1) != 1) {
                        perror("Failed to write to /dev/relay");
                        goto cleanup;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    struct timespec ts;
} MotorMonitor;

void handle_signal(int sig) {
    MotorMonitor *monitor = (MotorMonitor *) sig;
    if (monitor) {
        monitor->line->release();
        monitor->chip->release();
        close(monitor->fd);
        close(monitor->line->dev);
        close(monitor->event->dev);

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;

    monitor.chip = NULL;
    monitor.line = NULL;
    monitor.edge = NULL;
    monitor.event = NULL;

    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

        perror("Failed to get GPIO chip");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Get GPIO line
    if (ioctl(monitor.fd, GIOCGLINE, &monitor.line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set GPIO line to input with pull-up
    if (ioctl(monitor.fd, GPIOCLEAR, monitor.line->line_number) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to clear GPIO line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(monitor.fd, GPIOPRINT, monitor.line->line_number, GPIOPRINT_PU) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set pull-up");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Create edge and event
    if ((edge = gpiod_create_edge(monitor.line->line_number, GPIOD_EDGE_RISING)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create edge");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if ((event = gpiod_create_event(edge, GPIOD_EVENT_EDGE, GPIOD_EVENT_TRIGGER)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set event to edge
    if (gpiod_set_event(edge, event, GPIOD_EVENT_SET) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Start monitoring
    while (1) {
        // Wait for edge
        if (gpiod_wait_event(edge, &event) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to wait for edge");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        // Debounce
        if (count > 0 && (monitor.ts.tv_sec - event->ts.tv_sec) * 1000 + (monitor.ts.tv_nsec - event->ts.tv_nsec) / 1000000.0 < DEBOUNCE_MS) {
            continue;
        }

        // Update timestamp
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &monitor.ts);
        snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%s", ctime(&monitor.ts.tv_sec));

        // Count pulse
        count++;

        // Compute RPM
        if ((monitor.ts.tv_sec % (INTERVAL_MS / 1000)) == 0) {
            double rpm = (count * 60.0) / (INTERVAL_MS / 1000.0);
            printf("%.2f RPM\n", rpm);

            // Write to log

            if (log == NULL) {
                perror("Failed to open log file");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
            fprintf(log, "%s,%.2f\n", timestamp, rpm);
            fflush(log);
            fclose(log);
        }

        // Reset count
        count = 0;
    }

    return 0;
}

    int gpio_fd;
    int sensor_fd;
    bool initialized;
    bool running;
} MPR121State;

void mpr121_init(MPR121State *state) {
    if (state->initialized) return;

    state->initialized = false;

    // Open I2C bus
    state->i2c_fd = open(MPR121_DEV_NAME, O_RDWR);
    if (state->i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return;
    }

    // Set I2C address
    if (ioctl(state->i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C address");
        return;
    }

    // Initialize MPR121
    if (mpr121_soft_reset(state->i2c_fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to perform soft reset");
        return;
    }

    // Set filter parameters
    if (mpr121_set_filter(state->i2c_fd, 0x00) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set filter parameters");
        return;
    }

    // Set touch and release thresholds
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_ELECTRODES; i++) {
        if (mpr121_set_threshold(state->i2c_fd, i, TOUCH_THRESHOLD, RELEASE_THRESHOLD) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set threshold for electrode %d", i);
            return;
        }
    }

    // Enable run mode
    if (mpr121_set_run_mode(state->i2c_fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to enable run mode");
        return;
    }

    state->initialized = true;
}

int mpr121_soft_reset(int i2c_fd) {
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    uint8_t reg[1] = {0x00};
    if (write(i2c_fd, reg, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int mpr121_set_filter(int i2c_fd, uint8_t filter) {
    uint8_t reg[1] = {filter};
    if (write(i2c_fd, reg, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int mpr121_set_threshold(int i2c_fd, int electrode, uint8_t touch_threshold, uint8_t release_threshold) {
    uint8_t reg[3] = {0x00, 0x00, 0x00};
    reg[0] = 0x01 + electrode;
    reg[1] = touch_threshold;
    reg[2] = release_threshold;
    if (write(i2c_fd, reg, 3) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int mpr121_set_run_mode(int i2c_fd) {
    uint8_t reg[1] = {0x0F};
    if (write(i2c_fd, reg, 1) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

void mpr121_read_status(MPR121State *state, RelayState *relay) {
    uint8_t reg[1] = {0x00};
    if (write(state->i2c_fd, reg, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read status register");
        return;
    }

    if (read(state->i2c_fd, reg, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read status register");
        return;
    }

    relay->touch_status[0] = (reg[0] & 0x01) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[1] = (reg[0] & 0x02) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[2] = (reg[0] & 0x04) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[3] = (reg[0] & 0x08) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[4] = (reg[0] & 0x10) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[5] = (reg[0] & 0x20) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[6] = (reg[0] & 0x40) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[7] = (reg[0] & 0x80) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[8] = (reg[0] & 0x01) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[9] = (reg[0] & 0x02) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[10] = (reg[0] & 0x04) ? 1 : 0;
    relay->touch_status[11] = (reg[0] & 0x08) ? 1 : 0;

    relay->relay_state = relay->touch_status[0] | relay->touch_status[1] | relay->touch_status[2] | relay->touch_status[3] | relay->touch_status[4] | relay->touch_status[5] | relay->touch_status[6] | relay->touch_status[7] | relay->touch_status[8] | relay->touch_status[9] | relay->touch_status[10] | relay->touch_status[11];
}

void relay_state_to_file(RelayState *relay, const char *filename) {
    FILE *fp = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (!fp) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }

    char buffer[128];
    sprintf(buffer, "%ld %d\n", relay->timestamp, relay->relay_state);
    if (fwrite(buffer, 1, strlen(buffer), fp) < strlen(buffer)) {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
    }

    fclose(fp);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (mpr121_state->running) {
        mpr121_state->running = false;
        mpr121_state->initialized = false;
    }

    if (mpr121_state->i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(mpr121_state->i2c_fd);
    }

    if (mpr121_state->gpio_fd > 0) {
        close(mpr121_state->gpio_fd);
    }

    if (mpr121_state->sensor_fd > 0) {
        close(mpr121_state->sensor_fd);
    }

    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

    MPR121State mpr121_state;
    RelayState relay_state;

    mpr121_state.i2c_fd = -1;
    mpr121_state.gpio_fd = -1;
    mpr121_state.sensor_fd = -1;
    mpr121_state.initialized = false;
    mpr121_state.running = false;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    mpr121_init(&mpr121_state);

    if (!mpr121_state.initialized) {
        perror("Initialization failed");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    mpr121_state.running = true;

    FILE *gpio_file = fopen(GPIO_RELAY_FILE, "w");
    if (!gpio_file) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO relay file");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    fprintf(gpio_file, "direction=high\n");
    fclose(gpio_file);

    while (mpr121_state.running) {
        mpr121_read_status(&mpr121_state, &relay_state);

        if (relay_state.relay_state) {
            if (mpr121_state.gpio_fd > 0) {
                if (write(mpr121_state.gpio_fd, "1", 1) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set GPIO relay to HIGH");
                }
            } else {
                mpr121_state.gpio_fd = open(GPIO_RELAY_FILE, O_WRONLY);
                if (mpr121_state.gpio_fd < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to open GPIO relay file");
                    continue;
                }

                if (write(mpr121_state.gpio_fd, "1", 1) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set GPIO relay to HIGH");
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (mpr121_state.gpio_fd > 0) {
                if (write(mpr121_state.gpio_fd, "0", 1) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set GPIO relay to LOW");
                }
            } else {
                mpr121_state.gpio_fd = open(GPIO_RELAY_FILE, O_WRONLY);
                if (mpr121_state.gpio_fd < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to open GPIO relay file");
                    continue;
                }

                if (write(mpr121_state.gpio_fd, "0", 1) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set GPIO relay to LOW");
                }
            }
        }

        relay_state.timestamp = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
        relay_state_to_file(&relay_state, LOG_FILE);

        usleep(DELAY_USEC * 1000 + DELAY_MS * 1000);
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B that continuously monitors a weight‑triggered solenoid lock using a load cell amplified by an HX711 on the GPIO bus, with the HX711 data line connected to GPIO4 (BCM) and the clock line to GPIO17 (BCM), and the solenoid lock driven by GPIO27 (BCM) as an active‑high lock signal; the program must read the HX711 sensor every 500 ms, enforce a read timeout of 0.5 seconds and gracefully skip any iteration where the timeout occurs, initialize the GPIO driver with error checking, load calibration data (scale_factor and offset) from a space‑separated calibration.txt file or fall back to defaults of scale = 1.0 and offset = 0.0 if the file is missing or invalid, perform a one‑time startup calibration by averaging 100 readings at zero load to determine the offset, compute weight using the loaded or default scale and offset, engage the solenoid (set GPIO27 high) when the computed weight exceeds a calibrated threshold of 10.0 kg, log each reading with a timestamp to weight_log.txt and write any updated calibration values back to calibration.txt, and handle SIGINT to cleanly shut down by releasing all GPIO resources and closing open files.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO4 4
#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO27 27
#define CALIBRATION_FILE "calibration.txt"
#define SCALE_DEFAULT 1.0
#define OFFSET_DEFAULT 0.0
#define THRESHOLD 10.0
#define CALIBRATION_SAMPLES 100
#define CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_INTERVAL 500

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_handle handle;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
} GPIOManager;

typedef struct {
    double scale;
    double offset;
} CalibrationData;

void sigint_handler(int sig) {
    GPIOManager *gpio = (GPIOManager *)malloc(sizeof(GPIOManager));
    gpio->fd = -1;
    gpio->handle = NULL;
    gpio->line = NULL;
    gpio->event = NULL;
    free(gpio);
    exit(0);
}

void init_gpio(GPIOManager *gpio) {
    if (gpio->fd < 0) {
        gpio->fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK);
        if (gpio->fd < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
    if (ioctl(gpio->fd, GPIO_GET_HANDLE, &gpio->handle) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get gpiod handle");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(gpio->handle, GPIO_GET_LINE, &gpio->line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_GET_EVENT, &gpio->event) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    gpio->line->direction = GPIODIR_OUT;
    if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line direction");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    gpio->line->value = 1;
    if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO line value");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void release_gpio(GPIOManager *gpio) {
    if (gpio->line) {
        gpio->line->direction = GPIODIR_IN;
        if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO line direction");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        gpio->line->value = 0;
        if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO line value");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
    if (gpio->event) {
        gpio->event->flags = 0;
        if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_EVENT, gpio->event) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO event flags");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
    if (gpio->handle) {
        if (ioctl(gpio->handle, GPIO_UNLINK_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to unlink GPIO line");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (ioctl(gpio->handle, GPIO_UNLINK_HANDLE) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to unlink gpiod handle");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
    if (gpio->fd > 0) {
        close(gpio->fd);
    }
    free(gpio);
}

CalibrationData read_calibration_data(const char *filename) {
    CalibrationData data;
    FILE *file = fopen(filename, "r");
    if (!file) {
        data.scale = SCALE_DEFAULT;
        data.offset = OFFSET_DEFAULT;
    } else {
        char line[128];
        while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), file)) {
            if (sscanf(line, "%lf %lf", &data.scale, &data.offset) < 2) {
                fclose(file);
                data.scale = SCALE_DEFAULT;
                data.offset = OFFSET_DEFAULT;
                break;
            }
        }
        fclose(file);
    }
    return data;
}

void calibrate_sensor(CalibrationData *data) {
    double sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < CALIBRATION_SAMPLES; i++) {
        double value = read_hx711(GPIO17);
        usleep(CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_INTERVAL);
        sum += value;
    }
    data->offset = sum / CALIBRATION_SAMPLES;
}

double read_hx711(int pin) {
    double value = 0;
    int count = 0;
    struct timeval start, end;
    gettimeofday(&start, NULL);
    while (count < 10) {
        value = read_hx711_once(pin);
        if (value != 0) {
            count++;
        }
        usleep(100);
        gettimeofday(&end, NULL);
        if ((end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) > 0.5) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return value;
}

double read_hx711_once(int pin) {
    double value = 0;
    FILE *file = fopen("/dev/i2c-1", "r");
    if (!file) {
        return 0;
    }
    char buf[16];
    if (fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), file)) {
        sscanf(buf, "%*[^0-9.%]+%lf", &value);
        fclose(file);
    }
    return value;
}

void log_reading(double weight, const char *filename) {
    FILE *file = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (!file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    struct timeval now;
    gettimeofday(&now, NULL);
    fprintf(file, "%ld.%06ld %lf\n", now.tv_sec, now.tv_usec, weight);
    fclose(file);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);
    CalibrationData data = read_calibration_data(CALIBRATION_FILE);
    calibrate_sensor(&data);
    double scale = data.scale;
    double offset = data.offset;
    double threshold = scale * (THRESHOLD - offset);
    GPIOManager *gpio = (GPIOManager *)malloc(sizeof(GPIOManager));
    init_gpio(gpio);
    while (1) {
        double weight = read_hx711(GPIO4);
        if (weight == 0) {
            continue;
        }
        weight -= offset;
        weight /= scale;
        if (weight > threshold) {
            gpio->line->value = 1;
            if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to set GPIO line value");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        } else {
            gpio->line->value = 0;
            if (ioctl(gpio->line, GPIO_SET_LINE, gpio->line) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to set GPIO line value");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }
        log_reading(weight, "weight_log.txt");
        usleep(500000);
    }
    release_gpio(gpio);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/signal.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define DT_PIN 23
#define SCK_PIN 24
#define LOCK_PIN 17
#define HX711_ADDR 0x38
#define HX711_GAIN 128
#define DT_TIMEOUT 1000000
#define LOCK_DURATION 5000000

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int dt_fd;
    int sck_fd;
    int lock_fd;
    int lock_active;
    struct gpiod_handle handle;
    struct gpiod_line *dt_line;
    struct gpiod_line *sck_line;
    struct gpiod_line *lock_line;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    struct gpiod_event *lock_event;
    struct gpiod_event *error_event;
    char *log_file;
} HX711StockMonitor;

void init_hx711(HX711StockMonitor *monitor) {
    int i2c_fd;
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg ioctl_msg;
    struct gpiod_device *device;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_event *event;

    monitor->fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (monitor->fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    msg[0].addr = HX711_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].data[0] = 0x10; // Set gain to 128
    ioctl_msg.msgs = msg;
    ioctl_msg.num_msgs = 1;
    ioctl_msg.control = I2C_RDWR;
    ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &ioctl_msg);

    device = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (!device) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_get_line(device, DT_PIN);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to get DT line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    monitor->dt_fd = line->fd;
    monitor->dt_line = line;

    line = gpiod_get_line(device, SCK_PIN);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to get SCK line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    monitor->sck_fd = line->fd;
    monitor->sck_line = line;

    line = gpiod_get_line(device, LOCK_PIN);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to get LOCK line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    monitor->lock_fd = line->fd;
    monitor->lock_line = line;

    monitor->lock_active = 0;
    event = gpiod_create_event(monitor->dt_line, DT_PIN, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 0);
    if (!event) {
        perror("Failed to create DT event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    monitor->error_event = gpiod_create_event(monitor->dt_line, DT_PIN, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 1);
    if (!monitor->error_event) {
        perror("Failed to create DT error event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    monitor->lock_event = gpiod_create_event(monitor->lock_line, LOCK_PIN, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, 0);
    if (!monitor->lock_event) {
        perror("Failed to create LOCK event");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    monitor->log_file = "stock_events.txt";
    if (access(monitor->log_file, F_OK) == -1) {
        if (mkdir("/tmp/stock_events", 0777) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create log directory");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (mkdir("/tmp/stock_events/stock_events", 0777) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create log directory");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (mkdir("/tmp/stock_events/stock_events.log", 0777) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create log directory");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (mkdir("/tmp/stock_events/stock_events.err", 0777) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create log directory");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (open(monitor->log_file, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_APPEND, 0777) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create log file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    gpiod_enable_event(monitor->dt_line, event);
    gpiod_enable_event(monitor->dt_line, monitor->error_event);
    gpiod_enable_event(monitor->lock_line, monitor->lock_event);
}

void read_hx711(HX711StockMonitor *monitor) {
    int dt_val;
    int sck_val;
    int dt_count = 0;
    int sck_count = 0;
    int i;
    int weight = 0;
    int timeout = DT_TIMEOUT;

    while (dt_count < 30) {
        if (read(monitor->dt_fd, &dt_val, 1) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read DT line");
            return;
        }
        if (read(monitor->sck_fd, &sck_val, 1) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read SCK line");
            return;
        }
        if (dt_val == 1 && sck_val == 1) {
            dt_count++;
            sck_count++;
        }
        if (dt_count == 30) {
            break;
        }
        usleep(1000);
        timeout--;
        if (timeout == 0) {
            return;
        }
    }

    if (dt_count < 30) {
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            weight += sck_count;
        }
    }

    weight = weight / 15;
    weight = weight / HX711_GAIN;

    if (weight < 100) {
        monitor->lock_active = 1;
    } else {
        monitor->lock_active = 0;
    }
}

void log_event(HX711StockMonitor *monitor, int type, int weight, int duration) {
    char log_buffer[256];
    struct timeval tv;
    struct tm *tm;
    int len;

    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    tm = localtime(&tv.tv_sec);
    strftime(log_buffer, 256, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ", tm);

    if (type == 0) {
        len = snprintf(log_buffer + strlen(log_buffer), 256, "Weight: %d g, Lock: %d, Duration: %d ms\n", weight, monitor->lock_active, duration);
    } else if (type == 1) {
        len = snprintf(log_buffer + strlen(log_buffer), 256, "Error: %s\n", log_buffer);
    } else {
        len = snprintf(log_buffer + strlen(log_buffer), 256, "Lock: %d\n", monitor->lock_active);
    }

    if (write(monitor->fd, log_buffer, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
    }
}

void handle_error(HX711StockMonitor *monitor) {
    char log_buffer[256];
    struct timeval tv;
    struct tm *tm;
    int len;

    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    tm = localtime(&tv.tv_sec);
    strftime(log_buffer, 256, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ", tm);

    len = snprintf(log_buffer + strlen(log_buffer), 256, "Error: %s\n", log_buffer);
    if (write(monitor->fd, log_buffer, len) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
    }
}

void cleanup(HX711StockMonitor *monitor) {
    gpiod_disable_event(monitor->dt_line, monitor->dt_line->event);
    gpiod_disable_event(monitor->dt_line, monitor->error_event);
    gpiod_disable_event(monitor->lock_line, monitor->lock_event);
    gpiod_close(monitor->dt_line);
    gpiod_close(monitor->sck_line);
    gpiod_close(monitor->lock_line);
    gpiod_close(monitor->handle);
    close(monitor->fd);
    free(monitor->log_file);
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    cleanup((HX711StockMonitor *)NULL);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    HX711StockMonitor monitor;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO_NUM 16
#define GPIO_NUM_RELAY 20
#define LOG_FILE "relay_events.log"
#define LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %ld %s\n"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
} GPIOHandler;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    GPIOHandler *handler = (GPIOHandler *) signal_info(signum)->si_signam;
    if (handler) {
        gpiod_line_close(handler->line);
        gpiod_chip_free(handler->chip);
        close(handler->fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

GPIOHandler *init_gpio_handler(int gpio_num) {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_event *event;

    fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
        return NULL;
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd);
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod_chip");
        close(fd);
        return NULL;
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, gpio_num);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO line");
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        close(fd);
        return NULL;
    }

    handler->fd = fd;
    handler->chip = chip;
    handler->line = line;

    event = gpiod_line_request_event(line, GPIOD_LINE_EVENT_EDGE);
    if (!event) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO event");
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        close(fd);
        return NULL;
    }

    return handler;
}

void read_gpio(GPIOHandler *handler) {
    int value;
    gpiod_line_get_value(handler->line, &value);
    if (value == 0) {
        printf("Obstacle detected\n");
        if (handler->line->direction == GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(handler->line, 1);
        } else {
            gpiod_line_set_value(handler->line, 0);
        }
    } else {
        printf("No obstacle detected\n");
        if (handler->line->direction == GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(handler->line, 0);
        } else {
            gpiod_line_set_value(handler->line, 1);
        }
    }
}

void log_event(int state, const char *message) {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];

    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), LOG_FORMAT, timeinfo);

    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file for appending");
        return;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", buffer, message);
    fprintf(stderr, "%s: %d\n", buffer, state);
    fprintf(f, "%s: %d\n", buffer, state);
    fclose(f);
}

int main() {
    GPIOHandler *handler = init_gpio_handler(GPIO_NUM);
    if (!handler) {
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    int state = 0;
    while (1) {
        read_gpio(handler);
        log_event(state, "Toggle event");
        state ^= 1;
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#define BUZZER_OFF 0

    int gpio;

void gpio_init(GPIOContext *ctx) {
    ctx->fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR);

        perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ctx->gpio = ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_GET_DEVICE, 0);
    if (ctx->gpio < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO device");
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ctx->gpio->direction = GPIO_DIR_OUT;
    if (ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_SET_DIRECTION, ctx->gpio) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO direction");
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ctx->gpio->value = BUZZER_OFF;
    if (ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_SET_VALUE, ctx->gpio) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ctx->buzzer = ctx->gpio->gpio[GPIO18];
    if (ctx->buzzer < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO 18");
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_GET_PIN, ctx->buzzer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO 18 pin");
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_SET_PIN, ctx->buzzer) < 0) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

void gpio_cleanup(GPIOContext *ctx) {
    if (ctx->fd >= 0) {
        close(ctx->fd);

}

void buzzer_on(GPIOContext *ctx) {
    if (ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_SET_PIN, ctx->buzzer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO 18 pin");
        gpio_cleanup(ctx);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void buzzer_off(GPIOContext *ctx) {
    if (ioctl(ctx->fd, GPIO_CLR_PIN, ctx->buzzer) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to clear GPIO 18 pin");
        gpio_cleanup(ctx);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void log_motion(const char *timestamp) {
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(log_file, "%s\n", timestamp);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void handle_motion(GPIOContext *ctx) {
    char timestamp[128];
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), LOG_FORMAT, localtime(&tv.tv_sec));

    log_motion(timestamp);
    buzzer_on(ctx);
    usleep(2000000); // 2 seconds
    buzzer_off(ctx);

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        buzzer_off(ctx);
        close(ctx->fd);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }

    gpio_init(&ctx);

    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(ctx.fd, GPIO_GET_PIN, ctx.buzzer) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read GPIO 18 pin");
            gpio_cleanup(&ctx);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (ctx.gpio->value == BUZZER_ON) {
            handle_motion(&ctx);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

    int inverted_valid;
} extended_command_data;

void mqtt_callback(struct json_object *json) {
    decoded_command *cmd = json_object_get_array_element(json, 0);
    extended_command_data *ext_cmd = json_object_get_array_element(json, 1);

    if (cmd && ext_cmd) {

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define AS7341_ADDR 0x29
#define IDENT_REG 0x00
#define ENABLE_REG 0x01
#define CFG6_REG 0x02
#define SP_EN_BIT 0x20
#define PON_BIT 0x10
#define CLEAR_BIT 0x40
#define NIR_BIT 0x80

#define LOG_FILE "spectral_log.csv"

#define SENSOR_PRESENT 1
#define SENSOR_ABSENT 0
#define I2C_SUCCESS 0
#define I2C_ERROR -1
#define I2C_TIMEOUT -2
#define I2C_READ_ERROR -3
#define I2C_WRITE_ERROR -4
#define I2C_BUS_ERROR -5
#define I2C_TIMEOUT_ERROR -6

#define LOG_LINE_FORMAT "%ld,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d\n"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    bool initialized;
    bool sensor_present;
} I2CDevice;

I2CDevice i2c_device;

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    if (err == I2C_SUCCESS) {
        return;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", err);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sensor_error(int err) {
    if (err == SENSOR_PRESENT) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor not present\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_log_error(int err) {
    if (err == I2C_SUCCESS) {
        return;
    }

    fprintf(stderr, "Log file error: %d\n", err);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    handle_log_error(i2c_device.fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void init_i2c_device() {
    i2c_device.fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_device.fd == -1) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_BUS_ERROR);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_device.fd, I2C_SLAVE, AS7341_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_BUS_ERROR);
    }

    i2c_device.initialized = true;
}

void read_ident_register() {
    uint8_t ident;
    ssize_t bytes_read;

    if ((bytes_read = i2c_device.fd ? read(i2c_device.fd, &ident, 1) : -1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_READ_ERROR);
    }

    if (bytes_read == 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_TIMEOUT_ERROR);
    }

    if (ident != 0x00) {
        handle_sensor_error(SENSOR_PRESENT);
    }
}

void write_enable_register() {
    uint8_t enable;
    enable = PON_BIT | SP_EN_BIT;

    if (write(i2c_device.fd, &enable, 1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_WRITE_ERROR);
    }
}

void write_cfg6_register() {
    uint8_t cfg6;
    cfg6 = CLEAR_BIT | NIR_BIT;

    if (write(i2c_device.fd, &cfg6, 1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_WRITE_ERROR);
    }
}

void read_spectral_channels() {
    uint8_t data[10];
    ssize_t bytes_read;

    if ((bytes_read = i2c_device.fd ? read(i2c_device.fd, data, 10) : -1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_READ_ERROR);
    }

    if (bytes_read == 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(I2C_TIMEOUT_ERROR);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        printf("%d ", data[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
}

void compute_lux_approximation() {
    // Simplified approximation for demonstration purposes
    uint32_t sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        sum += data[i];
    }

    lux_approximation = sum / 10;
}

void write_log_file() {
    FILE *fp;
    fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        handle_log_error(I2C_WRITE_ERROR);
    }

    fprintf(fp, LOG_LINE_FORMAT, current_time, data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7], data[8], data[9]);
    fclose(fp);
}

void main_loop() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        read_ident_register();
        write_enable_register();
        write_cfg6_register();
        read_spectral_channels();
        compute_lux_approximation();
        write_log_file();

        sleep(5);
    }
}

int main() {
    init_i2c_device();

    main_loop();

    return 0;
}

#define I2C_BUS "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x23
#define I2C_REG 0x00
#define I2C_REG_LUX 0x81
#define I2C_MULTICAST_IP "239.255.255.250"
#define I2C_MULTICAST_PORT 5000
#define I2C_MULTICAST_TTL 1

#define BUFFER_SIZE 1024

int i2c_fd;
int sock_fd;
struct sockaddr_in multicast_addr;

void i2c_read(int fd, unsigned char *buf, size_t size) {
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, buf) < 0) {
        perror("I2C read failed");
        return;
    }
}

void i2c_write(int fd, unsigned char *buf, size_t size) {
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, buf) < 0) {
        perror("I2C write failed");
        return;
    }
}

void i2c_close() {
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
        i2c_fd = -1;
    }
}

void i2c_init() {
    i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_read_lux() {
    unsigned char buf[2];
    i2c_write(i2c_fd, buf, 2);
    i2c_read(i2c_fd, buf, 2);
    float lux = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1];
    lux = lux / 0x80;
    printf("%.2f\n", lux);
}

void i2c_send_lux() {
    char buf[BUFFER_SIZE];
    struct sockaddr_in sender;
    socklen_t sender_len = sizeof(sender);
    int sent = 0;

    memset(buf, 0, BUFFER_SIZE);
    sender.sin_family = AF_INET;
    inet_pton(AF_INET, I2C_MULTICAST_IP, &sender.sin_addr);
    sender.sin_port = htons(I2C_MULTICAST_PORT);

    while (sent < BUFFER_SIZE) {
        if (sendto(sock_fd, buf, sent, 0, (struct sockaddr *)&sender, sender_len) < 0) {
            perror("UDP send failed");
            return;
        }
        sent += sprintf(buf + sent, "%.2f ", lux);
    }
}

void signal_handler(int sig) {
    i2c_close();
    close(sock_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    i2c_init();
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

    struct sockaddr_in multicast_addr;
    sock_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    if (sock_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to create UDP socket");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    multicast_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;

        perror("Failed to set UDP socket options");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (setsockopt(sock_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, &multicast_addr.sin_addr, sizeof(multicast_addr)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set UDP socket options");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    }

#define RANGE_LEN 4

} CsvWriter;

RadarFrame radar_frame;
RadarData radar_data;
CsvWriter csv_writer;

void init_radar_frame() {
    memset(&radar_frame, 0, sizeof(radar_frame));
    memset(&radar_data, 0, sizeof(radar_data));
}

void init_csv_writer(const char *filename) {
    strncpy(csv_writer.filename, filename, sizeof(csv_writer.filename) - 1);
    csv_writer.file = fopen(csv_writer.filename, "w");
    if (!csv_writer.file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open %s for writing\n", csv_writer.filename);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(csv_writer.file, "timestamp,object_index,range_m,velocity_mps\n");
}

void cleanup_radar_frame() {
    memset(&radar_frame, 0, sizeof(radar_frame));
    memset(&radar_data, 0, sizeof(radar_data));
}

void cleanup_csv_writer() {
    if (csv_writer.file) {
        fclose(csv_writer.file);
    }
}

void handle_radar_frame_error(const char *error) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Error reading radar frame: %s\n", error);
}

void read_radar_frame(int fd) {
    ssize_t bytes_read;
    bool magic_word_read = false;
    bool tlv_read = false;

    while (1) {
        bytes_read = read(fd, radar_frame.tlv, sizeof(radar_frame.tlv));
        if (bytes_read < 0) {
            handle_radar_frame_error("Failed to read from UART");
            return;
        } else if (bytes_read == 0) {
            handle_radar_frame_error("Empty read from UART");
            return;
        }

        if (!magic_word_read) {
            if (memcmp(radar_frame.tlv, radar_frame.magic_word, MAGIC_WORD_LEN) == 0) {
                magic_word_read = true;
            } else {
                handle_radar_frame_error("Invalid magic word");
                return;
            }
        }

        if (magic_word_read && tlv_read) {
            if (radar_frame.tlv[TLV_LEN * 2 - 1] == 0) {
                // Valid TLV
                radar_data.timestamp = *(uint64_t *)&radar_frame.tlv[0];
                radar_data.object_index = radar_frame.tlv[TLV_LEN];
                radar_data.range_m = *(uint32_t *)&radar_frame.tlv[TLV_LEN + 1];
                radar_data.velocity_mps = *(uint32_t *)&radar_frame.tlv[TLV_LEN + 3];

                fprintf(csv_writer.file, "%ld,%d,%u,%u\n", (long)radar_data.timestamp, radar_data.object_index, radar_data.range_m, radar_data.velocity_mps);

                cleanup_radar_frame();
                init_radar_frame();
                magic_word_read = false;
                tlv_read = false;
            } else {
                handle_radar_frame_error("Invalid TLV");
                cleanup_radar_frame();
                init_radar_frame();
                magic_word_read = false;
                tlv_read = false;
            }
        } else if (!magic_word_read) {
            if (bytes_read >= MAGIC_WORD_LEN) {
                memcpy(radar_frame.magic_word, radar_frame.tlv, MAGIC_WORD_LEN);
            }
        } else if (!tlv_read) {
            if (bytes_read >= TLV_LEN * 2) {
                tlv_read = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int uart_fd;
    struct gpiod_device *dev;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_signal *signal;
    struct gpiod_loop *loop;
    struct gpiod_loop_event *event;
    struct gpiod_loop_event *prev_event;
    int fd;

    init_radar_frame();
    init_csv_writer("radar_data.csv");

    uart_fd = open(UART_DEV, O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY);
    if (uart_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open %s for reading\n", UART_DEV);
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    fd = ioctl(uart_fd, TIO_CFLAGS, TIO_CFLAG0);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to set baud rate\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    fd = ioctl(uart_fd, TIO_CMODE, TIO_CMODE8N1);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to set mode\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    dev = gpiod_open("/dev/ttyS0");
    if (!dev) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open device\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    line = gpiod_get_line(dev, "gpiochip0", "gpio28");
    if (!line) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get line\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    edge = gpiod_get_edge(line, "rising");
    if (!edge) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get edge\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    signal = gpiod_get_signal(edge, "edge");
    if (!signal) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get signal\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    loop = gpiod_get_loop(signal, "loop");
    if (!loop) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get loop\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    event = gpiod_loop_get_event(loop, 0);
    if (!event) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get event\n");
        cleanup_csv_writer();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    prev_event = NULL;

    while (1) {
        gpiod_loop_wait(loop, event, prev_event);
        if (event) {
            if (prev_event) {
                gpiod_loop_remove_event(loop, prev_event);
            }
            prev_event = event;
            read_radar_frame(uart_fd);
        }
    }

    cleanup_radar_frame();
    cleanup_csv_writer();

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
